izzyondroid:com.sentaroh.android.SMBSync.name: SMBSync2
izzyondroid:com.sentaroh.android.SMBSync.summary: sync files between a PC/NAS and Android via wireless LAN
izzyondroid:com.sentaroh.android.SMBSync.description:
SMBSync2 is a tool for synchronizing files via wireless LAN using SMB1, SMB2 or SMB3 protocol between the internal storage of Android terminal, SDCARD and PC/NAS. Synchronization is a one-way from the master to the target, mirror, move, copy, archive can be used. (Internal storage, SDCARD, SMB, ZIP combination is possible).
 A start of the sync can be done by external application (Tasker, AutoMagic etc) or SMBSync2 schedule.
 Mirror: If master and target files are different, to copied files from master to the target directory. To delete target files and directories if does not exist in the master.
 Move: If master and target files are different, to copied files from master to the target directory. To delete the master directories and files copied to the target.
However, the master and target same name, same file modification time and file size, to delete the file on the master without copying files.
 Copy: If master and target files are different, to copied files from master to the target directory. However, the same file modification time and file size with the same name does not copy the master and target.
 Archive: Move photos and videos in the directory on the master side to the target under conditions such as shooting date/time than the date and time of archive execution, such as 7 days or earlier or 30 days or earlier. (However, ZIP can not be used for target)

izzyondroid:org.screenlite.webkiosk.name: Screenlite Web Kiosk
izzyondroid:org.screenlite.webkiosk.summary: displays web content in full-screen mode
izzyondroid:org.screenlite.webkiosk.description:
Screenlite Web Kiosk is a simple Android kiosk browser app that displays web content in full-screen mode.
 Key Features 
 Displays any website in immersive full-screen mode
 Automatically launches on device boot
 Brings itself back to the foreground if minimized
 Clicking and scrolling are disabled in WebView on TV
 Supports website rotation (0°, 90°, 180°, 270°), even if the device doesn’t support orientation changes
 Automatic retry mechanism with exponential backoff for network failures
 Automatically injects responsive viewport meta tags
 Special UI adaptations for Android TV devices
 Hides system bars and navigation elements
 Prevents device from going to sleep
 Real-time network connectivity monitoring
 Error handling with user-friendly messages
 Compatible with both Android TV and mobile devices
 Usage Instructions 
 Install the APK on your Android device.
 Grant the Display over other apps permission to Screenlite Web Kiosk.
 Launch the app.
 Access settings by tapping the screen 5 times quickly in the bottom-left corner on a mobile device, or by pressing the center button (OK) on a TV remote.
 Enter the website URL you want to display.
 Set the app visibility check interval (recommended 5–10 seconds). If you need time to configure the device, set a higher number.
 Choose screen rotation if needed.
 Save your settings; the app will restart with the new configuration.

Sunday - Glorious
Monday - Joyful
Tuesday - Sorrowful
Wednesday - Glorious
Thursday - Luminous
Friday - Sorrowful
Saturday - Joyful

fdroid:com.dev.svn.psbdx.name: PSBDx SVN
fdroid:com.dev.svn.psbdx.description:
PSBDx SVN is a modern, fully open-source Subversion client for Android. Check out repositories, edit files, commit and review history from your phone, with your saved credentials protected by biometrics.
 Subversion tools 
• Checkout, update, commit, revert and cleanup
• Built-in file explorer: view, edit, rename, delete, copy, cut, paste and add files and folders
• Conflict resolution: keep mine, take theirs, or merge by hand
• Commit history with author, date, message and changed paths
• Visual diff of your working copy against the base revision
• Saved repository bookmarks with custom aliases
 Bring files in and out 
• Upload files or whole folders from internal storage, SD cards and USB drives with the built-in file browser
• Export a repository to your Download folder as a clean copy without .svn metadata
 Your credentials stay yours 
• Repository URL and username copy with one tap
• Viewing or copying a password requires fingerprint, face, or your device PIN / pattern
• Copied passwords are wiped from the clipboard after 30 seconds
• Credentials are stored with Android Keystore backed encryption
• System cloud backup is disabled for the app
 Backup and restore, the F-Droid way 
• Encrypted backup (AES-256-GCM with your own passphrase) to a local file, works with no account at all
• Google Drive backup is optional and off by default. It signs in with your Google account in the browser (OAuth 2.0 with PKCE) and uploads one encrypted file to the app's private Drive folder. No Google Play Services and no closed-source SDKs are used
• Automatic backup whenever you add or change a repository, plus manual Backup Now and Restore
 Design 
• Material 3 interface with light and dark themes, automatic system switching and a manual override
 Good to know 
• Supports http, https and svn:// repositories (svn+ssh is not supported)
• Browsing storage to upload files uses the "manage all files" permission, requested only when you first upload
Found a bug or have an idea? Use Settings → Contact support to open an issue on GitHub.

fdroid:com.dmi3dmi3.saywhen.name: SayWhen
fdroid:com.dmi3dmi3.saywhen.summary: One phrase — and it's on your calendar. No forms, no fields.
fdroid:com.dmi3dmi3.saywhen.description:
No forms, no fields. Just say when.
Type an event the way you'd say it, in English, Russian, Italian, Spanish, German, or French:
• Gym every tuesday and friday at 9
• Movie tomorrow at 11 for 1.5h !10
• Dentist june 3 at 12:30
SayWhen parses the phrase as you type: date, time, duration, recurrence, a "!10" reminder. It shows a live preview of what it understood and writes the event straight to the calendar you chose. An alias in the phrase, like #work, sends one event to another calendar. Aliases come from your calendar names, and typing # brings up suggestions. With the Tasks.org integration turned on, a phrase can create a task in a Tasks.org list instead of an event: the lists appear next to your calendars. Tap the home-screen widget, type, done.
Private by construction:
• No sign-up, no server, no analytics, no identifiers
• No network access at all: the app doesn't even declare the INTERNET permission
• Two calendar permissions: read your calendar list, write the event you asked for. Two more for Tasks.org, asked only if you turn that integration on
Events go to your calendar and nowhere else. If your calendar belongs to a synced account, its own sync engine uploads the event, exactly as with any other calendar app.

fdroid:com.ismartcoding.plain.name: PlainApp: Phone Web Portal
fdroid:com.ismartcoding.plain.summary: Manage your phone on the web! Access files, contacts, videos, music & more.
fdroid:com.ismartcoding.plain.description:
**PlainApp** is a free, open-source Android app that turns your phone into a self-hosted management hub accessible from any web browser on the same network - no accounts, no cloud, no subscriptions.
**Why PlainApp?**
Most phone-management tools route your data through their own servers, lock features behind subscriptions, or show ads. PlainApp is different:
- **100% local** - your data never leaves your network
- **End-to-end encrypted** - every connection is secured with TLS + XChaCha20-Poly1305
- **Free and ad-free** - no purchases, no upsells, ever
- **Fully open-source** - audit the code, build your own binary, or contribute
**Features**
**Web-Based Phone Management**
Open a browser on any device connected to the same Wi-Fi network to manage your Android phone - no app installation required on the computer side.
- **Files** - Browse internal storage, SD card, and USB drives; upload, download, rename, delete
- **Media** - View and manage photos, videos, and audio; stream them in the browser
- **Contacts** - View, search, and manage contacts
- **SMS & Calls** - Read messages and call logs; send SMS from your desktop
- **Apps** - List installed apps and export APKs
- **Notifications** - Mirror phone notifications to the browser in real time
- **Screen Mirror** - Live-stream the phone screen to the browser with audio and remote control support
- **Device Info** - Check battery, storage, network, and system details
**Built-in Android Tools**
PlainApp is also a capable standalone app:
- **Markdown Notes** - Write and organize notes with a clean editor
- **RSS Reader** - Follow your favorite websites with a distraction-free reader
- **Video & Audio Player** - Full-featured media player with playlist support
- **TV Cast** - Cast media to any DLNA/Chromecast-compatible TV
- **Peer-to-Peer Chat & File Sharing** - Share files and messages directly between devices without a server
- **Pomodoro Timer** - Stay focused with a built-in work timer
- **Sound Meter** - Measure ambient noise levels in real time
**Privacy & Security**
- No Firebase Analytics or Messaging - crash reporting is optional and opt-in
- Zero data sent to any third-party server
- All traffic between phone and browser is encrypted
- No account registration required
**Links**
- Github: https://github.com/plainhub/plain-app
- Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/plainapp

Spix is your elegant, privacy-first fitness companion that works 100% offline.
PRIVACY & PHILOSOPHY
Because your health data belongs to YOU, Spix was designed to be completely transparent:

• Secure Camera: Used only for real-time movement detection in Rep Counter. No images are saved or sent.
• Accelerometer Alternative: Privacy-conscious? Use sensor-only mode to count reps without the camera.
• Optional Social Features: Social features are completely optional. You stay in control.
• Complete Deletion: One-click account deletion removes all your data instantly.
• No Data Selling: Never. This is a passion project, not a commercial product.
MAIN FEATURES
Dashboard & Tracking
• Today Screen: Synthetic view with weekly progress ring and calendar
• Complete Tracking: 4 dedicated modes (Home Workout, Running, Meals, Measurements)
• History: Full journal with filters and quick deletion
• Health Connect (Android): Smart automatic import of your workouts from other apps
Intelligent Rep Counter
Put down your phone and let AI work for you:
• Detection: Analysis via Camera (local Pose Detection) or Accelerometer
• Exercises: Support for Push-ups, Squats, Sit-ups, Jumping Jacks
• Feedback: Smooth animations and visual coaching
Tools & Gamification
• Workout Generator: Create custom workouts (Duration, Focus, Intensity)
• Streak System: Maintain your streak to unlock visual rewards
• Badges: 10+ trophies to unlock (From "First Step" to "Legend")
• Statistics: Interactive charts to visualize your progress (Weight, Activity)
TECH STACK
Built with React Native, Expo SDK 54, TypeScript, and local-first architecture using Zustand + MMKV for blazing-fast offline performance.
OPEN SOURCE
Spix is open source under AGPL-3.0 license. Contributions welcome!

fdroid:com.urik.keyboard.name: Urik Keyboard
fdroid:com.urik.keyboard.description:
Privacy-focused Android keyboard with swipe typing, custom layouts, and password manager support. No tracking, 100% on-device, and fully open source.
## Features
**Input**
- Swipe typing with geometric path matching and vertex detection
- One-handed and split modes with coordinate transformation
- Adaptive layout for tablets and foldables
- Long-press for character variations and custom key mapping
- Long-press comma key to switch keyboards (IME picker)
- Spacebar swipe for cursor control
- Backspace swipe to delete previous word
- Optional number row
- QWERTZ, AZERTY, Dvorak, Colemak, Workman, Bds and Hcesar layouts
- Hardware keyboard detection
**Intelligence**
- Local bigram model for next-word prediction
- On-device spell checking using URIK (Ultra-compressed Ranked Input Korpus) — a custom binary dictionary format with Levenshtein automaton traversal
- Autocorrect with configurable pause-on-misspell; skips URLs, emails, and punctuation
- Word learning with encrypted SQLCipher database
- User-specific word frequency tracking
- 19 supported languages with dedicated language toggle button
- Merged dictionaries mode for multilingual typing sessions
- Emoji search with keyword support
**Integration**
- Inline autofill support for password managers (Android 11+)
- Clipboard history with encrypted storage
**Customization**
- 15+ built-in themes with favorites and Material You dynamic theming (Android 12+)
- Custom long-press symbol and key assignments
- Haptic feedback strength slider
- Auto-capitalization toggle
- Configurable key size, key label size, spacebar size, and cursor speed
- Manage learned words: browse, search, and delete entries
- WCAG AA contrast and TalkBack support
**Privacy**
- No telemetry, analytics, or network permissions
- Local on-device processing
- Encrypted local storage for user data (AES-256 + Android Keystore)
- Biometric authentication for accessing learned words
- Dictionary export and import for backup or migration
- Bigram predictions and word frequencies remain local-only (not exported)
## Privacy
All processing happens on-device. No data leaves your phone. User dictionary and learned words are stored in an encrypted local database.
We answer to our users, not investors.

fdroid:dk.bjoerckbraun.deltasync.name: DeltaSync
fdroid:dk.bjoerckbraun.deltasync.summary: Encrypted KeePass sync — requires your own self-hosted server.
fdroid:dk.bjoerckbraun.deltasync.description:
⚠ REQUIRES YOUR OWN SERVER. DeltaSync does nothing on its own. You must first
install and run the self-hosted DeltaSync server (PHP + PostgreSQL), or have
access to someone else's, and enrol this device against it. There is no public
or default server — without one, this app has nothing to sync and cannot even
be set up. If you just want a standalone KeePass app, this is not it: use
KeePass2Android or KeePassDX instead.
DeltaSync keeps a KeePass (.kdbx) database synchronised across your devices
through a server that only ever sees encrypted blobs. Your master password
never leaves the device, and the server cannot read entry titles, usernames,
passwords, notes or attachments — even if it is compromised.
How it differs from other KeePass sync solutions:
• Entry-level deltas: only changed entries cross the wire, not the whole
 .kdbx file. Fewer bytes uploaded, fewer wholesale conflicts.
• Real end-to-end encryption: per-entry XChaCha20-Poly1305 with a key
 derived from your master password via Argon2id and HKDF-SHA256. The
 server stores opaque ciphertext.
• Concurrent edits merge: two devices editing different entries merge
 cleanly. If both change the same entry, the most recent edit wins.
• Multi-user sharing without key escrow: NaCl sealed-box wraps the
 database master key to each recipient's device public key. The server
 sees who has access, not what they can decrypt.
• Open source from end to end: the AGPL-3.0 server (PHP/PostgreSQL),
 GPL-3.0 desktop client (Go), and this GPL-3.0 Android client are all
 published. You can self-host the server, or use someone else's.
This app pairs with KeePass2Android or KeePassDX as your editor — DeltaSync
itself is a background sync service and does not display your passwords.
You point it at a .kdbx file on the device, supply the master password
once, and it keeps the file in sync with the server through WorkManager.
Project: https://gitlab.com/Star95/keepass-deltasync
Website: https://deltasync.org
Groups sync too: group structure and which group each entry belongs to stay
in sync across devices, alongside the entry contents.
Status: v0.4 — the sync layer (entries + groups) is feature-complete and
tested; the UI is functional but still minimal. Treat as beta.

fdroid:org.ea.sqrl.description:
This app is an implementation for SQRL (Secure Quick Reliable Login) on Android.
Before you begin using SQRL to login to websites, your SQRL private identity
must be created. You only need one, probably for life, because it reveals
NOTHING about you, and it's highly secure. It's just a very long (77-digit)
random number.
From then on, whenever you login with SQRL to a website, your private identity
is used to generate another 77-digit number for that one website. Every website
you visit sees you as a different number, yet every time you return to the same
site, that site's unique number is regenerated.
This allows you to be uniquely and permanently identified, yet completely
anonymous.
Since you never need to use an eMail address or a password, you never give a
website your actual identity to protect. If the website's SQRL identities are
ever stolen, not only would the stolen identities only be valid for that one
website, but SQRL's cryptography prevents impersonation using stolen identities.
This is as good as it sounds. It's what we've been waiting for.

Zoom Earth is an interactive weather map of the world and a real-time hurricane tracker.

With Zoom Earth, you can track the development of hurricanes, storms, and severe weather, monitor wildfires and smoke, and stay aware of the latest conditions by viewing satellite imagery updated in near real‑time.
SATELLITE IMAGERY
Zoom Earth shows weather maps with near real-time satellite imagery.
Live satellite images from NOAA GOES, JMA Himawari, and EUMETSAT Meteosat geostationary satellites are updated every 10 minutes.
HD satellite images are updated twice a day from NASA polar-orbiting satellites Aqua and Terra.
RAIN RADAR & NOWCAST
Stay ahead of the storm with our weather radar map, which shows rain and snow detected by ground-based Doppler radar in real-time, and provides an instant short-term weather forecast with radar nowcasting.
WEATHER FORECAST MAPS
Explore beautiful, interactive visualizations of the weather with our stunning global forecast maps. Our maps are continually updated with the latest weather forecast model data from DWD ICON and NOAA/NCEP/NWS GFS. Weather forecast maps include:
Precipitation Forecast - Rain, snow, and cloud cover, all in one map.
Wind Speed Forecast - Average speed and direction of surface winds.
Wind Gusts Forecast - Maximum speed of sudden bursts of wind.
Temperature Forecast - Air temperatures at 2 meters (6 feet) above the ground.
“Feels Like” Temperature Forecast - Perceived temperatures, also known as apparent temperature or heat index.
Relative Humidity Forecast - How air moisture compares to temperature.
Dew Point Temperature Forecast - How dry or humid the air feels, and the point at which condensation occurs.
Wet-Bulb Temperature Forecast - Heat stress levels.
Atmospheric Pressure Forecast - The average atmospheric pressure at sea level. Low-pressure areas often bring cloudy and windy weather. High-pressure areas are associated with clear skies and lighter winds.
HURRICANE TRACKING
Follow hurricanes from development to category 5 in real-time with our best-in-class tropical tracking system. Information is clear and easy to understand. Our hurricane tracking weather maps are updated using the very latest data from NHC, JTWC, NRL, and IBTrACS.
WILDFIRE TRACKING
Monitor wildfires with our active fires and heat spots overlay, which shows points of very high temperature detected by satellite. Detections are updated daily with data from NASA FIRMS. Use in conjunction with our GeoColor satellite imagery to see the movement of wildfire smoke and monitor fire weather in near real-time.

Adjust temperature units, wind units, time zone, animation styles, and many more features with our comprehensive settings.

apple-macos:1662162702.name: MoodyScope
apple-macos:1662162702.description:
MoodyScope is a mood tracker you can use in five seconds.
Pick how you feel, from Awful to Great. Every mood is weather: a thunderstorm for the worst days, full sun for the best. Pick the feelings that fit, tag what you were doing, like working, sleeping, or socializing, and add a line if you want. That's the whole check-in.
A SKY THAT FOLLOWS YOUR DAY
Home shows the real sun and moon where you are, from sunrise to a sky full of stars, with clouds and rain from today's mood.
YOUR MONTH IN COLOR
Every check-in fills a square on your calendar. Tap any day to see the mood, feelings, tags, and note you logged. Streaks, averages, and your mood mix show up on their own as you go.
ONE QUESTION A DAY
365 short reflection prompts, one for each day. Answer today's, skip it, or come back later. Your answers stay saved, and you can reopen and edit them anytime.
WELLNESS SCORE
Connect Apple Health and MoodyScope turns your steps and heart rate into a daily score out of 100, next to how you said you felt. MoodyScope only reads Health data. It never writes to it.
BADGES
Earn seals for showing up, from your first mood to a full year of check-ins. Each one shows how close you are to the next.
ALSO
• Daily reminders at the time you choose
• Share a day's mood
• Made for iPhone Duo: fits the outside screen, and splits across both halves when open
• On Mac too, with Calendar, Journal, and Insights
• Sign in with Apple or email
• Your entries sync to your account, so a new phone picks up where you left off

apple-macos:976359729.name: Earthquake Monitor
apple-macos:976359729.description:
Browse earthquakes in the past 24 hours or past 30 days in map mode or data feed mode. Use the slider to quickly filter earthquakes by magnitude. 
Get push notifications for earthquakes globally or at up to four custom specific locations. For each location you choose to monitor, you set the cutoff magnitude and radius. These earthquake notifications have a built-in epicenter map on iOS and watchOS. Tap a notification in the iOS Notification Center to jump to the detailed view for that earthquake.
Set a custom location in feed mode to find the closest recent earthquakes to that location and to populate distances for all earthquakes relative to the custom location. 
Tap on an earthquake to show more details including depth and "Felt By" numbers. 
Drilling into a specific earthquake also reveals options to:
1. jump to the USGS event webpage
2. plot cities near the epicenter with their populations
Also included:
- A Today View Widget for quick access to earthquakes in the past hour. Tap an earthquake from this table to jump to its specific page in the app.
- A watchOS app for access to the past hour of earthquakes, including zoomable maps, "Felt By" numbers, and depths.
- 3D touch the app icon to bypass the main app menu in convenient ways.
A Recent Earthquake News section: find news from 1,600+ cited sources quickly on a map or in a table view tagged by state alphabetically. Set up your own custom state feed with the state toggles.
Please read the App Help File for more specific usage information.
All data is from the USGS (United States Geological Survey).
Terms of Use: https://davidgrossapps.com/terms/tos-earthquake-monitor.html

apple-macos:1671426023.description:
All Day shows you the weather for the whole day in a single glance. 
There's no scrolling or tapping to navigate to the info you want.

Hourly conditions are shown in a row of icons across the top of the screen.
Precipitation is shown in a bar chart.
Temperature is shown in a line chart.
Cloud Cover is shown with precipitation.
Alerts are shown across the top of the screen with starting and ending times.

apple-macos:1581367286.name: WallCal - Calendar on desktop
apple-macos:1581367286.description:
WallCal is a desktop calendar that always stays on the desktop wallpaper. A keystroke or mouse click can bring it to the frontmost, and with another keystroke or click it will return to the background. Instantly see and recall what your calendar/agenda/todo-list currently be as soon as you go back to the desktop wallpaper!
These features below are available free of charge:
・An always-on desktop background calendar displaying all events/reminders of the current month on your desktop. Reminders appear right alongside your events, and overdue or undated reminders are listed below the calendar header. Since it displays your current macOS/iCloud calendars, you don't have to create anything new, just continue using your existing macOS/iCloud calendars as you always do.
・Bring the calendar to frontmost state on demand by a keystroke/mouse click, and another keystroke/mouse click to bring it back to the desktop background.
・Step to the previous or next month or week with the arrow and Today buttons on the calendar and the sidebar, even while the calendar sits on the desktop background.
・Check off a reminder by clicking its square, right on the desktop background.
・Switch between the whole month and the weekly agenda view, which shows your events on a 24-hour timeline, with the button in the calendar's header.
・Overdue reminders show in red and stay pinned above the Sidebar's days.
・The pencil switch in the header turns off adding and editing, or every interaction, while the calendar sits on the desktop background.
・Click a day in the Sidebar's mini calendar to jump the Event list to that day.
・Choose where reminders without a date appear in the Event list: first, right after today, or last.
・Resize/reposition by dragging & dropping the calendar view while it’s in the frontmost state
With the Expert calendar add-on, these features below will be available for use:
・Add and edit events and to-dos right from the calendar: on the desktop, double-click a day to add one and click an item to edit it. In front, a single click does it.
・You can set the weekly agenda view's visible hours, the number of days it shows, and its display mode.
・You can choose to display only the calendar, only the sidebar, or both, and hide the Sidebar's mini calendar.
・You can choose which calendar event sets or reminder sets to be displayed. By default, all calendar event/reminder sets will be displayed.
・You can choose whether the main calendar shows calendar events, reminders, or both.
・You can choose a Native Liquid Glass look, Transparent or Blurred background for your calendar, and adjust its text size.
If you have any bugs to report, or you have any questions/suggestions, please feel free to contact us at tsukie.studio@gmail.com or visit wallcal.app/support. All inquiries are very much appreciated!

 Software easy to use offline dictionary
 The Eudict is an essential reference software for English learners. It starts quickly, has a full range of features, is ad-free, and provides an uninterrupted experience. With a massive expandable vocabulary library and customizable editing, it supports translations in multiple languages, including Chinese, English, Japanese, French, German, and more. Covering all aspects of language learning, it includes learning, translation, note-taking, and exam preparation. With features like voice translation, photo translation, and one-click access, the app offers convenient operations. In addition to word lookups, translations, note-taking, and vocabulary building, it also introduces AI features such as theme writing and error correction, revolutionizing your English learning experience.
 【产品简介】 
海量词汇：内置常用英汉词条30万个，专业词条40万个，海量例句库178万条。 
拍照翻译：摄像头取词、拍照查词功能，即拍即查，阅读文献好帮手。 
单词复习：自定义学习目标，多种图表，帮你更好回顾自己的学习。 
在线搜索：基于海量数据的云端词典，生僻词、例句、图片查询一网打尽。 
纯正发音：美音、英音自由选择，自定发音语速、小语种发音应有尽有。 
文件阅读：词典中即可阅读文件，支持单词长按查询，即点即译。
 【强大词库】 
权威词库：英汉 - 汉英词典、英英词典、同义词、反义词词典，权威详实。 
编辑词库：提供电脑端词库编辑器，支持自制扩充词库；朗文、牛津，权威词库尽情添加。 
扩充词库：通过网络下载各语种的扩充词库，支持Mdict、灵格斯、Babylon等多种词典格式，覆盖医学、经济、工程、计算机等十余个领域。
 【实用工具】 
高亮标记：重点词添加标记，云端同步，随时查阅。 
笔记同步：生词本、笔记、历史记录功能，支持同步。 
语音输入：英语整句翻译发音功能，支持语音输入。 
跨软件取词：使用其他软件时，长按即可查词，自动显示释义。
 【AI功能】
AI翻译：精准自然的AI翻译，超越各大翻译引擎
批改纠错：输入/粘贴文本后，精准高效地检查拼写、语法、标点等错误
主题写作：借助AI的力量，给定主题，将您的想法转化为文字
短句扩写：根据选中内容自动扩写，突破写作瓶颈
文章润色：文本一键润色、优化表达，助您的文章脱颖而出

flathub:net.trowell.typesetter.name: Typesetter
flathub:net.trowell.typesetter.description:
Typesetter is a minimalist editor for creating beautiful documents with the Typst markup language.
 Adaptive, user-friendly interface: Focus on writing. Great for papers, reports, slides, books,
 and any structured writing.
 Powered by Typst: A modern markup-based typesetting language, combining the simplicity of
 Markdown with the power of LaTeX.
 Fully local: Your files stay on your machine. No cloud lock-in.
 Secure by default: Keeps Typst projects isolated from unrelated files.
 Package management: Install, remove, and automatically fetch Typst packages from within the
 app.
 Bibliography management: Create and manage references through a built-in graphical interface.
 Templates: Create new documents from built‑in or user templates.
 Automatic preview: See your rendered document update as you write.
 Click-to-jump: Click on a part of the preview to jump to the corresponding position in the
 source file.
 Magnifier tool: Click and hold on the preview to inspect fine details.
 Accessibility checking: Simulate different forms of color blindness to check how your document
 looks to all readers.
 Centered scrolling: Keeps your writing visually anchored as you type.
 Syntax highlighting: Makes your documents easier to edit and read.
 Grammar suggestions: Automatically checks your writing for grammatical errors (currently
 English only).
 Document statistics: Easily calculate page, word, and character counts.
 Comment navigation: Browse your notes and other comments in one place, and jump directly
 to each one in the source.
 Fast and native: Built in Rust and GTK.

firefox-addons:3031070.name: PrivacyPirate - Block Trackers & Fingerprinting
firefox-addons:3031070.summary: Take back your privacy. Block trackers, poison their data, and browse without being watched.
firefox-addons:3031070.description:
Trackers follow you across the web, building profiles of everything you do. PrivacyPirate stops them with two layers of protection: network-level blocking and real-time counter-tracking.
WHAT IT BLOCKS
Over 50,000 tracking rules covering domains from companies like Google, Meta, Amazon, and hundreds of data brokers. Requests are blocked before they leave your browser using Firefox's built-in declarativeNetRequest engine. No data ever reaches the tracker.
WHAT IT FIGHTS BACK WITH
Some trackers can't be blocked without breaking the sites you need. For those, PrivacyPirate fights back with 7 counter-tracking tools:
Data poisoning: feeds trackers fake purchases, fake searches, and fake page views so your real profile becomes useless
Fake mouse movements: generates realistic mouse activity to pollute heatmap and session replay trackers like Hotjar and FullStory
Fake form interactions: simulates form field activity to corrupt form analytics that track how you fill out pages
Canvas fingerprint randomization: adds subtle noise to canvas and WebGL output so trackers can't build a unique fingerprint of your browser
Navigator spoofing: reports fake device details so trackers can't identify your hardware
Extension detection shield: prevents websites from detecting which extensions you have installed
Link tampering watchdog: alerts you if another extension silently modifies affiliate or referral links
FOUR PROTECTION LEVELS
Choose the level that fits your needs:
Moderate: blocks known trackers while keeping most sites working perfectly
High: blocks more aggressively for stronger protection
Extreme: maximum blocking for users who want the strictest privacy
Off: disable protection per site when you need to
You can also create per-site rules, allow specific trackers, or temporarily pause protection with a single click.
YOUR DATA STAYS WITH YOU
PrivacyPirate collects nothing. No analytics, no accounts, no telemetry. All settings are stored locally on your device. The tracker lists are bundled with the extension, not fetched from a server. You can export, import, or reset your settings at any time.
Made with care for your privacy.

firefox-addons:483763.description:
This addon won't be maintained further. I'm shelving this project due to lack of interest/utility and too much burden. The addon will remain available for download as long as the store allows, and the source on gitlab will also remain available to fork.
 I do have a greasyfork account you can check out, and you can get new versions of CSL, DID, and IBCP there! 
Available for Chrome too.
 Downloading images 
 (double)(right)click on images
 hover over them and click the button that appears
 drag and drop an image onto the hover button
 select page content (or point at an image) and use the context menu
 Extras 
 trigger a notification on successful downloads
 rename downloaded images using patterns and variables for better mass organization * 
 use filters to limit functionality if it gets in the way
 visually customize the hover button
 "image downloaded" effect for visual feedback can be disabled
 * uncertain support in Firefox: addon will automatically disable feature until supported
 FAQ 
 How does it work on thumbnail galleries? 
This addon downloads the image you directly interact with, i.e. the thumbnail. This is an unfortunately but deliberately omitted feature. Most browsers download link targets when alt-clicking on links, and most thumbnail galleries link each thumbnail to its full size source. Therefore, you do not actually need an addon to download most thumbnail galleries. For more complex galleries, addons dedicated to this purpose exist. You could also install Copy Selected Links and use a download manager.
The Options screen will automatically open after add-on updates if they force a change to any of your settings.
 Please rate/review/donate! :) 
A lot of time and work goes into creating my addons, and making changes or troubleshooting issues for users. This particular addon has cost hundreds of hours by now. Any donations are greatly appreciated.
 Cross-browser 
Please note that not all features work the same (or at all) as WebExtension support in browsers is not perfect yet.
 Problem, bug, broken, question, request? 
Per Mozilla policy, only an evaluation of an addon's entire function with reasonable expectations is a proper review. Vague complaints or 1-star ratings for single reasons are considered spam, as are false claims about the addon not working at all. For more detailed discussions, use the linked support site or email.

firefox-addons:2810525.name: grpc-web-devtools
firefox-addons:2810525.summary: Chrome extension for gRPC-Web to inspect requests and responses in human readable format
firefox-addons:2810525.description:
Chrome extension for gRPC-Web to inspect requests and responses in human readable format
grpc-web-devtools is a powerful extension designed to seamlessly intercept network requests and responses executed via the grpc-web protocol. This browser extension integrates a dedicated tab into the Chrome DevTools, facilitating the comprehensive logging of all grpc-web requests generated by a web application.
Within this extension, users gain the ability to effectively manage requests, employing advanced features such as request filtering and the purging of outdated requests. Notably, the extension is equipped with an intuitive JSON editor that enables in-depth inspection of both request and response elements, encompassing both body and metadata components for each interaction. This editor further offers the convenience of collapsing expansive objects for enhanced clarity, and supports easy content copying.
The scope of this extension's functionality extends to both UnaryRequest and StreamRequest interception. In the DevTools environment, when examining an unary call, the request showcases a structured representation featuring a body property denoting the transmitted object, as well as metadata encompassing supplementary headers sent during the request. This parallel structure is mirrored in the response, wherein the body signifies the object response from the server, and metadata encapsulates any extra headers furnished by the server.
For StreamRequest interactions, the structure is aligned with Unary, albeit with a distinction in the response. In the StreamRequest scenario, responses manifest as an array, encompassing key elements such as "data," "status," "error," "metadata," and "end."
For a comprehensive guide on configuring and utilizing this extension, refer to the following link: https://github.com/IvanRodriCalleja/grpc-web-devtools

Upgrade your HAM license from General to Amateur Extra! With the elimination of the Morse Code requirement, there is no reason not to upgrade your license to the highest level to obtain all privileges!
Amateur Radio License exams are composed of questions from a pool. Use this application prior to taking your exam to review and practice all possible questions. Then, test your knowledge with practice exams!
After completing your first practice exam, the question pool screen will display your proficiency in each question group for all practice exams you have completed.
You may choose to receive immediate feedback on right and wrong answers when taking a practice test. On practice tests, questions in a group will not be repeated until all of them have been used.

An in-progress practice test can be resumed if you exit the test or the application.
Current Extra question pool is valid through June 30, 2028.
Versions of this application for both the Technician and General license classes are also available.
This app has these additional features:
• Accessibility option for vision-impaired users to exclude questions with figures
• Dark mode support
• Portrait and Landscape support on iPad
• Swipe gestures to navigate between questions
• Tap on answer to select it
• Double-tap or use pinch gesture to zoom Figures on iPhone and iPod touch
• Buttons to skip to next/previous wrong answer in test results 
• ARRL question number displayed on practice tests 
• Configurable Test Settings 
• Optional randomizing of test answers 
• Optional auto-advance during test

We list every public autograph signing in America. Well. That we know about. We still need your help with submitting short notice, hard to find local appearances, which is what makes crave so great. We get submissions all day long from fans sending last minute signings, they see in public, social media, etc...Those short notice signings that are announced 24-48 hours in advance, that nobody ever hears about, we are able to quickly get listed on our website and give that instant information about the signing to our fans on our website and app. We have built a very unique website which is directly tied to this app and is free information for everyone.
Download the application now and have quick access to check your state right on your phone! You never know who you could meet today, tomorrow or this weekend!

bluejetty:00133846:ios.name: 3rd Grade Math Learning Games
bluejetty:00133846:ios.summary:
Smart Kidz Club Grade 3 Math App is curriculum-aligned for 8-9-year-olds to practice and master all the required grade 3 math skills. 
This app follows the US Common Core State Standards and consists of comprehensive math skills essential
bluejetty:00133846:ios.description:
Smart Kidz Club Grade 3 Math App is curriculum-aligned for 8-9-year-olds to practice and master all the required grade 3 math skills. 
This app follows the US Common Core State Standards and consists of comprehensive math skills essential for GRADE 3 school students. Resources consist of activity books with math problems.
Each Math Activity that requires complex solving, consists of a SCRATCH PAD option where the child can freely write on the screen (overlay) to solve the problems in writing if they so desire.
Math activities cover all the required grade 3 skills such as decimal numbers, equations, variables, measurement, geometry, understanding fractions including equivalent fractions, operations with fractions, logical reasoning, numbers up to thousands, place value, estimation, rounding, probability, statistics, Roman Numerals, data, graphs, properties and importance of parenthesis, time, and addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division expertise concepts.
Math Activities consist of 2 modes, practice and test. Each of these modes comes with a choice of the number of questions/problems that the child wishes to solve—
1) Practice Mode: The Practice Mode allows the child to solve each problem before advancing to the next problem while prompting them to try again if they choose the wrong answer. The Practice Mode is not scored. At the end of the practice mode, the child can try again with a new set of problems.
2) Test Mode: The Test Mode is scored and does not prompt the child during their attempt to solve the problem. At the end of the Test Mode, the child can try again with a set of new math problems or review their answers with detailed feedback and explanation. 
This app supports maths learning in homes by helping kids in grade 3 with their mathematical understanding and mastering math skills without any harmful distractions or ads.

bluejetty:00169267:ios.name: Australian Geology Travel Maps
bluejetty:00169267:ios.summary: Australian Geology Travel Maps is a field app that displays the best available data from the government geological surveys in interactive maps created by Trilobite Solutions. It does not have any reliance on cell phone reception in the fiel
bluejetty:00169267:ios.description:
Australian Geology Travel Maps is a field app that displays the best available data from the government geological surveys in interactive maps created by Trilobite Solutions. It does not have any reliance on cell phone reception in the field, and uses GPS so your location is always marked on the map. Maps are downloaded to your phone when have an internet connection, and from that point on, you are independent of the internet.
The simple geology maps are rich with contextual data - including shaded relief, roads, towns, tracks, rivers, lakes, geographic names, indigenous land, national parks & provincial parks.
App development, system maintenance and user support is fully-funded by subscriptions - there is no in-app advertising and your data is absolutely PRIVATE.
Overview video: http://trilobite.solutions/maps/videos/
App subscription
 - $11.99/year for Australians (1-week FREE trial)
 - required by ALL app users to run the app
 FUNCTIONALITIES
 • record your trails and write notes on marked locations
 • geology is spoken when you cross a boundary while driving
 • overlay any map semi-transparently over any other map
 • export trails and marked locations to Google Earth or your GIS
 • import trails and marked locations from Google Earth
 • import geojson data and mbtiles maps (videos on web-site)
 • draw straight line to target destination
 All AUSTRALIAN states:
 • simple geology
 • detailed geology
 • symbolised resource map
 • aero-magnetics imagery
 • recorded locations for many resource types
 • mining and lease boundaries
 NEW ZEALAND:
 • geology map
 • earth resources
 • earthquakes overlay
WA prospector subscription
 - $17.99/year for Australians (1-week FREE trial)
 - access to specialised prospecting maps
 • live/pending tenement boundaries (updated after every working day)
 • map of gold resources
 • drill holes overlay
 • display selected WA tenements
 • 1:250k topo maps for all of WA
 • graticular blocks overlay
QLD, NSW & VIC gold subscription
 - each $7.99/year for Australians (1-week FREE trial)
 • symbolised gold map for the state (updated 3-monthly)
Subscriptions cover all your iPhones & iPads.
When in the field, please PUT YOUR PHONE INTO FLIGHT MODE. This greatly extends your phone's battery life.
Warning: iPads without SIM sockets do not have GPS hardware, so will NOT determine your LOCATION IN THE FIELD.
Terms of Use: http://trilobite.solutions/maps/terms/
Trial and subscriptions details:
 • Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at the end of the 1-week trial period, unless you cancel your subscription at least 24 hours before the trial has finished, in which case NO CHARGE IS MADE.
 • Subscription automatically renews each year unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current subscription period
 • Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current subscription period
 • Subscriptions may be managed by you, and auto-renewal may be turned off within the SETTINGS APP on your iPhone/iPad

bluejetty:00089434:ios.description:
DeepFit is one application for fitness activity, providing data record, track, statistics etc, could work with DeepFit smart fitness bracelet and watch, users will enjoy more complete & uniform experience, to inspire people to have exercise habit and healthy life style, and meet the better yourself.
# DeepFit could do for you :
- Record daily exercise data: steps, distance, burnt calories.
- Show 24-hour exercise data, and total data by week and month, and trend statistics graph accordingly.
- Record daily sleep status, illustration with character shows deep sleep time, light sleep time and wake-up times. And summarize the sleep trend by week and month.
- Record daily actual data and scope about heart rate, list the top heart rate value, the lowest value, average data by day, week, month respectively.
- Record daily actual blood pressure data and variability trend, and list Blood pressure data on average and variability trend by week, month respectively.
- Record the exercise time in modes run, ride, plank, speed, heart rate, trajectory and burnt calories.
- Record daily weight data and variability curve.
- Could set exercise goal, and statistic daily complete percentage and achievement days, to encourage yourself to workout every day.
- Support to share data to WeChat, Moments, Weibo, facebook, twitter and other SNS APP.
- Health fitness data in registered Account syncs to Ali cloud server, no worry to lost data even use one new cellphone.
- Support to add your family, friends as caring people, and get their fitness data about exercise, heart rate, blood pressure and health trend.
- Could set alarm clocks of smart fitness watch and bracelet, stopwatch, countdown, event reminder, call reminder, mute, hang-up functions etc.
# Sweet tips :
- DeepFit APP supports OS: iOS 9.0 above. After getting permission, excercise data (steps, sleep, heart rate etc) syncs to iHealth APP, and steps data syncs to WeRun APP.
- DeepFit APP needs working with DeepFit smart watch and bracelet, can’t perform all functions if use individually.
# Suggestion feedback to deepservice@szhulin.com

bluejetty:00132305:ios.summary:
Every level hides a theme: art, science, cinema, countries, food. First you work out what the level is about, then which word is encoded in it.
The pictures are clues, not the answer. What you see is rarely the word itself, only something
bluejetty:00132305:ios.description:
Every level hides a theme: art, science, cinema, countries, food. First you work out what the level is about, then which word is encoded in it.
The pictures are clues, not the answer. What you see is rarely the word itself, only something connected to it. Two inventions on screen can point to the name of the inventor. Read the hint, find what the pictures have in common, then build the answer from the word pieces in the right order.
Why play:
- themed levels: art, science, cinema, countries, food, and more
- pictures that hint at the answer instead of showing it
- word pieces to arrange once you have found the connection
- castles to unlock, each with new categories and harder levels
- hints for the levels that stump you
- fully offline play, no internet needed
How to play:
- read the hint and study the pictures
- work out the theme and what connects the clues
- decide which word they point to
- put the pieces together in the correct order
- finish the level and open the next castle
Word Logic is for players who enjoy deduction, general knowledge, and picture clues. It is not a word search and not a quiz with ready answers: every level asks you to notice the link, recall the right word, and assemble it piece by piece.
Play offline, conquer castles, and see how many connections you can uncover.
Subscription
Royal Membership is an auto-renewable subscription available for a week, a month or a year. It unlocks extra levels, gives free coins every day and removes ads.
The price is shown in the app before the purchase and is charged to your Apple Account once the purchase is confirmed. The subscription renews automatically for the same period unless it is turned off at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Renewal is charged within 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel the subscription in your Apple Account settings.
Privacy Policy:
https://lunappstudio.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Use (EULA):

bluejetty:00062177:ios.description:
This is the brand-new Electronics Engineering ToolKit! The HIGHLY RATED and RECOMMENDED productivity app.
Users say it is the BEST and MOST PRACTICAL Electronics App in the whole App Store.
From an electronics enthusiast with a master's degree in Electronics Engineering. This App is for engineers, students and hobbyists and anyone interested in Electronics Engineering.
The App gets CONSTANT and POWERFUL improvements!
!!! This is a UNIVERSAL App - for iPhone and iPad !!! With In-App upgrade to PRO. If you don't like In-App purchases, you can also download the PRO version (red icon with PRO text) which is full PRO from the beginning without any In-App purchase.
WHAT OTHER USERS ARE SAYING:
“Awesome app, constant and powerful improvements”
This app was worth every penny I paid for it back when I bought it years ago. Since then, I’ve regularly used it at work and found it to be an excellent, quick tool to use. The most impressive aspect of this app are the constant and VERY impressive updates! Massive feature additions and very easy to use interface! The list of capabilities this app has makes it an amazing value for truly anyone involved in electronics.
“Latest version makes this an exceptional tool”
The EE Toolkit was always a very useful tool, but with the additions in the latest version it is truly an exceptional tool. The author is extremely diligent in managing bugs and improving the tool.
“A superb app highly recommended”
Fantastic application. Very useful. Always updated. Good developer. Lots of great bonus tools. Just love it.
"Incredible useful, worth the money"
I have had this app for a while now. Originally as an Electrical Engineering student I didnt really use it but once I was out in the field it became my bible. I definitely recommend to any engineering students/professionals alike. I also recommend buying the Pro version because it is definitely worth it. 
FEATURES OF THE EE TOOLKIT:
Ω more than 160 electronic applications
Ω amazingly great multi-functional keyboard
Ω huge selection of color code tools and SMD code tools
Ω audio scope and a frequency pitch detector
Ω favorites page only for the tools that you have marked as favorite
Ω full-featured frequency generator
Ω extra large component reference section (incl. 7400 Series, PIC family, etc.) with the option to open pdf datasheets live or by e.g. iBooks
Ω 555 Timer Tools with the most important application examples
Ω extensive collection of Single Board Computers (more than 120 different boards!!!)
Ω PCB trace impedance tools for several different structures
Ω simple and quick unit conversion within the single calculators
Ω fast on-the-fly conversions and calculations
Ω real-time circuit simulations of the example circuits
Ω support for preferred E series, sliders and min/max calculations
Ω auto-save of all entries over several sessions
Ω file manager to save and load individual calculations
Ω built-in access to your iCloud
Ω formula search tool with quick links to the tool which uses the formula
Ω and many many more

bluejetty:00127658:ios.summary:

Stay connected globally for less. Whether you need to make high-quality international calls at low rates, recharge a phone of a loved one back hom
bluejetty:00127658:ios.description:
Save today on International Calls, Mobile Recharges & Travel eSIMs with the KeepCalling App!
Stay connected globally for less. Whether you need to make high-quality international calls at low rates, recharge a phone of a loved one back home, or get instant data for your next trip, KeepCalling has you covered in one easy-to-use iOS app.
Forget about calling cards and roaming fees. Easily make cheap calls or send top-ups to Mexico, India, China, Colombia, Cuba, Thailand, Vietnam, Saudi Arabia, Nigeria, and many more. With KeepCalling it’s easy to call home.
Premium voice calls:
• High Quality: Enjoy crystal-clear VoIP calls at local rates
• Pay per minute with no hidden fees
• Use with WiFi or Mobile Data
Download for free and get:
• Cheap rates for international phone calls
• No Hidden or Extra Fees
• $5 Minimum Order to get started
• Minute Rounding
• 100% Call Quality
• Access from all iOS smartphones and tablets
• Direct access to your phone contacts
• 24/7 Outstanding Customer Service
Very easy to use:
1. Create an account or login.
2. Buy Voice Credit, Mobile Recharge, or Travel eSIM.
3. Start calling and stay connected with the world!
Extra options:
• Instantly check the rate/min for the destination you want to call
• Check out the answers to frequently asked questions in our Help Center
• Set My Caller ID - Let your friends and family know it’s you calling by setting your Caller ID directly in the app.
• Rate Our App - We value your feedback. Let us know how we’re doing!
Features:
• Integrated Contacts: Use your existing iOS contact list for 1-tap calls.
• Easy Onboarding: Create a new account directly from the app in seconds.
• Speed Dial: Call your favorite international numbers faster than ever.
TIP: We recommend turning off "International Calling" with your current mobile provider to avoid accidental high charges on their network. Always use the KeepCalling app for the best international rates!
Backup calling method:
Use our Toll Free or Local Access numbers from any mobile or landline.
Mobile Recharge
Help your family stay connected globally. Send mobile recharges to over 160 countries instantly. Our secure platform ensures your mobile credit reaches those who matter, fast and without hassle.
Travel eSIM
Travel smart with our eSIM data plans. Stay online abroad without the headache of expensive carrier roaming fees. Activate your Travel eSIM in seconds and enjoy high-speed internet.
Questions or feedback?
We value your opinion! Reach out to us at customerservice@keepcalling.com or check our Help Center directly in the app.
Frequently asked questions
1. Can I use my phone contacts?
Yes, but you have to make sure that all phone numbers are saved in international format: country code + phone number.
2. How much data does the app use for an online call?
On average, the app uses approximately 1MB/min for making a voice call. In order to benefit from the highest quality available, we advise you to use the application with a WiFi network. Any costs resulting from using the application with mobile data networks when you call internationally are not covered by us.
3. Which countries & operators support mobile top-ups?
You can send top-ups to 160+ countries and mobile operators around the world. Simply browse through the list of available destinations; once you select your desired country, the available operators will be displayed.
4. What is a travel eSIM and how does it work?
A travel eSIM is a digital SIM card that allows you to access mobile data in other countries without needing a physical SIM. Instead of inserting a plastic card, you download a profile to your phone. It works by connecting your device to local mobile networks in your destination country, providing you with affordable data at more cost-effective rates than traditional international roaming.

bluejetty:00061623:ios.name: Delivery Route Planner - Upper
bluejetty:00061623:ios.summary:
Plan smarter routes. Deliver more packages. Get home earlier.
Upper is the route planning app built for delivery drivers, couriers, and field professionals who need to optimize multi-stop routes fast. Stop wasting time manually plotting ad
bluejetty:00061623:ios.description:
Plan smarter routes. Deliver more packages. Get home earlier.
Upper is the route planning app built for delivery drivers, couriers, and field professionals who need to optimize multi-stop routes fast. Stop wasting time manually plotting addresses — let Upper's algorithm find your fastest path through 500+ stops in seconds.
INTELLIGENT ROUTE OPTIMIZATION
Our optimization engine analyzes every variable: distance between stops, real-time traffic, delivery time windows, priority packages, service time at each location, and your preferred highways. The result? Routes that actually work in the real world, not just on paper.
- Optimize up to 500 stops per route
- Factor in delivery windows and priority levels
- Set service time per stop for accurate planning
- Choose highway preferences and toll avoidance
- Handle pickups and deliveries on the same route
IMPORT STOPS YOUR WAY
No more typing addresses one by one. Upper accepts stops however you get them:
- Import from Excel, CSV, or any spreadsheet
- Capture manifest photos — our OCR reads the addresses
- Copy-paste address lists directly
- Add stops manually when needed
ADDRESS VALIDATION BUILT IN
Bad addresses kill delivery efficiency. Upper validates every address before you drive, catching typos, wrong zip codes, duplicates, and formatting errors automatically. Know your route is solid before you leave.
ACCURATE ETAs YOUR CUSTOMERS CAN TRUST
Give customers reliable arrival windows. Upper calculates ETAs using actual driving speeds, service time at each stop, scheduled breaks, and real distances — not optimistic guesses.
NAVIGATE WITH YOUR FAVORITE APP
Launch directions in Google Maps, Waze, Apple Maps, or MapQuest. Use your phone or connect through Apple CarPlay. Upper hands off navigation seamlessly to whatever you prefer.
PROOF OF DELIVERY & TRACKING
Document every stop with photos, signatures, and notes. Track your progress through the route with real-time status updates. Export completed routes for client reporting or employer records.
SEE YOUR ROUTES VISUALLY
View all stops on an interactive map with color-coded pins. Distinguish deliveries from pickups, see your optimized sequence, and understand your route at a glance.
WHO USES UPPER?
- Independent delivery drivers and owner-operators
- Amazon DSP and Flex drivers 
- FedEx Ground and Express contractors
- Courier and messenger services
- Food and flower delivery
- Pharmacy and medical delivery
- Field service technicians
- Sales representatives with territory routes
- Real estate agents showing multiple properties
- Any professional running multi-stop routes
THE NUMBERS THAT MATTER
Drivers using Upper report saving 1-2 hours daily, reducing miles driven by 20-40%, and completing more stops per shift. Less driving means lower fuel costs, less vehicle wear, and more time with your family.
TRY UPPER FREE
Start your 3-day free trial on monthly plans. No commitment — cancel anytime. See how much time you save on your very first route.
---
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
Upper offers monthly and annual subscription options. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at purchase confirmation.
For billing and subscription support: https://support.apple.com/billing
LINKS
Privacy Policy: https://faq.upperinc.com/main/articles/1600838500117-privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://faq.upperinc.com/main/articles/1600838360756-terms-of-use
Questions? Contact support@upperinc.com

bluejetty:00082443:ios.description:
Get the latest Tennessee lottery results within minutes of the draws taking place. This easy-to-use app includes the following lotteries:
- Powerball (including Double Play)
- Mega Millions
- Powerball Xs & Os
- Lotto America
- Millionaire For Life
- Tennessee Jackpot
- Tennessee Cash
- Cash 3 (Morning, Midday and Evening)
- Cash 4 (Morning, Midday and Evening)
Powerball, Mega Millions, Powerball Xs & Os, Lotto America, Millionaire For Life, Tennessee Jackpot and Tennessee Cash also include a full breakdown displaying the number of winners and amount paid out for each prize level.
The following features are also included:
Ticket Checker
----------------------------
Enter and save your chosen numbers to see if you have won or to see how often they have come up in the past. You can also label your tickets – great if you play multiple lines or if you run a syndicate. The ticket checker also highlights prizes won on each ticket as well as calculating the total for each lottery. Only play lotteries on certain days of the week? Not a problem, you can exclude your checked tickets from draws you do not play.
Customizable Notifications
----------------------------
Get notified instantly when the latest lottery results and prize breakdowns become available. The App allows you to customise notifications for specific lottery games and you can also choose which days of the week you play. Want to know when the jackpot has rolled over or has reached a certain amount? Just head to the Notification section of the app to set up your alerts. There is also the option to set notifications at times that suit you - great for reminding you to purchase tickets before the draw.
Random Number Generator
-----------------------------
Stuck for numbers? Use this handy tool and let the app choose your numbers rather than having to rely on house numbers and anniversary dates!
Results Archive
----------------------------
Access to the full archive of results dating back to the first draw of each lottery.
Settings
----------------------------
Customise which lotteries display in the app and in which order.
Support
----------------------------
If you have any feedback or suggestions on how we can improve this app, please get in touch at contact@lottery.net.

bluejetty:00014175:ios.description:
The eCollection eReader app is part of a brand new platform that re-imagines guided reading for iPads. Guided reading is a widely used teaching strategy where the teacher and all students in a group have a copy of the same book. The teacher assists the students to practise various reading strategies in order to comprehend the text. The eCollection eReader app allows teachers and students to use eCollection eBooks for guided reading. It utilises native iOS gestures to provide a seamless experience for young readers.
~~~~~~~~~~
FEATURES
~~~~~~~~~~
300 pedagogically sound, carefully levelled eCollection eBooks combined with the following features:
+ Guided Reading Profile
+ Custom Reading Profile
+ Independent Reading Profile
+ Tap to Hear Words
+ Tap to Save Words
+ Record Mode
+ Draw Mode
+ Edit Text Mode
+ Reading Sessions
+ Student Profiles
+ Reading History
+ Reading Groups
~~~~~~~~~~~
REVIEWS
~~~~~~~~~~~
"A great way to access a very thorough levelled reading resource. It is compact and accessible."
"I am working with older students and adults. It is a fantastic way for them to access material that they can read without making it obvious that they are reading at a low level."
"I love having access to the eCollection readers digitally. I have used them throughout my 30+ years teaching"
"Easy for kids, parents, teachers to use, convenient, wide range of books/levels, great graphics and wonderful app. Great resource for setting readers for home or school."
"eCollection has made a difference in the learning for our target children."
"A highly engaging digital reading resource directly linked to school reading."
"Books are expensive and this is a cheaper option. No lost or damaged books."
~~~~~~~~~~
SUPPORT
~~~~~~~~~~
Send us an email at anz.techsupport@cengage.com with any questions, feedback or requests.

bluejetty:00144675:ios.name: Myzone | Make movement count
bluejetty:00144675:ios.summary:
Get in the zone and make it count, with a social platform and gamification to keep you feeling good, inside and out.
Join an inclusive community fuelled by physical activity, fitness and wellbeing with the heart rate monitor that rewards e
bluejetty:00144675:ios.description:
Get in the zone and make it count, with a social platform and gamification to keep you feeling good, inside and out.
Join an inclusive community fuelled by physical activity, fitness and wellbeing with the heart rate monitor that rewards effort over ability. Or build your own community among your family, friends, and classmates.
At the heart of over 7500 gym chains in over 80 countries, Myzone is a unique wearable fitness brand that rewards effort rather than ability. It's the secret to motivating anyone to feel good about exercise.
The Myzone app uses inclusive, game-based mechanics and social elements to prove time and time again that we're stronger together. When combined with a Myzone heart rate monitor, the app creates personalised zones, based on your maximum heart rate, which means anyone can compete together on a level playing field.
What is Myzone?
▶ FEEL GOOD INSIDE AND OUT
Myzone develops accurate wearable technology, providing engaging and motivational experiences that support lifestyle changes to make exercise habits stick. 
▶ JOIN THE COMMUNITY OR BUILD YOUR OWN
Myzone is used by 1.8 million people around the world at home, outdoors and in our partner gyms such as Snap Fitness, LA Fitness, Bannatyne Health Club, Fitness First, Anytime Fitness, and UFC GYM.
▶ USE IT YOUR WAY
Myzone connects through analogue, ANT+ and Bluetooth with gym equipment, and Apple Watch. Myzone integrates with Apple Health to save your workout data and biometrics such as weight, BMI, and BMR. It also integrates with third-party apps such as MapMyRun, Strava, and MyFitnessPal.
Myzone integrates with many other platforms, including Apple Health. If you grant permission, we will save your activity calories, height, weight, BMI, BMR and body fat data to Apple Health.
▶ THE MOST ACCURATE TRACKERS 
Myzone heart rate monitors let you know the exact level that you're working out at, in real time. The heart rate monitoring system features electrocardiography (ECG) measurement that's accurate up to 99.4%, as used by health professionals. The MZ-Switch combines an ECG sensor with a photoplethysmography (PPG) sensor to create the world's first interchangeable heart rate monitor for the gym, outdoors or in water.
▶ LEVEL THE PLAYING FIELD
Myzone rewards effort over ability. Each device automatically updates how it records your effort, every time you progress through your goals. The five tailored effort zones make heart rate training easy to understand. Each zone is a percentage of your maximum heart rate, meaning that athletes and fitness newbies can exercise together to earn MEPs (Myzone Effort Points). 
▶ WORLD-CLASS WORKOUTS
Myzone means you can take part in live classes with real studio buzz, wherever you are. Exclusive to the Myzone app, MZ-Remote is the world's first virtual live group workout where participants can connect and exercise together, while receiving real-time biometric feedback and personalised coaching from a trainer.
▶ LOVED BY THE EXPERTS
Myzone has been featured and reviewed by international journalists from publications such as Men's Fitness, Men's Health, Women's Health, The Huffington Post, GQ, T3, Wired and Esquire for over 10 years.
For more information on how you can join the Myzone community visit www.myzone.org

View up-to-date locations and time predictions for the SF Muni buses.

LIVE MAP
Get up-to-date bus positions showing exactly where each bus is along its route.

PUSH NOTIFICATIONS
Get real-time updates regarding delays, closures, and other important messages.

FAVORITE STOPS
Add stops you use often to your Favorites for quick, easy access.

NEARBY STOPS
See stops nearest to your current location, as well as how far they are.

SET REMINDERS
Easily set reminder notifications so you don't forget to catch your bus when it arrives.

NOTIFICATION CENTER WIDGETS
2 Notification Center widgets for easy access to time predictions for nearby stops as well as your favorites.

APPLE WATCH + IPAD
Optimized for iOS 17, iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch.

If you run into any issues or have any feedback, use the in-app Support button or email support@iminichrispy.com. You can also tweet me @iMinichrispy.

bluejetty:00171751:ios.description:
The long anticipated sequel to the award-winning Shop Heroes title is here!
Freshly graduated from the prestigious shopkeeping academy, you’ve received an invitation from your uncle’s old friend, Jacque. Your uncle has mysteriously vanished, leaving his once-legendary shop in ruins. Now, it’s up to you to restore its former glory and reclaim its status as the most renowned shop across the lands. Do you have the wit, grit, and business savvy to go from zero to hero?
Immerse yourself in an Idle Simulation Tycoon RPG like no other! Expand your empire by running a profitable item shop, crafting legendary equipment for your customers, and commanding mighty heroes on epic quests to gather rare artifacts and blueprints. Challenge elite shopkeepers, rise through the ranks, and prove yourself as the ultimate shopkeeping legend!
What are you waiting for? Join millions of players worldwide in Shop Legends—where every sale, every hero, and every crafted masterpiece brings you closer to glory. Prepare yourself for endless adventure as Aragonia awaits your awakening!
~~~~~~~~~
BECOME A MASTER SHOPKEEPER
~~~~~~~~~
◆ CUSTOMIZE & DESIGN your dream item shop with endless layouts and decorations
◆ CRAFT & FUSE legendary gear to attract VIP customers and grow your reputation
◆ TRADE with other shopkeepers worldwide to expand your fame and fortune
◆ PERSONALIZE your shopkeeper to showcase your unique styles and flair
~~~~~~~~~
EMBARK ON AN EPIC RPG ADVENTURE
~~~~~~~~~
◆ RECRUIT & EQUIP mighty heroes, each with their own unique abilities
◆ COLLECT & LOOT epic loot across time-limited dungeons and themed events
◆ TEAM UP with your friends or make new ones to form a thriving alliance
◆ BATTLE fearsome bosses and slay titans together to prove your strength
~~~~~~~~
SUPPORT
~~~~~~~~
Experiencing any issues? Got some suggestions? We would love to hear from you! You can reach us at support@cloudcade.com for immediate assistance. Connect with our growing community on Discord: https://discord.gg/5q9dbYHMbG
A persistent network connection is required to play.
PLEASE NOTE! Shop Legends is completely free to play, but you can purchase some game items with real money. If you don’t want to use this feature, you can disable in-app purchases in your device’s settings.
~~~~~~~~
TERMS & PRIVACY
~~~~~~~~
Terms of Service: http://cloudcade.com/terms-of-service/
Privacy Policy: http://cloudcade.com/privacy-policy/
~~~~~~~~
FOLLOW US
~~~~~~~~
Facebook: http://facebook.com/shopheroes
Official Website: http://shopheroes.com

bluejetty:00186786:ios.name: Color by Numbers - Flowers
bluejetty:00186786:ios.summary:
Painting by Numbers is a fun coloring game for your children. 
If your child likes flowers, this coloring game is made for them. Beautiful flowers make them feel the joys of spring, and the painting process turns into an enthralling game wh
bluejetty:00186786:ios.description:
Painting by Numbers is a fun coloring game for your children. 
If your child likes flowers, this coloring game is made for them. Beautiful flowers make them feel the joys of spring, and the painting process turns into an enthralling game where they can bring their fantasies to life and draw a red daffodil, or a blue sunflower. 
Benefits: 
◦ Teaching children simple arithmetic. Addition and subtraction
◦ Coloring by geometrical figures and pictograms
◦ Coloring by letters
◦ Very simple program interface that any child can master 
◦ Easy-to-use palette that allows you to put together your own unique set of colors
◦ High-quality drawings of all pictures 
◦ Visual effects and sound effects 
◦ Pleasing background music 
◦ Colored pictures automatically saved on closing the program
◦ And many other useful features that make coloring entertaining
Paint by numbers - an interactive coloring book for children. This mathematical game teaches children to recognize numbers and solve simple mathematical examples. In addition, this program develops memory, attention, imagination, and logical abilities.
Boys and girls of all ages love to color. The simple coloring mode is suitable for the smallest of children, including those of kindergarten and preschool age. These include simple and recognizable images that are easy to color. If the child selects the wrong shape, then they will be prompted with the correct number. Therefore, the picture will always be colored correctly, and the child will quickly memorize the numbers. Children can choose to color by geometrical figures and pictograms in addition to numbers. A child can easily distinguish a square from a circle, diamond, and triangle.
School-age children will enjoy the complex coloring mode. Here the picture is divided into a large number of elements, thus making it difficult at first to determine what it depicts. Older children can complicate the task by adding addition and subtraction tasks. Now children will need to solve the examples and choose the correct answers in order to color the picture. This will teach the child how to quickly do arithmetic in their mind.
Those who are learning the alphabet can choose to color by letter. Coloring by letters will be useful for children preparing to enter primary school.
To make the coloring process more interesting and fun, you can change any of the preset colors. To do this, press and hold the jar of paint and a palette will open. Then you can choose your favorite color. Thus, all the shaded areas of the image can be changed in the coloring by number mode. You can have fun by changing the color scheme to suit your taste. Try the program right now!

bluejetty:00169363:ios.summary:
RocketTunnel: The Eco-Conscious VPN Built for Unmatched Efficiency
Meet RocketTunnel, the environmentally-friendly VPN that merges high performance with minimal battery consumption. Our mission is to reduce carbon footprints across the glo
bluejetty:00169363:ios.description:
RocketTunnel: The Eco-Conscious VPN Built for Unmatched Efficiency
Meet RocketTunnel, the environmentally-friendly VPN that merges high performance with minimal battery consumption. Our mission is to reduce carbon footprints across the globe by ensuring that every line of code is optimized for maximum efficiency. Whether you’re streaming, browsing, or gaming, RocketTunnel has you covered—without draining your device or the planet’s resources.
Lean and Powerful Native Architecture
---------------------------------------
At RocketTunnel’s core lies a modern, proprietary TCP/IP implementation. By using pure, native C code—free from bulky high-level SDKs—we’ve achieved a binary size of just a few megabytes, significantly smaller than many mainstream VPN apps. This streamlined approach delivers a fast, secure connection while extending your device’s battery life.
Security & Supported Protocols
--------------------------------
Your privacy is our top priority. That’s why RocketTunnel is built upon customized OpenSSH and OpenSSL libraries, ensuring robust encryption without sacrificing performance. We support the following protocols for versatile and secure tunneling:
● SSH – Establish a direct tunnel to a remote SSH server, ensuring private, authenticated data transfer.
● SSH-XTLS – Add an extra layer of encryption by connecting through a TLS-secured channel.
● SOCKS-XTLS – Create a secure tunnel to a remote SOCKS5 proxy server via TLS, guaranteeing privacy and data integrity.
● XTLS – Mimic a modern browser’s fingerprint (TLS with fingerprint mimicry) to circumvent highly restricted networks, ensuring your connection remains undetected by advanced firewalls.
RocketTunnel also features secure public-key authentication for SSH, bolstering your defenses against unauthorized access.
Advanced Features & Customization
------------------------------------
Go beyond basic VPN usage with RocketTunnel’s comprehensive feature set designed for power users and casual users alike:
• BadVPN UDPGW for VoIP and Gaming – Enhance real-time communications and gaming performance.
• DNS-over-TCP Resolution – Maintain domain resolution capability even when UDPGW server is unavailable.
• Smart Domain Resolution – RocketTunnel queries multiple DNS servers to efficiently resolve hostnames, even if your ISP’s DNS is unresponsive.
• Route Domestic Traffic Directly – Exclude domestic traffic from the tunnel for optimal routing and lower latency.
• Per-Configuration Advanced Settings – Customize and override settings for UDP, QUIC, DNS strategy, and more.
• Public SSH Banner Display – View server-specific SSH banner messages for important announcements.
• Comprehensive Logs – Export logs in SQLite format and filter them by specific modules for in-depth troubleshooting and analysis.
Accessibility & Commitment
----------------------------
We believe that secure, eco-friendly VPN technology should be accessible to everyone:
• Broad iOS Compatibility – Supports iOS 12 and above, so you don’t need the latest hardware to stay protected.
• Completely Free & Ad-Free – No subscription fees, no intrusive ads—your online safety shouldn’t come with hidden costs.
• Planet-Friendly Mission – By continuously refining our native code, we minimize energy usage on devices worldwide, taking an active role in global sustainability
Join the Green VPN Revolution
-------------------------------
Enjoy secure, fast, and efficient connections with RocketTunnel—where your privacy, your battery life, and our planet’s well-being all come first. Download RocketTunnel today and discover a new standard in eco-conscious VPN technology.
