bluejetty:00033469:ios.description:
Introducing "SoberAI: AI Sobriety Sponsor" the groundbreaking app that revolutionizes the journey to sobriety and offers personalized support for anyone looking to manage their alcohol consumption. Whether you're navigating the challenges of recovery or simply seeking assistance to moderate your drinking habits, SoberAI: AI Sobriety Sponsor provides an innovative solution that fits right in your pocket. 
At the heart of SoberAI: AI Sobriety Sponsor lies cutting-edge AI technology, designed to understand and adapt to your unique needs and preferences. This app isn't just about tracking your sober days or reminding you to avoid alcohol; it's about offering genuine, tailored support that resonates with your personal journey.
Select Your AI Sponsor: Understanding that every individual's path to recovery is distinct, SoberAI: AI Sobriety Sponsor offers a diverse array of AI Sponsors to choose from. Each AI Sponsor comes with its own set of characteristics, methods, and areas of expertise, allowing you to select the one that aligns best with your goals, personality, and preferred approach to sobriety. Whether you need a compassionate listener, a strict motivator, or a knowledgeable guide through the 12 steps, your perfect AI Sponsor is waiting for you.
Tailored Support and Interaction: Engage in meaningful, real-time conversations with your AI Sponsor anytime, anywhere. These interactions are designed to provide support, advice, and encouragement tailored to your current state of mind and specific circumstances. The app utilizes advanced AI to learn from your conversations, enabling your AI Sponsor to grow more attuned to your needs over time.
Privacy and Anonymity: Your journey is personal, and privacy is our top priority. SoberAI: AI Sobriety Sponsor ensures that all interactions and data are securely protected, offering you a safe space to express yourself freely without fear of judgment or exposure.
A Community at Your Fingertips: While the journey can sometimes feel lonely, it doesn't have to be. SoberAI: AI Sobriety Sponsorconnects you to a broader community of individuals who share similar goals and challenges. Share stories, exchange advice, or simply find comfort in knowing you're not alone, all within a supportive and understanding environment.
Features at a Glance:
A wide selection of AI Sponsors, each with unique characteristics and approaches.
Personalized, real-time interactions with your AI Sponsor.
A supportive community of individuals on similar paths.
Complete privacy and protection of your personal data.
Insights and progress tracking to celebrate your milestones.
Whether you're deeply committed to sobriety or just beginning to contemplate change, SoberAI: AI Sobriety Sponsor is here to support you every step of the way. Embrace the power of AI and embark on a transformative journey towards a healthier, happier life. Download SoberAI: AI Sobriety Sponsor today and discover the perfect partner in your pursuit of sobriety.
Privacy Policy: https://aa-sponsor.com/privacy.html
Terms of Use: https://aa-sponsor.com/terms.html

bluejetty:00153581:ios.description:
Ai Teleprompter – AI Script Generator & Video Recorder App!
The Teleprompter App is your ultimate mobile companion for creating professional AI-generated scripts and recording high-quality videos effortlessly. Whether you're delivering a speech, presenting a business proposal, or recording content for social media, this app combines powerful AI script generation with seamless teleprompter functionality to elevate your content creation process.
Key Features:
1. AI-Powered Script Generator:
Create high-quality scripts tailored to any occasion with ease. Simply enter the title or name of your content, select your preferred style, and let the AI generate a custom script.
How It Works:
- Choose the tone of your speech (e.g., informative, political, debate, entertaining, inspirational, keynote, etc.).
- Pick a topic that matches your content (e.g., public speaking, video production, business presentations, podcasting, screenplay & dialogue, etc.).
- Alternatively, you can use the manual script option to write or paste your own script and start recording right away.
2. Customizable Teleprompter:
Adjust the font size, scrolling speed, and text layout to suit your reading comfort during video recordings.
3. Seamless Scrolling:
The teleprompter scrolls smoothly, allowing you to focus on delivering your lines naturally without distraction.
4. Video Recording Mode:
Once your script is ready, start recording your video instantly while the teleprompter stays visible, ensuring a smooth and confident presentation.
5. Offline Mode:
Prepare, practice, and refine your script even when you’re offline—perfect for on-the-go content creation.
6. Platform-Specific Formats:
Choose from formats optimized for popular platforms like YouTube Shorts, Facebook, Instagram, Snapchat, and more, ensuring your videos are perfectly suited for each audience.
Whether you're a content creator, business professional, educator, or speaker, the Teleprompter App is the all-in-one solution to generate AI scripts and record flawless videos, helping you take your presentations and content creation to the next level with ease.
Privacy Policy: https://teleprompter.posterapplab.com/privacy-policy/
Terms of Use: https://teleprompter.posterapplab.com/terms-conditions/
Download now and start creating with confidence!

bluejetty:00183595:ios.description:
SPEDN is shutting down on March 31, 2026. It’s been an incredible journey, but it’s time to say good-bye.
Please visit our website at spedn.io to withdraw your funds and learn more about what the shutdown of the SPEDN app means for you.
-----
Unleash your electronic cash—instantly—with just one tap and no fees. Powered by Flexa, SPEDN makes it possible to spend Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies without needing to cash out to US dollars or load a plastic card. Instead, just take your phone into any store that accepts Flexa, tap the brand where you’d like to spend your cryptocurrency, and scan your unique flexcode for payment.
LOAD
Tap the asset you want to load into the SPEDN app, and then reveal a unique deposit address in order to easily load the balance of your choice from any other cryptocurrency exchange service.
TAP
When you’re ready to spend, just open SPEDN, tap the name of the Flexa-accepting store where you’d like to use your cryptocurrency, and reveal your flexcode for instant payment at point-of-sale.
PAY
Finally, have your cashier scan the dynamic flexcode that appears on screen. In seconds, your cryptocurrency balance is converted into dollars, covering all or part of your purchase, and your transaction is complete.
SPEDN currently supports Bitcoin (BTC), Ether (ETH), Litecoin (LTC), Bitcoin Cash (BCH), Celo native asset (CELO), Dogecoin (DOGE), the Gemini dollar (GUSD), and Zcash (ZEC), with many more coins coming soon.

Unleash your electronic cash—instantly—with just one tap and no fees. Powered by Flexa, SPEDN makes it possible to spend Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies without needing to cash out to US dollars or load a plastic card. Instead, just take your phone into any store that accepts Flexa, tap the brand where you’d like to spend your cryptocurrency, and scan your unique flexcode for payment.

LOAD
Tap the asset you want to load into the SPEDN app, and then reveal a unique deposit address in order to easily load the balance of your choice from any other cryptocurrency exchange service.

TAP
When you’re ready to spend, just open SPEDN, tap the name of the Flexa-accepting store where you’d like to use your cryptocurrency, and reveal your flexcode for instant payment at point-of-sale.

PAY
Finally, have your cashier scan the dynamic flexcode that appears on screen. In seconds, your cryptocurrency balance is converted into dollars, covering all or part of your purchase, and your transaction is complete.

Forecast That Follows Your Trip
Weather and navigation combined to provide a route forecast precisely at the time you will be driving through. It's the best weather app you can have on the road. 
Features and benefits:
• Know What's Ahead Before You Get There — See exact weather at every point along your route at the time you'll actually be there
• Leave at the Right Time — Adjust your departure up to 7 days out and instantly find the safest, clearest weather window
• Choose the Smartest Route — Compare alternative routes side by side and take the one with the best conditions
• Never Be Caught Off Guard by Rain or Snow — Live Doppler radar shows real-time precipitation moving toward your route
• Get the Full Picture, Not Just the Temperature — Wind speed, gusts, UV index, visibility, and weather warnings all in one view
• Live Traffic Cameras Along Your Route — View real-time DOT camera feeds along your drive and see exactly what road conditions look like before you get there.
• Plan Multi-Stop Trips With Confidence — Add waypoints and stop durations so your forecast stays accurate across every leg of the journey
• Stay Focused on the Road — Full Apple CarPlay support delivers hands-free weather updates on your dashboard
• Avoid Driving Into Blinding Sun — Sunrise and sunset times are plotted right on your route timeline so you're never caught off guard
• Your Data Stays Yours — No ads, no tracking, no location stored. Just clean, accurate forecasting across 70+ countries
Free & Pro Plans
Free: 
Download and start using Weather on the Way at no cost. Core route forecasting features are included so you can get a feel for the app before committing.
Pro Monthly or Yearly:
Unlock the full power of the app including alternative route comparison, flexible departure time planning and all advanced weather layers. The yearly plan includes a free one-week trial so you can try Pro risk-free.
One-Time Purchase:
Not a fan of subscriptions? A lifetime purchase option is also available, giving you permanent access to all Pro features with a single payment.
Weather on the Way runs on iPhones with iOS 15 and newer.
Strict commitment to user privacy - both the app and our website collects NO personal information. We do not collect your location or chosen driving route.

Whether it's for vlogs, tutorials, or entertainment content, Thumbnail Maker is crafted to magnify your video's appeal.

Whether you're a lifestyle vlogger, a gaming commentator, or an educational content producer, Thumbnail Maker offers the tools to align with your video's theme and vibe. From gaming and tech to beauty and travel, discover the ideal template or forge your design that echoes with your channel’s essence.
Unleash Your Creativity
Thumbnail Maker is your platform for artistic expression. Play with a broad array of fonts, graphics, and effects to construct a YouTube thumbnail that genuinely mirrors your video. Our intuitive design instruments ensure precision and simplicity, letting you concentrate on the creative journey.
Inspiration Meets Customization
Looking for inspiration? Explore our library of professional templates specially designed for YouTube thumbnails. Personalize them to match your video content and brand identity. With Thumbnail Maker, you're not just selecting a design; you're creating a visual hook for your videos.
Easy Access and Professional Support
Download Thumbnail Maker Pro for free and begin crafting your YouTube thumbnails without hassle. For any suggestions or inquiries, our team of dedicated designers is only an email away at apps@contractsq.com.

Choose from weekly, monthly, or annual billing.

Visit our terms of use at https://www.thumbnailmaker.app/terms and privacy policy at https://www.thumbnailmaker.app/privacy.

Angel Tarot Cards by Radleigh Valentine is the first deck of tarot cards that is 100 percent gentle, safe, and trustworthy!
All of the words and artwork are positive and beautiful, while still retaining the magical effectiveness of traditional tarot. Rich with symbolism and imagery-including angels, archangels, unicorns, fairies, and mermaids-the Angel Tarot Cards will provide you with inspiring guidance on your life journey!

FEATURES:
- Give readings anywhere, anytime
- Choose between different types of readings
- Save your readings to review at any time
- Email readings to friends
- Browse the entire deck of cards
- Flip cards over to read each card's meaning
- Get the most out of your deck with the guidebook
About the Author
Best-selling author Radleigh Valentine has inspired audiences around the world with his angelic messages of pure love and unconditional support. Imagine having an encouraging guardian angel or fairy “godbrother” whispering in your ear, helping you realize your purpose as a child of the Divine. He’s written multiple oracle and tarot card decks, including the best-selling Angel Tarot Cards. His books How to Be Your Own Genie and Compendium of Magical Things offer insightful, exhilarating lessons about how to manifest the life of your dreams and find your own unique language for communicating with the Divine.

bluejetty:00046489:ios.description:
Stay in touch with your loved ones abroad at really cheap international rates with the Localphone app.
1 5G READY
–––––––––––––
Get high-definition voice quality with the next generation of mobile Internet. Compatible with the latest 5G (LTE) technology, our app is optimized to be location-aware and will intelligently moderate the quality of your call to ensure you get the best possible connection available to you.
2 SAVE ON INTERNATIONAL CALLS
–––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––---
Use your iPhone to talk to your friends and family in over 250 countries at a fraction of the cost of your mobile provider.
3 TWO CALLING MODES
––––––––––––––––––––---
Use WiFi mode when you have a good Internet connection, or use LOCAL calls mode to dial a normal, local-rate number that connects internationally.
4 FREE CALLS & FREE CREDIT
–––––––––––––––––––––––––––-
All new Localphone customers get a 5 minute free call to try us out. If you don’t already have a Localphone account, just install the app and create an account on our website. Once you have an account, come back to the application and you’ll be able to make a 5-minute free call.
You will also earn free credit every time you share the app with your friends, and there's no limit to how much you can earn.
5 YOU CAN DO ALL THIS
–––––––––––––––––––––---
* Use WiFi mode when you are roaming to save money on expensive calls back home
* View your existing Localphone contacts on your iPhone and make cheap international calls in just one click
* View your call history
* Look-up our worldwide call rates and get a price in seconds
* Check your real-time balance and see exactly how much credit you have
* Call your existing iPhone contacts through the Localphone app and save a fortune
6 OUR RATES
–––––––––––--
Our international call rates are some of the lowest in the world. Now it’s even easier to access them by using this app.
United States from 0.1¢ per min
United Kingdom from 0.6¢ per min
Canada from 0.3¢ per min
Australia from 1.5¢ per min
India from 1.5¢ per min
Pakistan from 3.5¢ per min
Visit www.localphone.com/prices for more countries.
Please note calls made using local numbers may incur charges from your operator, but depending on your call plan these calls may be free as part of your inclusive minutes. When no WiFi signal is found in WiFi mode your data connection will be used. To avoid charges from your operator only use this mode if you have a good WiFi connection or a data allowance.
Local Number calls are currently available in these countries:
Algeria, Argentina, Australia, Austria, Belgium, Brazil, Bulgaria, Canada, Chile, China, Colombia, Costa Rica, Croatia, Cyprus, Czech Republic, Denmark, El Salvador, Estonia, Finland, France, Georgia, Germany, Greece, Hong Kong, Hungary, Ireland, Israel, Italy, Latvia, Lithuania, Malta, Mexico, Netherlands, New Zealand, Norway, Panama, Peru, Poland, Portugal, Puerto Rico, Romania, Russia, Singapore, Slovakia, Slovenia, South Africa, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, Thailand, Turkey, Ukraine, United Kingdom, United States, Venezuela.

bluejetty:00128467:ios.description:
Welcome to the adventure and action-packed story of Archer Attack.
Archer Attack will give you an exciting archer experience with its unique graphics and designs. In this game, you will be the hero and you will be able to direct the bowman the way you want. The decisions will be entirely yours, you will destroy the targets step by step and achieve victory.
Looking for bowman games and shooting games to play? Let’s have this combat and neutralize the enemy in this longbow 3d assassin world. Shoot all the targets and become the master of the archer games.
You will experience various conflict areas and scenarios, such as the capture of a military base by militants. Sometimes you will crawl on the ground, sometimes you will aim from behind the bushes, hold your breath and shoot your arrow. And in the end you will win.
You will find yourself in a wonderful adventure of war games, gun games and battlefield games. As you level up in the game, the targets will become mobile and the game will become more and more difficult. But as you keep leveling up, you can rank up in combat games! 
Archer Attack 3D was specially made for longbow gamer enthusiasts. Archer Attack 3D is a bowman game full of adventure and fun, made to please you with its special and impressive level designs.
Enjoy Archer Attack 3D committed to the action!

bluejetty:00024255:ios.description:
- Mirror your phone screen to your TV with Chromecast!
- Watch your Photos & Videos, Browse the web, Cast your app to a TV...
HOW DOES IT WORK:
- Download the app
- Choose which cast device to Connect to
- Start mirroring and watch the stream from your phone screen to the TV
- To stop mirroring, there are two options: (1) click on the red top bar/button that you will see on your iPhone or iPad. Or (2) Open the app and click on 'Stop Mirroring'.
FEATURES:
- Easy to setup: the app will identify available devices on your network. Just choose which one the app connects to
- Portrait/Landscape: the app will automatically switch between portrait or landscape orientation depending on availability and compatibility
COMPATIBILITY:
The app is compatible with:
- All versions of Google ChromeCast (1st, 2nd, 3rd generation and Ultra 4K)
- Every device or TV with Chromecast built-in: Xiaomi MI Box, NVIDIA Shield TV, Sony, TCL, Vizio, Sharp, Philips, Hisense, Skyworth, Soniq... Check https://www.google.com/chromecast/built-in/ for more information.
- Gaming consoles
- All versions of Fire TV
NOTES:
- WiFi Network: Your iPhone/iPad and your Chromecast must be connected to the same wifi to enable screen mirroring
- Privacy: Even though there are notifications about Screen Recording, we do access any recording you make. It is only streamed to your Chromecast device.
- DRM Restriction: Be aware that some Apps do not allow the screen to be captured (like Amazon Prime or Netflix). So the TV screen will be black. 
DISCLAIMER:
Chromecast is a trademarks of Google LLC. The app is not affiliated with Google or any other trademark mentioned. This is for informational purposes only intended for the user.
Fire TV is a trademark of Amazon. This app is not affiliated with Amazon or any other trademark mentioned. This is for informational purposes only intended for the user.
SUBSCRIPTIONS:
You can subscribe to upgrade to Premium features
- Subscriptions length: weekly, yearly
- Your payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
- To Manage or Cancel your subscription, it can be done via the Settings app of your device: Open the Settings app, Tap your name, Tap Subscriptions, Tap the subscription, Tap Cancel Subscription. You might need to scroll down to find the Cancel Subscription button. If there is no Cancel button or you see an expiration message in red text, the subscription is already canceled. For more detail, see https://support.apple.com/en-us/118428 .
- To Manage or Cancel your subscription, it can also be done directly from the app: Go to ‘Settings’ screen inside our app, tap on ‘Manage Subscriptions’ and the app will directly open the list of your Subscriptions with the AppStore. You can select a subscription and check available plans or cancel subscription.
- When canceling a subscription, your subscription will remain active until the end of the period. Auto-renewal will be disabled but the current subscription will not be refunded.
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable

bluejetty:00070435:ios.description:
【新用户福利】：注册即可领取一节新思维试听课！
 火花新思维以AI时代学习能力发展需求为导向，通过可视化、结构化与迁移式学习方式，帮助孩子从“学知识”走向“会思考、会表达、会解决问题”，构建面向未来的儿童思维能力培养体系。
 关于火花思维
 火花思维团队由一群多年从事儿童启蒙研究的团队及互联网技术人员组成，我们运用儿童关键期，儿童心理学，儿童认知等理论，对标国内外思维培养经验，匠心研发了一套符合孩子认知的培养体系及方法。专注培养孩子的思维能力与习惯。让成长更快乐是火花思维不变的追求。
 火花新思维的特点
 以逻辑问题、科学与工程问题为载体，综合三大知识模块（逻辑关系、建模分析、益智策略）配合历史文化、趣味故事、思维游戏和特色学具，让孩子系统的提升逻辑分析能力、空间想象能力、动手操作能力、迁移应用能力等12种核心能力的思维方法的培养体系。
 -通过小班直播方式关注到每个孩子；
 -通过”动态分层“让孩子保持“够一够就能”的状态；
 -通过可视化，将抽象思维过程转化为可视化路径，使学习从“理解结果”走向“理解过程”。
 -构建“学习—练习—反馈—优化”的系统化学习闭环，通过连续性训练推动能力持续稳定提升。
 -通过递进式启发路径，引导孩子主动探索问题本质，而非直接获取答案。
 综合素养：
 「火花编程」：打造阶梯少儿编程课程，从图形化编程平滑过渡到 Python。
 通过AI + 真人双师教学，趣味闯关式学习，贴合新课标要求，专属辅导答疑，练创结合，高效培养逻辑思维与创新创造能力。
「火花中文」：以积累文化素养为基础，培养语言应用能力和人文思想洞察能力，让孩子从容地完成演讲与辩论的课程体系。
 聚焦阅读写作，深耕文史经典——让孩子读写能力同步跃升，核心素养扎实养成，腹有诗书、爱读善思、开口能说、提笔会写。

bluejetty:00044072:ios.name: Termix: SSH Client & Terminal
bluejetty:00044072:ios.summary:
Termix is a modern SSH client and terminal developed by a European team of cybersecurity experts. It offers an unrivaled SSH and SFTP experience that enhances your productivity without compromising your privacy.
With zero ads and a strict
bluejetty:00044072:ios.description:
Termix is a modern SSH client and terminal developed by a European team of cybersecurity experts. It offers an unrivaled SSH and SFTP experience that enhances your productivity without compromising your privacy.
With zero ads and a strict no-data-collection policy, Termix uses the most secure open-source libraries to keep your connections safe.
Key Features:
Ultimate SSH & SFTP Client:
Termix delivers a robust, desktop-grade terminal experience across all Apple devices.
Advanced File Manager & Code Editor:
Inspired by WinSCP, our fully featured file manager lets you download, upload, manage, and edit files, directories, and permissions effortlessly. It also includes a rich code editor with syntax highlighting that supports over 40 programming languages.
Native Gestures & Keyboard Shortcuts:
Navigate like a pro with native touch gestures and hardware keyboard shortcuts, enabling fast navigation, multiline command editing, and precise text selection. Termix feels just like a regular text editor with all the perks you need for efficient terminal work.
Multi-Session & Customization:
Work in parallel with seamless split-screen support, advanced key management (including generation and uploading), and a fully customizable interface with themes tailored for power users.
Serverless Security:
Termix works completely serverless. All your hosts, private keys, and passwords are stored in encrypted form on Apple iCloud and never leave your device. This design guarantees that your sensitive data remains exclusively under your control.
Enhanced Automation:
Boost your workflow with startup snippets, execute commands across multiple hosts simultaneously, and configure environment variables with ease.
Modern Apple-Native Design:
Experience a clean, smooth, and beautifully modern interface designed exclusively for Apple products.
Developer & Sysadmin Focused:
Built for developers and loved by system administrators, Termix includes features such as command history, regex search, and snippet support to save hours of time and increase productivity.
With Termix Pro, you can also:
- Upload and edit files using the File Manager.
- Create startup snippets.
- Execute snippets on multiple hosts simultaneously.
- Import custom fonts.
- Manage and configure environment variables. 
- Choose an alternative icon for Termix.
Discover the most powerful, secure, and feature-rich SSH and SFTP client made for those who demand quality. Get Termix today and transform your remote management experience!

King Weather is to forecast weather up to 24 hours and next 15 days forecast.
The weather forecast is one of the best weather application on AppStore for you.
Weather forecast, which has accurate weather information for anytime and everywhere.
Report immediately local weather forecast & real time rain, storm, ice & snow ...
With weather information, you can prepare your plan carefully, you will be successful at work and have better life. The application is very helpful with everybody.
There are many information in weather forecast which includes weather condition, atmospheric pressure, relative humidity, visibility distance, precipitation in different unites, dew point, wind speed and direction, in addition to ten days future forecast, also hourly weather forecast.
Real-time temperature, rain, snow, humidity, pressure, wind force and wind direction are all in this weather application based.
FEATURES:
- All is free, weekly, daily, hourly update with real time.
- Weather forecast for global, for all country: United States (US), Canada, Brazil, United Kingdom (UK), Sweden, Denmark, Italy, Germany, France, Portugal, Spain, Mexico, Finland, Norway , Russia, India, Japan, Korea, China, Australia, Vietnam, ...

- Search and manage multiple locations
- Supported notification
- Weather description: Sunrise Time, Sunset Time, Humidity, Precipitation Probability, Visibility, Wind Speed...
- Real time weather maps & weather radar animations with your personal blizzard & hurricane tracker: Rain, snow, clouds, wind, temperature, Humidity, wave, pressure, current.

- Top weather can display all languages over the world

bluejetty:00023229:ios.name: Idle SWAT Academy Tycoon
bluejetty:00023229:ios.summary:
Train up the most elite SWAT team in the entire world! This isn’t your normal police squad. Invest in your academy and soon your recruits will be ready for the toughest dispatch missions!
Earn cash and gold to spend on more training areas.
bluejetty:00023229:ios.description:
Train up the most elite SWAT team in the entire world! This isn’t your normal police squad. Invest in your academy and soon your recruits will be ready for the toughest dispatch missions!
Earn cash and gold to spend on more training areas. Idle your time away while your recruits work and train. Become a rich SWAT tycoon billionaire while building up your base of operations!
There are several training areas where your recruits need to train to get ready for action. They include:
Breach Training - knock down doors and get ready for action
Firearms Training - get down to the shooting range and perfect your aim
Obstacle Course - you’ve got to be fit to be be the best
Close Quarter Combat Training - sometimes you’re going to have to face up
Canine Training - Police dogs are your best friend, so let their nose do the work
Tech Training - It’s the 21st century, so get robot and drone tech to help solve the crime
Shoot House - the classic hostage situation training - storm buildings or planes, clear rooms and find the enemy
Bomb Squad - a steady hand is needed here to defuse bombs and save. The day
Rappel Training - you’ve got to be able to quickly get down ropes to access windows and elevator shafts
Car Pursuit - hone your driving skills so you’re ready for the craziest getaway drivers on the road
Car Ramming - sometimes you’re going to have to take the enemy off the road
Sniper Training - a steady arm and a deep breath to take out the baddies at long distance
Unlock different missions depending on how you build your academy. Have they taken hostages? Send in the negotiator squad! Drugs found? Time for the canine unit! They’re trying to escape? Get your crack car pursuit officers on the job! You’re the sheriff in this town!
This isn’t your normal Police Academy training centre. No, this is for the elite SWAT teams, training to protect the people with the toughest training. There will be no time to idle about here!
So are you ready to train your recruits to be the finest SWAT men and women to protect the people? Earn money to upgrade all your areas and become a tycoon with millions and billions of dollars to invest back into your academy. Keep the streets safe with the best training facilities for your academy. It’s what tycoons do to keep our people safe! Don’t idle officer…get to work now!

bluejetty:00167676:ios.name: Idle Hero TD Tower Defense RPG
bluejetty:00167676:ios.summary:
* ENJOY WEEKLY UPDATES WITH TONS OF NEW CONTENT!
If you're a fan of classic old-school tower defense strategy games or endless idle games where you deal impossibly large numbers of damage, then you will LOVE Idle Hero TD! Assemble a team of
bluejetty:00167676:ios.description:
* ENJOY WEEKLY UPDATES WITH TONS OF NEW CONTENT!
If you're a fan of classic old-school tower defense strategy games or endless idle games where you deal impossibly large numbers of damage, then you will LOVE Idle Hero TD! Assemble a team of powerful heroes, build an unstoppable defense, and battle endless waves of monsters while you grow stronger - even while offline. Whether you love idle games, deep RPG progression, or tactical tower defense challenges, Idle Hero TD has it all. 
* IDLE TD PROGRESSION
No time to grind? No problem! Idle Hero TD keeps working while you’re away. Collect offline rewards, resources, and loot every time you return. With idle mechanics, your heroes never stop fighting - even when the game is closed. With simple auto-battle mechanics, your heroes fight for you, making every session rewarding whether you play actively or passively.
* BUILD & UPGRADE
Level up heroes, unlock new abilities, and upgrade towers to deal massive damage. Collect gold, resources, and loot from every wave to strengthen your team. Invest in long-term progression with upgrades that make your heroes stronger every run, unlocking powerful strategies for endless defense.
* DOZENS OF UNIQUE HEROES
Unlock 48 unique heroes, all of which have different skill sets that make tower synergy crucial to success. Experiment with team combinations to create the perfect defense. None of them ever become obsolete, as ranking them up unlocks new mechanics that makes even the early-game heroes extremely useful in the end-game. Determining the most effective combination of their skills and synergies will keep you entertained and speculating for weeks! Discovering how to use each hero is part of the fun.
* MILLIONS OF UPGRADES
Collect a wide variety of resources to unlock millions of powerful upgrades, including Research, Prestige Power, Spells, Technology, Runes, Tournament Points, Mastery Points, and much more!
* ENDLESS CHALLENGES
Battle Ultra Bosses and Immortal Bosses, climb the ranks in PvP Tournaments and leaderboards, team up with other players on Weekly Community Challenges, and conquer several different maps, each with different perks and requiring different strategies to defend. Find the one that suits your current goals best, and conquer its challenges! The longer you play, the more powerful and rewarding your defense becomes.
* KEY FEATURES:
- Idle tower defense with auto battle mechanics.
- Simple to start, but deep strategy to master.
- Idle offline resource gains and progress while the game is closed.
- Hero upgrades and tower progression for long-term growth.
- Weekly PvP Tournaments, Boss Challenges, and Leaderboards give this casual game a competitive edge. 
- Weekly Community events.
- Countless daily missions, achievements, and challenges. 
- Fantasy RPG heroes and skills.
- Fun, cute, and colorful artwork.
Whether you’re a fan of idle games, tower defense games, or strategic fantasy RPGs, Idle Hero TD delivers the perfect mix of relaxing progression and tactical depth. Defend your kingdom, grow your team of heroes, and see how far your strategy can take you.
Download Idle Hero TD today and join the battle in the ultimate idle tower defense RPG!"

bluejetty:00117715:ios.description:
تطبيق إرواء يوفر لك خدمة توصيل كراتين مياه إرواء و الثلاجات و منتجات مياه متنوعة لمصلين المساجد بجميع مدن المملكة العربية السعودية بكل سهولة و آمان ويمكنك طلبها لمنزلك أيضا من خلال 3 خطوات بسيطة: 1- اختر موقع المسجد/منزلك الذي تريده. 2- اختر كمية الماء المطلوبة. 3- أرسل طلبك. وبعد إتمام توصيل الطلب بإمكانك الإطلاع على صور توثيق التوصيل من خلال التطبيق وذلك لضمان جودة الخدمة المقدمة لعملائنا الكرام.
Erwaa is an online platform and smartphone application with the aim of enabling individuals interested in contributing to providing water to mosques easily and confidently in KSA. In addition to facilitating water delivery to mosques, this versatile app also enables users to conveniently deliver water to homes. You can request drinking water for any mosque or home of your choice through three simple steps: 1. Select Mosque / Home 2. Choose the Quantity 3. Submit your request. 
The Erwaa application facilitates water delivery to mosques and homes in all cities across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, including Riyadh, Mecca, Medina, Jeddah, Al Khobar, Dhahran, Abha, Khamis Mushait, and more. 
With Erwaa, individuals have access to a variety of drinking water brands, including the private Erwaa water brand.

bluejetty:00185338:ios.description:
Selected by Facebook as one of BEST MOBILE GAMES
Invasion: Modern Empire is an online war-themed MMO game that challenges you to conquer and battle your way to world domination in the midst of a global apocalypse. 
Prepare yourself for stunning 3D graphics and exhilarating, real-time MMO battles! Join the fight online and partner with a clan to spread your influence.Join the fight and find out now! 
Invasion: Modern Empire Features:
Visceral real-time strategy combat meets MMORPG mechanics
• Clash with enemies as your army sweeps across the world
• In Invasion, you are the commander! Guide your army in real time
• Incredible 3D graphics and MMO combat will give you a whole new perspective on war, as each tank and soldier obeys your every command
Clash with enemies to expand your clan’s territory and earn resources!
• Train a vast army and battle for territory across a stunning 3D world map!
• Invade enemy territory and win wars to expand your empire!
• Acquire resources by defeating enemies and claiming their empire as your own
Use advanced war strategy to collect intel and seize the upper hand
• Collect intelligence on your enemies in this futuristic shadow war, and launch devastating strikes against your opponent’s weak spot!
• Lead your army from a real-time panoramic map to get the upper hand! 
Join and alliance and conquer crucial "monuments" in online games!
• Make your alliance the star of the military world. Clash in massive online wars to gain the upper hand.
• Forge strategic alliances to defeat your rivals, and experience the constant surprise of online real-time combat!
• Fight in huge Monument Wars against powerful alliances around globe! Winners will become kings in this online battlefield
Cinematic 3D presentation and action-packed military battles
• Construct a formidable military empire and watch as you crush enemies in 3D
• Build and train a range of elite modern war forces, from tanks to cannons to gunships
• Unlock powerful hi-tech military units with research. Battle enemies from land to air with tanks, soldiers and more
Take up arms in the post-apocalyptic warzone of the year 2020!! Governments have fallen and cities have been reduced to ash, as rival armies clash for domination in the chaotic new age. Only you and your star units can conquer the world’s greatest monuments, build the strongest army, and rebuild this once-great world.
The Invasion has begun!

bluejetty:00015991:ios.name: Armor Age: Tank Wars
bluejetty:00015991:ios.summary:
Armor Age is a tactical RTS set in the world of 20th century tank battles. Take command of a squad of war machines and lead it through a whole row of battle operations!
Fight in campaign and survival modes. Level up your tanks and their cr
bluejetty:00015991:ios.description:
Armor Age is a tactical RTS set in the world of 20th century tank battles. Take command of a squad of war machines and lead it through a whole row of battle operations!
Fight in campaign and survival modes. Level up your tanks and their crews and get blueprints for new technologies.
Choose up to five tanks for your squad from a large number of real-world combat vehicles, each having its own role on the battlefield!
Your personal hangar can fit a squad suitable for any tactical and playing style. Challenge other players to PvP battles to try out your tactical ideas and shine as a commander.
Features:
- Realistic and straightforward controls;
- Real time battles with tactical pause mode;
- Historically accurate combat vehicles from various countries;
- A variety of tactical situations and missions.
The game supports the following languages:
English, German, Spanish, Russian, Ukranian, Korean, Chinese (Simplified) and Chinese (Traditional).
_____________________________________
Subscription terms
Officers Club offers a subscription for a month ($19,99).
No free trial period provided.
The prices are set for US customers.
Pricing in other countries may vary and actual charges may be converted to your local currency.
Upon purchase of the subscription, you will get:
- 50% more silver in all Supply Crates;
- Access to Career rewards;
- Tanks repair time reduced by 50%;
- Access to unique Officers Club portraits.
All subcriptions are auto-renewable.
We charge your iTunes account right after a purchase confirmation.
Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. 
Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of current period.
Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings on the device.
An unused part of a free trial period will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription.
See the links below for more details.
Cancelling the subscription
https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039
Our Privacy Policy
http://www.herocraft.com/privacy/
Our Terms of Service
http://www.herocraft.com/terms/
Support email: support@herocraft.com

QUICKVIEW
ACCOUNT DETAILS
BILL PAYMENTS
REMOTE DEPOSIT*
SCHEDULED TRANSACTIONS
TRANSFERS

MESSAGES
ATM LOCATOR
FINANCIAL CALCULATORS

Bank securely and with confidence. Our mobile banking app uses the same high level of security as our online banking. For information on security, please see our security section on our website.

bluejetty:00161946:ios.description:
Alodokter, Menjawab Semua Kebutuhan Kesehatanmu
Penuhi semua kebutuhan kesehatan hanya dalam super app no. 1 di Indonesia, Alodokter.
Mulai dari Chat Bersama Dokter, Buat Janji Konsultasi, Artikel Kesehatan, Perlindungan Kesehatan Terlengkap, serta Diskon Belanja di Apotek Century dan Apotek Generik bisa kamu dapatkan di Alodokter. Tak ada alasan lagi untuk tidak download aplikasi Alodokter.
Sejak didirikan pada tahun 2014, Alodokter hadir sebagai platform kesehatan yang membantu masyarakat Indonesia dalam menentukan keputusan terbaik terkait kesehatan. Terbukti dengan lebih dari 20 juta pengguna aktif mengakses Alodokter setiap bulannya.
Saatnya kamu mengenal 5 fitur utama Alodokter:
1. Chat Bersama Dokter
Konsultasikan masalah kesehatanmu di aplikasi Alodokter. Lebih dari 20rb Dokter umum, spesialis, dan psikolog berpengalaman siap menjawab pertanyaanmu.
Dokter yang bertugas di Alodokter telah tersertifikasi sehingga dijamin terpercaya. Dapatkan pula jawaban yang akurat dan berkualitas dengan respons cepat, kurang dari 2 menit.
2. Artikel Kesehatan Terlengkap
Jelajahi artikel kesehatan dengan beragam topik yang disajikan dalam Bahasa Indonesia yang mudah dipahami. Setiap artikel disusun dari sumber yang terpercaya dan disunting bertahap oleh tim dokter dan editor bahasa.
3. Buat Janji Konsultasi
Jadwalkan konsultasi dengan dokter pilihan berpengalaman di lebih dari 1.500 rumah sakit dan klinik yang tersebar di Indonesia. Dapatkan kepastian jadwal dokter dan estimasi biaya untuk kebutuhan konsultasi dengan mudah dan cepat.
4. Perlindungan Kesehatan Tambahan dengan Proteksi Alodokter
Lengkapi perlindungan kesehatanmu dan keluarga dengan Proteksi Alodokter, yang lengkap, simpel dan terjangkau.
5. Alodokter Shop
Kini, belanja kebutuhan kesehatan jadi lebih aman dan praktis. Dapatkan promo ongkir dan pengiriman cepat dalam 1 jam
Izin Aplikasi
App ini memerlukan izinmu untuk mengakses: lokasi, nomor ponsel, email, dan akun Facebookmu.

bluejetty:00061776:ios.name: Travel Logs - Vehicle Logbook
bluejetty:00061776:ios.summary: Travel Logs is your intelligent vehicle logbook. Track trips, mileage, expenses, maintenance, and vehicle records in one easy-to-use app. Whether you drive for work, manage business travel, maintain a fleet, or simply want better records fo
bluejetty:00061776:ios.description:
Travel Logs is your intelligent vehicle logbook. Track trips, mileage, expenses, maintenance, and vehicle records in one easy-to-use app. Whether you drive for work, manage business travel, maintain a fleet, or simply want better records for your vehicle, Travel Logs helps you stay organised with less manual effort. With smart automation, flexible reports, and powerful fleet features, Travel Logs makes vehicle record keeping easier, safer, and more accurate.
Intelligence built-in
Travel Logs Intelligence helps you choose your next activity, checks trips for details that may need attention, suggests trip purposes and types, and reads receipts or maintenance invoices. Intelligence feature is local and on-device only, privacy focused first.
Automatic Trip Tracking
Start trips manually with a tap, or let Travel Logs help track them automatically.
Travel Logs supports smart trip automation using:
- Bluetooth device connection
- NFC tags
- Vehicle motion detection
- Places and geofencing
- CarPlay support
Set up the tracking method that works best for you and reduce the chance of missed trips.
Travel Logs helps you record:
Trip start and end locations
Odometer readings
Vehicle expenses
Maintenance and service records
Places That Work for You
Create Places for locations you visit often, such as home, work, client sites, depots, or regular stops. Travel Logs can use Places to help automatically start or end trips when you arrive or depart, making location-aware tracking simple and convenient.
Reports Ready When You Need Them
Preview and export clear vehicle reports in PDF or CSV format. Travel Logs reports are designed to support ATO-compliant record keeping, helping Australian drivers keep organised records for tax time, work claims, business use, or personal review.
Built for CarPlay
Travel Logs includes a built-in CarPlay app, giving you a safer way to start and stop trips while on the road. Manage your logbook without needing to pick up your phone.
Manage Expenses and Maintenance
Travel Logs is more than a mileage tracker. Record vehicle expenses such as fuel, tolls, parking, insurance, registration, repairs, and servicing. Keep maintenance records in one place so you can see what has been done and stay on top of your vehicle history.
Travel Logs Fleets
Travel Logs Fleets helps teams collect, review, discuss, approve, reject, and report on submitted vehicle records. Drivers can keep private logs and only submit the records they choose to share with a fleet. Drivers can also belong to multiple fleets, making it easy to manage records across different teams or businesses. Shared vehicle support allows your drivers to share vehicles.
KEY FEATURES
- ATO Compliant
- CarPlay Support.
- Cloud sync with web portal.
- Rate based estimates. Estimate reimbursement amounts with distance-based rates per vehicle.
- Bluetooth hands-free support for auto start/stop.
- Location aware for auto start/stop.
- NFC tag support.
- Multiple Vehicles.
- Contacts integration.
- Exporting of log reports in CSV & PDF format.
- Location auto-fill and distance calculation.
- Import calendar entries to use as trip purpose.
- Route recording and exporting (GPX file).
- Vehicle expense tracking.
- Vehicle maintenance/service logs.
- Fleets (Shared vehicles, fleet reports, audit logs and more)
Why Use Travel Logs?
- Reduce manual logbook entry
- Avoid missed trips
- Track vehicle costs
- Keep maintenance history organised
- Export PDF and CSV reports
- Prepare clearer records for tax time
- Manage fleet submissions and approvals
- Use CarPlay for safer trip control
Perfect For
- Sole traders
- Contractors
- Small businesses
- Employees tracking work-related travel
- Fleet teams
- Drivers managing multiple vehicles
- Anyone who wants better vehicle records
Note: Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.
Privacy Policy - http://travellogs.app/privacy.html
Terms of Use - http://travellogs.app/terms.html

bluejetty:00166893:ios.summary: Boo is back and now in 3D! Meet the cutest virtual pet to take care of and have fun. Meet his neighbors, play adventure games, and remember to take care of your virtual friend every day. Play FREE* My Boo 2 and enjoy all the fun with your p
bluejetty:00166893:ios.description:
Boo is back and now in 3D! Meet the cutest virtual pet to take care of and have fun. Meet his neighbors, play adventure games, and remember to take care of your virtual friend every day. Play FREE* My Boo 2 and enjoy all the fun with your pet in various adventures!
Meet the cutest pet with new features! Boo is back, and you can join the fun with adventure games, meet other Boos, and explore a world of games with your virtual friend. Enjoy the dog, cat, rabbit, and other animal skins, all to make your buddy happy. With My Boo 2, you will find a 3D world of many adventures and virtual friends for limitless fun.
Download My Boo 2 now and make your pet happy!
VIRTUAL PET GAME
Boo is the best animal companion you can have fun with! There are adventure games and a great neighborhood with virtual friends. The more you interact with your pet, the happier he gets and the more coins you earn to unlock new features. Enjoy fun games with your best friend!
ANIMAL COSTUMES
You can customize your Boo in many ways. There are options of clothes and skins of puppies, kittens, rabbits, and other virtual animals. Everything to make your game even more fun and your pet happy. Remember to play every day, complete the daily missions, and take care of Boo to get more items for your adventure game!
EXPLORE THE 3D BOO WORLD
Explore a 3D world of many adventures with your buddy! Meet your neighbors and make new virtual friends. In addition to meeting other Boo species, you can complete daily quests and missions to earn rewards, unlock new areas, clothes, and items for your pet. Discover funny adventures with your virtual pet.
*My Boo 2 is a free offline virtual pet game. However, there are additional features and extra items that can be purchased through the store.

bluejetty:00068537:ios.description:
Who are unable to speak, This application will give you a voice. Sounds interesting?
Yes, There are many patients who cannot speak because of throat related diseases.
Like,
Speech Impaired / Mute
Aphasia 
Multiple Sclerosis (MS)
Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS)
Parkinson’s Disease
Alzheimer’s Disease and Related Dementia etc.
Here is the application, You just need to type once and it will speak anytime!
You also can change language, Speech rate, volume etc. All features are described below:
Features:
1. Type and Speak - Text To Speech Option
2. Change Speech Rate, Pitch, Volume, Language
3. Save text and use it later
4. History Manager
5. No need to type overtime
6. Some common words, just press to speech
7. Available in your language (English, French, Spanish, Hindi, Russian, Chinese-Traditional, German, Japanese))
8. Image To Text Feature added - Take a photo with camera and this app will identify the text from taken photo and speak for you.
USE POLICY:
You can use this app as an entertainment purpose / for need / Personal. You can use this for commercial purpose even. To use commercial purpose you only need to notify developer via email once. Our intention is only to give a voice to speechless people. Let me know if you have any query / Suggestions:
droidoworld@gmail.com

bluejetty:00078006:ios.description:
Learn Kalimba fast with numbers. Learn Kalimba with numbers offline.
What are the origins of the Kalimba?
The origins of the kalimba can be found in Africa where this instrument would have been invented twice: about 3000 years ago on the west coast towards Cameroon, as an instrument completely in wood with bamboo, rattan or palm blades, and there is about 1300 years old in the Zambezi where we find traces of it with keylimba metal strips.
Kalimba is the name given by the ethnomusicologist Hugh Tracey in the 1950s when he began to introduce in the West this musical instrument of African origin, called mbira by the Shonas ethnic group of Zimbabwe. The mbira is an emblematic instrument of the Shonas culture. This instrument has several names depending on the geographical area where it is used: likembe, sanza or senza in Cameroon and Congo, mbira in Zimbabwe and Malawi, lukeme, karimba in Uganda … The Europeans called it thumb keylimba or finger piano but It is under the name of kalimba that we now designate all the thumb pianos that are not traditional in Africa. Mbira keylimba remains the generic name used for traditional African thumb pianos.
Kalimba number. Learn Kalimba fast. learn Kalimba fast with numbers.
You don´t need to learn the music theory! You follow a brilliant number system that we developed and thanks to it you can play famous songs immediately. Learn Kalimba with numbers - Learn Kalimba fast is for anyone looking to learn the Kalimba from scratch or those who have prior knowledge and want to continue learning by practicing playing along with their favorite songs. The app is ideal to improve your memory, coordination, concentration, peripheral vision and last but not least fast reaction and sharp eye.
Listen to the rhythm of the Kalimba classic songs and learn how to play it:
Jingle bells Christmas song
Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star
Mary Had a Little Lamb
Row Row Row Your Boat
Features of Learn Kalimba faster with numbers.
• Learn Kalimba from scratch.
• 100% free, reliable, and fast.
• A highly user-friendly approach.
• Kalimba learning like never before with an easy interface, full keys, and more.
Transform yourself into a Kalimba master with this Kalimba everyone app.

bluejetty:00064764:ios.description:
Crypto Pro is the #1 privacy-focused, ad-free crypto tracker on the App Store since 2015.
Stay ahead in the cryptocurrency world with a comprehensive and intuitive experience.
Crypto Pro offers real-time data, portfolio tracking, and market insights for both seasoned traders and beginners.
Powerful Portfolio Tracker:
• Support for all publicly traded cryptocurrencies, precious metals and fiat currencies.
• Real-time data from renowned exchanges such as Coinbase, Binance, Kraken, and more.
• Automatic import of data using wallet addresses or exchange API keys.
• Detailed profit / loss gains and other portfolio metrics.
Full Privacy:
• No user monitoring or analytics for absolute privacy.
• Store all personal data on your device, not ours.
• Secure local key storage using Apple keychain.
• Optional secure backup/sync via iCloud.
No Ads:
• No distractions, pop-ups or 3rd party data sharing.
• Extra layer of privacy assurance.
Optimized for the Apple Ecosystem:
• Seamlessly switch between iPhone, iPad, Mac or Apple Watch.
• Swift native app crafted for best performance and efficiency.
• User-friendly design that Apple users love and recognize.
• Dark and Light mode with optional automatic switching.
• Face ID, Touch ID, or passcode locking for your data.
• Dynamic font size and other accessibility features.
• Haptic Touch for intuitive menus and previews.
• Localized into 45 languages.
• Siri and HomePod shortcuts.
Customizable Widgets:
• Display prices, charts, news and portfolios.
• Customizable theme, size and refresh.
• Exclusive widget for Mac menu bar.
• Home screen placement support.
Apple Watch:
• Customizable complications for every watch face.
• Display your favorites, prices and charts.
• Currency conversion calculator.
• QR code wallet requests.
Never Miss a Beat:
• Powerful news aggregation with a section for each cryptocurrency.
• Customizable price notifications with charts (on long press).
• Optional breaking news alerts and more.
Transparent Pricing:
Crypto Pro offers a FREE and ad-free experience for every crypto enthusiast. For users seeking advanced features like detailed candlestick graphs and automatic portfolio synchronization, we offer a premium subscription. This subscription comes with a 7-day free trial. Additionally, you can unlock these premium features for free by simply inviting friends.
The cost of the premium subscription may differ based on your country or region. Subscriptions will renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. If not canceled, your account will be charged for renewal within the final 24 hours of the current period. Manage your subscription and adjust auto-renewal settings via your App Store account.
Terms of service: https://www.cryptopro.app/terms
Privacy policy: https://www.cryptopro.app/privacy
Stay informed, stay secure, and dive deep into the crypto realm with Crypto Pro.

listings.description:
NassWallet - Digital Banking for the New Era.

SERVICES

- Add Cash & Make Withdrawals
- Money Transfer
- Western Union
- eVoucher
- Mobile Top-Up
- Pay with a QR Code
- Salary Payment


NassWallet is your easy-to-use, secure, and effortlessly efficient mobile app.

You can open an account directly from your mobile device or at your nearest NassWallet branch with only two forms of identification. There is no activation fee, no cash-in fee through agents, and no minimum balance. You can add cash to your account anytime, anywhere.




Your NassWallet balance is equivalent to the same amount of cash you have. You can simply add money or cash it out whenever you want by visiting your nearest NassWallet branch or agent all across Iraq. 

Sending and receiving money internationally is simpler with Western Union through the NassWallet App. Whether you're transferring funds to or from Iraq, NassWallet and Western Union provide a convenient solution with support for various currencies.

NassWallet offers a wide range of eVouchers, you can easily access and explore over 2000 eVouchers. Whether you're looking for an iTunes gift card, PlayStation credits, or Amazon 
eVouchers, we've got you covered.


Stay connected and Top-Up your Korek balance on the go with NassWallet. Never worry about running out of airtime credit again. Enjoy the convenience of instant and hassle-free airtime Top-Ups, ensuring you stay connected whenever you need to. With NassWallet, managing your mobile credit is simple, quick, and convenient.

If you are a business or an institution (small or large), we know how challenging payday can be, and that’s why we have bulk salary payments as a part of NassWallet. You can pay from one to hundreds and thousands of employees at the click of a button, no matter where the receiver is; they will have their NassWallet account credited without needing to travel anywhere to collect the cash in person.


SECURITY

NassWallet is an electronic financial services provider regulated and certified by the Central Bank of Iraq.

bluejetty:00026828:ios.description:
Welcome to Walkie Talkie, the go-to spot for real topic-based audio conversations. Wanna debrief a season finale ? Practice a new language? Or just looking for a late night heart-to-heart?  Walkie Talkie is the place for intentional conversation!
-- How It Works:
1). Choose your vibe: Browse a list of groups categorized by interest (Gaming, TV shows and more).
2). Consent before you join: Check the topic and see who’s already in the conversation before jumping in. You're always in control of where you hang out.
3). Push to Talk: Simple, real-time voice interaction.
-- Keeping It Real (and Safe):
We’re all about good vibes and quality convos. Join a verified community where every account uses secure authentication and where usernames ensure accountability and persistent user identities. Walkie Talkie features comprehensive, user-facing safety tools, including the ability to Block, Mute, and Report users or content instantly. Your experience is protected by a human moderation team and an AI-driven engine that blocks objectionable material before it reaches you.
Your safety and privacy are important for us. Have a concern? Reach our team easily through the in-app "Contact Support" button or via email at support.ios@walkie-talkie.io
Join the conversation. Pick your topic. Push to talk.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://picslocorp.com/policies/privacy-policy/
By using Walkie Talkie, you agree to our Community Guidelines and standard EULA, which strictly prohibit the posting of objectionable content or the harassment of other users.

bluejetty:00178911:ios.name: FastHabit Intermittent Fasting
bluejetty:00178911:ios.summary: FastHabit helps you start and stay consistent with Intermittent Fasting. Set your fast length, log daily, and use advanced features like reminders, weight tracking and Health App syncing, Apple Watch integration, calendar views, data export
bluejetty:00178911:ios.description:
FastHabit helps you start and stay consistent with Intermittent Fasting. Set your fast length, log daily, and use advanced features like reminders, weight tracking and Health App syncing, Apple Watch integration, calendar views, data export, and multi-day fasting to track your progress and accelerate your results.
SIMPLE, FLEXIBLE TRACKING
- Choose how many hours you want to fast
- Keep your motivation in view- See percent complete, time completed, time remaining, and target end.
- Easy editing. Stop, restart, or adjust your fast at any time.
SYNC EVERYWHERE
- Apple Watch integration: Leave your phone at home and still track your fast. 
- Save and transfer your fasts to a new device with iCloud syncing
- FastHabit also integrates with Apple HealthKit. This lets you sync your logged weight in the app automatically to your HealthKit profile. FastHabit also pulls in updated weight data from HealthKit if enabled, to always keep your weight data in sync across the board.
SET REMINDERS AND NOTIFICATIONS
- Choose the days and times you want reminders to start fasting
- Get a notification when your fast is complete
MOTIVATIONAL STATS AND PROGRESS:
- 10 day Snapshot with ‘streaks’ to show how many days in a row you’ve fasted and how many days you’ve met your goals – a great way to stay motivated.
- Calendar and weekly views with daily details
- Weight tracking views with fasting overlay
MORE GREAT FEATURES
- Apple watch complications
- iPhone widget
- Getting started guide
- Enhanced support for longer, multi-day fasts
- Export your data
FastHabit has been featured in GQ, the Guardian, and Fast Company. 
---
FastHabit offers an optional auto-renewing annual Premium Subscription (price varies by territory, may include free trial) located on the Upgrade page. Payments will be charged to your iTunes Account after confirmation. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the subscription period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Subscriptions may be managed in your iTunes Account’s Settings after purchasing. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Privacy Policy: https://fasthabit.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Service: https://fasthabit.com/terms-of-service

bluejetty:00061350:ios.description:
Retrouvez les éditions papier du Figaro et ses magazines dans la nouvelle application Kiosque Figaro, pour iPhone et iPad.
Un accès aux PDF en avant-première :
- Le journal quotidien dès 22h, la veille de sa parution en kiosque
- Les magazines et suppléments, la veille de leur parution : Madame Figaro, Le Figaro Magazine, TV Magazine, F l’art de vivre
- Le Figaro Hors-séries, Le Figaro Santé et le Figaro Histoire du Figaro 
Une expérience intuitive : 
- Feuilletez les pages comme dans la version papier, grâce à l’affichage en mode PDF
- Essayez l’affichage en “mode article” pour un meilleur confort de lecture, et réglez la taille du texte à votre convenance
- Sauvegardez vos journaux et magazines dans l’onglet “Mes éditions”, ils resteront accessibles même hors ligne
Le journal quotidien et les magazines sont disponibles en accès libre pour les abonnés Premium du Figaro.
Profitez pleinement du Kiosque Figaro avec nos offres d'abonnement Figaro Premium :
- 2 abonnements mensuels à 14,99€ et 19,99€, reconductibles automatiquement et sans engagement de durée, pour s'adapter à votre consommation du Figaro et de ses magazines.
- L’abonnement Premium vous donne accès en illimité au site et à l’application Le Figaro - Journal & Magazines pour tous les titres sauf Le Figaro Hors-série. L'abonnement Premium+ donne accès à toutes les publications, y compris au Figaro Hors-série, au Figaro Histoire et au Figaro Santé.
- Pour profiter de votre abonnement sur le site Web du Figaro et nos applications, n’oubliez pas de créer votre compte dans l’application après vous être abonné.
Le montant de l’abonnement est débité sur votre compte iTunes automatiquement à la confirmation de l’abonnement. L’abonnement est automatiquement reconduit sauf si cette option est désactivée dans les vingt-quatre heures précédant la fin de la période en cours. Lors d'un renouvellement, votre compte iTunes sera débité dans les 24 heures précédant l'échéance de la période d'abonnement en cours. L’abonnement et son renouvellement peuvent être gérés en vous rendant sur votre compte dans l’App Store après l’achat.
Plus d'infos sur l'abonnement à cette adresse : http://mentions-legales.lefigaro.fr/page/cgu
Ou achetez des éditions à l’unité : 
- Le journal quotidien à 2,99 €
- Les magazines entre 0,99€ et 1,99€
- Les hors-séries à 6,99€
Bonne lecture dans le Kiosque Figaro !

bluejetty:00138574:ios.description:
Os melhores Esboços de Pregações
Nesta ferramenta, você encontrará vários esboços de pregação.
Aplicativo na que encontrará todo esboços de pregações que ajudarão você a estudar mais em profundidade a Biblia ou a pregar com o exemplo em qualquer momento ou lugar.
Compartilhamos com você alguns esboços de pregação, Estudos Bíblicos e mais conhecimento para enriquecer sua vida e permitir que você lide bem com a palavra de Deus.
O que é Esboço de Pregação ? Como o próprio nome diz, é um sermão que expõe. Mas, expõe exatamente o que? Claro que expõe a Palavra de Deus, mas não precisando necessariamente focar em um número específico de passagens Bíblicas.
O Esboço é como um esqueleto que sustenta um corpo. Quem coloca carne ou conteúdo na mensagem é o pregador. Mas quem dá vida à pregação é o Espírito Santo. Este é um recurso muito útil: usar esquemas elaborados para organizar a fala para pregar eficazmente.
Gostaria de compartilhar com você alguns esboços de Pregações, Estudos Bíblicos, Sermões, Mensagens Biblicas e muitos conhecimentos mais para enriquecer sua vida e capacitá-lo para manejar bem a palavra de Deus.
Grande variedade de esboços para uso em reuniões de célula ou em pequenos grupos, estudos bíblicos, devoções e pregação geral.
Nesta aplicação você encontrará uma variedade de esboços de pregações e diversos textos baseados na Bíblia ao crescimento e à fé cristã.
Esboço de Pregações contém, entre outros:
- Desejando Tudo, Mas Perdendo Tudo
- Satanás e Seus Ardis
- Sete Razões Para Buscar um Avivamento Pessoal
- Crentes Fora do Lugar
- O Perigo Das Dívidas Desnecessárias
- Tendo Comunhão Com Deus
- Sete Leis Bíblicas da Oração
- A História Mais Triste Com o Final Mais Feliz
- Como Vencer os Problemas da Vida?
- Escolhas Que Temos de Fazer
- Um Lugar Chamado Gólgota
- “Entra na Arca...”
- “Vem Conosco...”
- Pouco Com Deus é Muito
- Tirai a Pedra 2
- Cães Vivos e Leões Mortos
- As Janelas do Céu
- Como Desencorajar o Diabo
- Dá-me os Teus Ombros
- Removendo os Lugares Altos
- Confiando no Senhor Completamente
- Saudades da Presença de Deus
- Marche Pela Fé
- Guardando a Palavra
- e máis ...
Alguns estudos bíblicos incluídos:
- O Desafio de ser um discípulo
- Reforço espiritual
- Ao cumprir o dia de pentecostes
- A Razão da Adoração
- Em Espírito e em Verdade
- Não se Trata de Restrição mas de Libertação
- Deus Escolheu Você
- Vivendo os Dias Maus
- Onde Está a Sua Força?
- Não há Evangelho sem Cruz
- Alegria e Paz em Crer
- Amor e seus benefícios
- Que é um Viver Vitorioso?
- Cuidado com a Família
- Quem É Cristo Para Ti?
- Um Pai Amoroso
- O Que Mais Ainda Queremos?
- Você Não Pode Parar
- Para Subir com Cristo
- Excelência da Presente Glória
- e máis ...
Aqui estão alguns devocionais bíblicos:
- Sonda- me senhor!
- Canal aberto com o pai
- Alegria pela manhã
- Agora sei que temes a deus
- Orar ou criticar?
- Senhor, ensina nos a orar!
- Na carne ou no espírito?
- Os sonhos que nos movem
- Enfrentando as tempestadades
- Toque nele pela fé
- A doce presença de deus
- O meu socorro vem do senhor!
O aplicaçao é composto por:
- Esboço de Pregações
- Estudos Bíblicos
- Bíblia João Ferreira Almeida offline
- Lições bíblicas
Esse aplicativo contém esboços bíblicos de pregação, que você pode usar para desenvolver sua pregação cristã.
Navegue através desse arquivo de esboços de pregação, e escolha o esboço de pregação da vida cristã, ou qualquer outro tema de sermão que você deseja pregar, e/ou ensinar.
Esperamos que esta aplicação possa ser uma benção para suas vidas. Queremos que você os aplique à sua vida e ao seu relacionamento com Deus.
Essas mensagens podem ser usadas para pregações, estudos bíblico, reuniões de grupos etc.
Desfrute de estudos bíblicos maravilhosos que o encorajam a se motivar em sua própria vida.
¡ Descarga agora Esboço de Pregações e comece já o seu estudo bíblico !

bluejetty:00146697:ios.description:
William Rodgers had had an unexpected side-effect after an experimental medical trial in college. The power to read minds! He’s kept his ability a secret ever since, but now someone knows the truth, and William is caught in a dangerous game of cat and mouse with a madman calling themselves “The Designer.” Who is The Designer? How do they know about William’s secret power? Most importantly, what do they want?
TRY THE FREE TRIAL VERSION, AND THEN UNLOCK THE COMPLETE ADVENTURE IN THE GAME! 
Explore hidden object scenes inside people’s memories to find the clues, solve the mystery, and bring down the Secret Design in this gripping new Hidden-Object Puzzle Adventure!
Mindframe: The Secret Design includes:
• See if you have the mental fortitude and the detective skills to prevent a catastrophe in the bonus game!
• Never get lost with the strategy guide!
• Replay your favorite HOPs and mini-games.
• Collect special characters and morphing objects throughout the game! 
• Enjoy concept art, screensavers, and music from the game!

bluejetty:00064233:ios.description:

bluejetty:00159377:ios.description:
Stay up-to-date with the latest news and weather in Spokane and the Inland Northwest on the all-new free KREM 2 app. 
Our app features the latest breaking news that impacts you and your family, interactive weather and radar, and live video from our newscasts and local events.
LOCAL & BREAKING NEWS
• Receive real-time notifications for breaking news
• Read the latest news as it happens in your area
• Explore exclusive investigative stories
• Browse photos, news clips, and raw video
LOCAL WEATHER
• Daily and hourly forecasts for your city
• The latest forecasts from our meteorologists
• Interactive radar maps
• Automated hyperlocal severe weather alerts
LIVE VIDEO
• Watch live video newscasts and breaking news from KREM
PERSONALIZATION
• Discover and dive into topics that matter to you
• Favorite topics to receive personalized updates
Other Features:
• Share stories & videos directly with your friends and family
• See the latest updates and behind the scenes photos from your favorite anchors and reporters
• Get information on school delays & closings as they happen
• Cast videos and livestreams directly to your TV or streaming device, so you can lean back and enjoy your favorite programming on your biggest screen.
This is the official app of KREM 2 and KREM.com, the CBS affiliate serving the Spokane and Inland Northwest area.
Got feedback? Let us know how we can make this the best app experience for you! Send us a note at appfeedback@tegna.com.
Privacy Policy: https://www.krem.com/privacy
Do Not Sell My Information: https://www.krem.com/do-not-sell-my-information
Terms of Service: https://www.krem.com/terms

- Daily bonus coins for free hints and Daily Challenge gives you more free bonus coins
- Enhancing your vocabulary. Learn new words and their meanings while playing
- No time limit. Enjoy this word puzzle game at your own pace
- Play Offline or Online: anytime, anywhere

bluejetty:00145301:ios.description:
Inspired by 'VITA' — the Latin word for life — vitamin is crafted with care to help you effortlessly reach personal health goals, transforming nutrition tracking into an enriching and effortless journey to vibrant health.
▶ TRACK — easy nutritional journal, zero hassle
▶ NOTES — create or scan text, add pictures
▶ SYNCS — automatically with your devices
▶ FOODS — verified by the National Institutes of Health
▶ NORMS — dose advice for your age and gender
▶ CREATE — add any new element 
▶ HISTORY — analyze past records
▶ SECURITY — backed up to iCloud
▶ Apple Health? — enabled
▶ Apple Watch? — supported
■ SAFE AND SECURE
Privacy is not something you are merely entitled to, it is an absolute prerequisite. At Martspec, we believe privacy is a fundamental human right. So we built it into our products from the beginning of the design process.
We do not share your data with any 3rd party. We do not use it for advertisement purposes and do not use it for profit. Your data is stored only on your Apple service (Apple Health store and iCloud). We do NOT store your data on our servers.
■ DISCLAIMER
The nutritional information provided in this app is sourced from the U.S. National Institute of Health and the book “Nutrition for Health and Health Care,” 3rd Edition, by E. Whitney. This content is designed strictly for educational purposes and should not replace professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment.
Your use of this application is entirely at your own discretion and risk. The app is made available to you “as is” and “as available,” without any representations or warranties of any kind. While we strive for excellence in our software development, Martspec cannot guarantee that the app will be free from errors or defects.
Martspec expressly disclaims all warranties, whether express or implied, including, but not limited to, implied warranties of merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose, and non-infringement. We do not warrant that the app, or any content provided through it, will always be available, uninterrupted, timely, secure, current, accurate, complete, or error-free.
You acknowledge that your exclusive remedy for any dissatisfaction or issues with the app is to discontinue its use. Martspec shall not be liable for any direct, indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or exemplary damages, including but not limited to, damages for loss of profits, goodwill, use, data, or other intangible losses resulting from the use or inability to use the app.
■ MISSION
At Martspec, we focus on ensuring you can log your data as quickly and easily as possible. Because the easier we make it for you, the more likely you are to stay on track, and the more likely you are to succeed in your health and wellness goals. Making the world a healthier place just got a lot easier.
■ BUILD TOGETHER
We’re a passionate team of enthusiasts building this app with one goal in mind—making daily life easier. This app is built on the shared passion of our team and the invaluable feedback of our users. We’re always looking for ways to improve. Whether it’s a new feature, better wording, or a small tweak that would make a big difference, we want to hear from you! Share your thoughts through the feedback section in the app, and together, we can make this the best app possible. Thank you for being a part of our journey!

bluejetty:00171019:ios.name: Revelation M
bluejetty:00171019:ios.summary: "Revelation M" is fantasy MMORPG with a stunning three-dimensional world where you are free to explore the sky and travel through the sea. Your brightest dreams will come true in the game; there are surprises everywhere, and you can discove
bluejetty:00171019:ios.description:
"Revelation M" is fantasy MMORPG with a stunning three-dimensional world where you are free to explore the sky and travel through the sea. Your brightest dreams will come true in the game; there are surprises everywhere, and you can discover the hidden truth in rich adventures; there are challenges and difficult dungeons that will require all of your skills and courage; you will find an elaborate system of profession development, which will help your character to unlock its potential in the best possible way; new face creating system gives you a wide range of options for selecting details and customization!
This version of Revelation M innovated upon the predecessor PC version with several design and development philosophies:
 A WORLD THAT ANYONE WANTS TO LIVE IN
This world is the result of thousands of hours studying scenic places, referring to thousands of shows, parks, and actual theme parks from our development team. Revelation has vast, vivid sea and sky, where players are completely free to fly through the clouds or dive into the deep sea – yet still feel grounded in reality. This is our effort to elevate the immersive experience for players to fully enjoy the endless, majestic, and overwhelming scenery of Revelation.
BECOME ANYONE, TAKE ON ANY ROLE YOU WANT
"Creating a persona that has the courage to do what I may not" is the value that Revelation wants to encourage our players to embrace. In Revelation, we offer a character creation system that allows you to customize every detail & a deep fashion system with the highest degree of freedom. The quality and perfection of details are outstanding & in-depth, surpassing the standards of the best mobile role-playing games on the current market. All the NPCs are developed with the advanced AI system to strengthen the player’s experience throughout the game.
In addition, the social and job systems are highly invested with the ambition to unleash creativity in players' characters. Become a Musician, Dancer, Designer, Chef, or Vigilante in Revelation to freely express yourself, and build a comprehensive ecosystem with like-minded players. At the end of the day, we hope this feature can become a breakthrough medium for players to advance into a new era in roleplaying games.
EXPLORE THE WORLD TOGETHER
Magnificent sea and sky realms invite you to explore! Transformation, puzzle solving, treasure hunting, making choices...immersive experience across land, sea and air! Hurry to call friends to open the joy of this huge world together!
CHOOSE YOUR APPEARANCE
Face sculpting system, new characters, personalized costumes and innovative customization technology help you to create your ideal type of character. Check out this new ability to make your magical journey in the game even more exciting!
