Join millions of soccer managers worldwide and build your team of eleven soccer stars!
Do you dream of coaching a team of eleven stars hungry to be champions? New, free soccer club sim Top Soccer Manager 2025 puts sports fans like you in c
bluejetty:00182527:ios.description:
Join millions of soccer managers worldwide and build your team of eleven soccer stars!
Do you dream of coaching a team of eleven stars hungry to be champions? New, free soccer club sim Top Soccer Manager 2025 puts sports fans like you in charge! Bid on and scout for top players, build and train a team with special skills, test tactics and formations against real opponents from around the world, and watch the match in live 3D simulation.
BEAUTIFUL GAMEPLAY
Top Soccer Manager's immersive 3D graphics and a powerful game engine bring your coaching fantasy to life. Watch stunning games play out in real time as you command your eleven players or bet on other matches in your league. Every goal is a step further on your journey to victory.
MANAGE & TRAIN YOUR SQUAD
As club head, you will test different formations, adjusting player line-up and tactics during play in response to your opponent. Pick a promising player to groom into a hero with special skills to score in the ultimate showdown. Build a team of champs to climb the leader board.
HUNT FOR STAR PLAYERS
Hunt for players to meet your team’s needs. Bid against other soccer managers to win golden boys in the market, recruit all-stars with an agent, or use scouts to find young hopefuls you can make into tomorrow’s legends. Transfer players who no longer fit your strategy.
RICH MULTIPLAYER EXPERIENCE
Face off against real opponents from around the world in league games. Give your team unique style with officially-authorized jerseys from Premier League, La Liga，Primeira Liga, Bundesliga, MLS. Grow your network of friends, exchange gifts, and grow team experience through friendly matches. Create or join a Soccer Association to gain more rewards.
MONTHLY SUBSCRIPTION
1.Subscription price and period
You can subscribe the Monthly Subscription($4.49) in game which is a more affordable way than the Monthly Pack(Price is determined by region).The subscription period is one month.
2.Subscription content
Players who subscribe the Monthly Subscription will get 30 coins and 30 tokens immediately.During the subscription period players will also get 3 coins and 40 scout points every day through the mailbox in game.
3.About automatic renewal
- All payment operations will be monitored and managed under platform.
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.
4.Unsubscribe process
If you want to unsubscribe in IOS,you can find the unsubscribe way as follows:
“Settings” -> “iTunes & App Store” ->”Apple ID” ->”view Apple ID” ->”Subscriptions”
You can also tap the in game button to find this interface.
The terms of use：https://gamegou.tumblr.com/post/184933799914/monthly-subscription
The privacy policy：https://gamegou.tumblr.com/post/184889866644/gamegou-privacy-policy
For any issues or suggestions please contact us at https://gamegou.helpshift.com

bluejetty:00022380:ios.description:
VIP Games is home to the best international games, including Gin Rummy, Backgammon, Hearts, and many more.
GIN RUMMY RULES
Goal & Setup
• 2 players, standard 52-card deck, Aces are low (A=1).
• Each player gets 10 cards, rest go in a stock pile, top card turned face-up for the discard pile.
Form melds:
• Set = 3–4 cards of the same rank.
• Run = 3+ cards in the same suit in sequence.
• Keep deadwood (unmatched cards) as low as possible
• Cards score: A=1, 2-10 = face value, • J/Q/K=10.
Turn Flow & Ending a Hand
• On your turn: Draw (from stock or discard pile) → Discard one card.
• You may Knock if deadwood ≤ 10 points → discard, reveal hand, opponent can “lay off” onto your melds.
• Go Gin if you have no deadwood → opponent cannot lay off.
• Game ends when someone knocks or goes Gin, then scores are calculated.
Scoring & Winning
• Knocking: score = opponent’s deadwood − your deadwood.
• Gin: score = opponent’s deadwood + 25 bonus.
• Undercut: if opponent’s deadwood ≤ yours when you knock, they score difference + 25 bonus.
• First to 100 (or agreed score) wins the match.
FEATURES
• COMMUNITY – Expand your friend list, like their profiles, and send them gifts
• GLOBAL CHAТ – Discuss interesting topics, exchange tips, and strategies. Delete messages and kick players out of your topic!
• LEADERBOARDS – Follow your progress and climb up the rankings
• MULTI-PLATFORM – Log in from your PC, laptop, and any mobile device
• BONUSES – Come back each day to claim your bonus chips. Enjoy Purchase stamps and level-up bonuses.
• MEET NEW PEOPLE – Get to know players with the same interests as you
• PROFILE GOODIES – Personalize your picture and bio, the border around your picture, the table background, and your card deck.
• VIP STATUS – Gain access to a lot of special benefits
• FAIR MATCHMAKING – Get paired up against players with similar expertise
OTHER GAMES WE HAVE
• Backgammon – A classic two-player board game with checkers, where the goal is to remove them from the board before the opponent does. 
• Rummy – A card game where players form sets of cards, either by grouping cards of the same rank or by creating a sequence of consecutive cards in the same suit.
• Yatzy – One of the most popular dice games in the world. Roll the dice and score the highest amount of points possible!
• Crazy Eights – Enjoy the shedding-type card game Crazy Eights for 2 or more players! The winner is the first player to discard all cards. 
• Four in a Row – A two-player connection game, also known as Connect 4. The first to form a four-long line of checkers horizontally, vertically, or diagonally wins.
• Ludo – Race to the finish, test your luck, and roll the dice in one of the oldest board games! Based on the Indian game Parchisi.
• Domino – A tile-based game with easy-to-learn and more laid-back gameplay. The simple rules make it accessible to all players!
• Schnapsen – A fast-paced two-player card game popular in Central Europe, also known as Sixty-Six. The first to reach 66 points wins!
• Skat – The #1 card game in Germany! Skat is played with 3 players and 32 cards, and is one of the most complicated card games ever!
• Chinchon – A classic Spanish card game, played with two to six players. The goal is to form sets of cards, with the perfect run of seven consecutive cards called "Chinchón".

bluejetty:00140040:ios.description:
Enhance your AI-generated content by converting it into human-like text with Humanize AI - Bypassgpt. In today’s digital landscape, the use of AI tools for content creation has become increasingly common. While these AI-generated outputs are often original and unique, they can easily be flagged as machine-generated by various detection systems. Humanize AI offers a seamless solution to this challenge by converting AI-generated text into natural, human-written content with minimal effort.
By simply pasting your AI-generated content into Humanize AI, you can transform otherwise generic or formulaic outputs into polished, human-like writing with the click of a button. This ensures your content not only reads naturally but also effectively bypasses AI detection systems.
Key Features
Bypass AI Detectors: With the growing prevalence of AI detection tools in both academic and professional settings, ensuring your content remains undetected as machine-generated is crucial. Humanize AI is specifically designed to bypass these systems, making your content indistinguishable from human-written text.
Generate Original, Plagiarism-Free Content: Content processed through Humanize AI retains its originality while ensuring it is plagiarism-free. This makes it ideal for use in academic contexts, such as college and school assignments, as well as for professional documents, blog posts, and other forms of writing where originality is critical.
One-Click Paraphrasing: Humanize AI streamlines the paraphrasing process, allowing you to rephrase AI-generated content with a single click. This feature enables users to quickly transform their text into a more refined and natural form, without compromising on meaning or quality.
By leveraging Humanize AI - Bypassgpt, you can elevate the quality of your AI-generated content, ensuring it reads as if it were written by a human, while also avoiding detection by AI filters. Whether you’re a student, a professional, or a content creator, this tool is designed to meet your needs efficiently and effectively.

Payments deducted from your iTunes account upon confirmation.
Subscriptions renew automatically until deactivated via user account settings.
Account billed no later than 24 hours before the current subscription period ends.
Users can manage subscriptions and disable auto-renewal post-purchase.
No refunds for unused subscription periods.

bluejetty:00178505:ios.name: Dinosaur Master!
bluejetty:00178505:ios.summary:
What was the largest dinosaur? What was the longest? And the fastest?
With Dinosaur Master, kids will discover incredible facts about the most popular dinosaurs of the famous Jurassic Park & Jurassic World films, Camp Cretaceous and Ark: Su
bluejetty:00178505:ios.description:
What was the largest dinosaur? What was the longest? And the fastest?
With Dinosaur Master, kids will discover incredible facts about the most popular dinosaurs of the famous Jurassic Park & Jurassic World films, Camp Cretaceous and Ark: Survival Evolved. Play the game and learn their sizes and lifestyles. Collect more than 100 dinosaurs of all ages (Cretaceous, Jurassic and Triassic), including pterosaurs and other prehistoric animals, as well as more than 365 facts. 
With the minigames, kids can test their knowledge about dinosaur morphology, names, battle and hunting techniques. Fill up all this data in the encyclopedia and create a sort of dino zoo. You can find the most dangerous carnivore dinosaurs, the biggest herbivores and the rarest omnivores. Check facts and updated dinosaur data about all Camp Cretaceous dinosaurs.
Are you already an expert paleontologist? Can you get a 10 out of 10 in our quiz? This dinosaur game for kids is designed for different age groups. Minigames have different difficulties so that kids of all ages can have fun!
Learn how a paleontology expert or an archaeologist discovers new and rare types of dinosaurs from around the world. The game is permanently updated and new dinos are added every month. We will also be adding new Jurassic World 3 Dominion and JW Rebirth dinosaurs when they are announced. This way you can watch the movie and follow the story while learning scientific facts about dinosaur history.
Check the encyclopedia section with hundreds of facts and create your own dinosaur museum collection. It is better than a reference book! You will find illustrations of the greatest dinosaurs like tyrannosaurus, spinosaurus or velociraptor. All our illustrations in the encyclopedia are original and scientifically reconstructed from real dinosaur fossil skeletons. The art of the game is diverse but always tries to depict dinosaurs as the most recent discoveries show them, with feathers, correct anatomy and other known attributes. The periods, such as the Cretaceous or the Triassic, are also reconstructed according to the vegetation and environments typical of the different phases of the Mesozoic.
No wifi or no internet connection? No problem! You can can still play the game offline!
Become a great Philosoraptor with Dinosaur Master!

• Accurate Play Calendars: View real sessi
bluejetty:00036668:ios.description:
Ready to play more pickleball? PlayTime Scheduler makes it easier than ever to organize games, connect with more players, and hit the courts with a plan! Some key features of our platform include:
• Accurate Play Calendars: View real sessions posted by local players—no outdated or auto-generated listings.
• Easy Sign-Up: Join sessions that match your format and skill level with just one tap—no group codes required.
• Custom Notifications: Get instant alerts for new games, session changes, player messages, and more.
• Player Communication: Stay connected with session notes, private and group chats.
• Community Features: Post and browse local questions, photos, videos, announcements, surveys, and self-serve ads.
• Court Maps & Directories: Discover new court locations, vetted and maintained by local admins.
• Cross-Device Compatibility: Seamlessly switch between your desktop, smartphone, and tablet.
Registration is fast, free, and easy. Log in to your home region and explore a weekly calendar with pickleball sessions posted by other local players. Sessions are labeled by time, location, skill level, gender, and format. If you would like to join one, just tap the "Add My Name" button. You can also add notes that other players can read and respond to, and exchange group or private messages.
Can’t find a session that works for you? Post your own in just seconds and connect with players instantly! Just tap the "Add Session" button and fill in the form. Matching players in your region will be notified and have the opportunity to sign up. You'll get a notification when your session reaches the minimum number of players, so you know it's "game on!"
Choose from three levels of access: Free, Premium, and Power User. Premium unlocks a popup ad-free app experience and calendar customization features, while Power User adds a rich suite of advanced scheduling features.
This mobile app improves on the web experience with the following new features:
• Face ID/Touch ID login
• Instant push notifications
• Larger fonts and buttons for easier navigation
• Pop-up ad-free experience (Premium/Power Users only)
• Registration and play reminders (Power Users only)
PlayTime Scheduler - Where Pickleball Lives! Join the community today and take your pickleball experience to the next level!

NID Wallet BD is a multi-purpose application developed under Bangladesh Election Commission. The goal of this application is to make sure the NID-related services are easily available on your phone.
Current features:
- Identity Verification: This feature adds one more layer of security to make sure that no one but you can claim your account from the Bangladesh Election Commission website. In addition to your personal details and verification code, you'll need to use this app to scan your face to verify your identity while claiming your account.
Prerequisite:
*Phone must have a camera to scan the QR code
*Phone must have TrueDepth camera support to scan face
*Internet Connectivity
Important announcement:
To protect your data, we have implemented advanced face detection technology using TrueDepth camera support. Before initiating the face scan, please check if the device model supports the TrueDepth camera. While scanning your face, please follow the on screen instructions.
We're always excited to hear from you! If you have any feedback, questions, or concerns, please email us at:
nidwallet-support@nidw.gov.bd

bluejetty:00016153:ios.summary:

The Cat Scanner app will identify your cat's breed reliably in just a few seconds! Besides taking a picture, you can also record a video or upload an image from your ga
bluejetty:00016153:ios.description:
See a cat, but don't know its breed? Just take a picture and find out!
The Cat Scanner app will identify your cat's breed reliably in just a few seconds! Besides taking a picture, you can also record a video or upload an image from your gallery.
Got a mixed breed?
No problem, the Cat Scanner app also recognizes mixed breeds! We provide you with detailed data and interesting facts about the different breeds of your mixed breed cat.
No cat around?
Doesn’t matter! The Cat Scanner app also recognizes humans: Simply scan yourself, your friends, your family or the people around you and find out which cats you resemble the most!
------
NEW! Become a part of our Cat Scanner community!
Share your results and compare them to the results of the community! Upload pictures of your favorite cat to our Social Feed and share them with other cat lovers! Have a look at the profiles and photos of other users, like and comment on posts from our cat community and filter them by date or popularity!
Additionally, you can easily share your posts with your friends by simply sending a picture directly from the Cat Scanner app.
------
NEW! Catch all cat breeds and become an expert!
Catch all the cat breeds with our Gamification feature – just like in Pokémon Go! Master the challenges, earn virtual treats and become a true cat expert! Compete with your friends or users from the community and climb to the top of our ranking list!
------
All cat breeds in the Cat Scanner app!
The Cat Scanner app currently identifies around 60 different cat breeds, including all breeds officially recognized by the Fédération Internationale Féline (FIFe) and even some more! Our comprehensive database with information and pictures of all cat breeds (including the unofficial ones) can also be accessed completely without scanning!
Give us feedback on the Cat Scanner app!
Let us know if the cat’s breed has been correctly identified. If not, you will get useful tips to improve your own results. If you also indicate which cat breed is in the picture, you help us to enhance our software since the app automatically learns how to provide even more accurate outcomes. Also suggest or vote for (unofficial) cat breeds that you want us to add to the app in the future!
Get your premium upgrade!
With our premium version, the app will no longer show ads and your results will be available faster. Furthermore, you can now choose whether your cat breeds should be recognized rather quickly or with higher accuracy. With the premium version, scanning cats is also possible in offline mode, so you no longer need an active internet connection to identify their breeds. With the optional in-app purchase of our premium version, you will also help to support this app.
------
Find us on social media!
On our social media channels we provide you with the most beautiful cat pictures from the community. You will also find many interesting facts about your favorite pet. Furthermore, we will keep you updated on all new added features of the Cat Scanner app in the future.
* Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/catscanner_app
* Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/CatScanner
* Twitter: https://twitter.com/catscanner_app
------
Just give it a shot!
Cat recognition as easy as it gets! Despite the small app size you will get all features and be able to identify a cat’s breed or get access to our extensive database at any time! Before you consider getting an expensive DNA test, simply scan your cat with the app and the cat breed will automatically be determined within seconds! Download the Cat Scanner app now!
Terms of Service:
https://scanner.siwalusoftware.com/terms-of-service

bluejetty:00179205:ios.description:
Welcome to Nuclear Empire Simulator — a game where you will become an industrial tycoon and start your own business.
To become the richest nuclear tycoon in our clicker and succeed in the energy production industry, follow the economic strategy:
1) The path to wealth begins in the desert. Start your business from mining resources;
2) Earn money by selling resources (uranium, bismuth, cadmium, cesium);
3) Buy new equipment and upgrade it;
4) Explore new territories for energy production. You can build factories in various locations and develop your business.
Our idle tycoon game will immerse you in incredible adventures! You have to fight with a millionaire banker in building the highest tower. With each new built floor, you will receive bonuses (increased resource extraction, discounts on upgrading equipment, etc.). Build a cool skyscraper in our idle clicker that many tycoons will envy.
In addition, you, as a real miner, will be able to excavate in the mine using picks, dynamites and bombs in this stimulation game. Chests with diamonds, ore and holograms are hidden underground. All these things will be useful for the development of your Nuclear Empire.
You will discover an old science center during the game. Here you will need holograms found in the mine and chests, which contain blueprints for unique equipment (cards or suits). Get ready to become a real mining tycoon in this clicking simulator.
Build nuclear power plants, expand territories and upgrade your business!
So, are you ready to start your journey to success in our simulator and become an idle energy tycoon?

bluejetty:00163367:ios.description:
■■ Rock Identifier ° ■■
The ultimate tool for rock, gemstone and mineral identification, built for collectors, healers, and curious minds alike.
- Whether you're a gem collector, jewelry lover, crystal healer, geology student, or just intrigued by a beautiful stone — Rock Identifier ° helps you instantly identify any rock with just a photo. Discover everything about the stones you find: names, colors, properties, and more, all in one powerful app.
- Simply take a picture or upload one from your gallery, and Rock Identifier ° will instantly recognize the rock or mineral with stunning accuracy. From popular crystals like Amethyst and Rose Quartz to rare finds like Alexandrite and Benitoite, unlock deep insights into each discovery.
- All your identifications are automatically saved to your private Gem Collection, helping you track and revisit every stone you've captured.
■ Features
- Identify Rocks Instantly
- Quickly identify rocks and minerals from a single photo. Just point, capture, and discover.
- In-Depth Rock Profiles
Learn detailed information about each stone, including:
• Name & classification
• Color, clarity & origin
• Mohs hardness scale
• Treatments & rarity
• Market value estimate
• Energetic and healing properties
- Ask Anything About Gems
Have questions about meaning, use, or history? Use the built-in rock chat assistant for quick answers and helpful tips.
- Build Your Personal Collection
Each identified stone is automatically saved into your personal My Collection, with its photo and full details for easy access later.
- Optimized for Crystal Enthusiasts and Collectors
Supports identification of raw, polished, carved, and tumbled stones — ideal for hobbyists and professionals alike.
■ Why Choose Rock Identifier °?
- Identify gems in seconds using just your camera
- Perfect for collectors, jewelers, crystal healers, and students
- No need to sort through books or long rock databases
- Elegant, easy-to-use interface
- Accurate, fast, and beautifully organized

bluejetty:00064530:ios.description:
Alliance Community Bank is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with Alliance Community Bank:
-Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
-Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
-Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
-Transfer money between your accounts
-Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
-View and save your monthly statements
-Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the Alliance Community Bank app, you must be enrolled as an Alliance Community Bank Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00161874:ios.description:
BePresent is the #1 app to control your screen time and supercharge your productivity, mental health, and quality of life. Experience life beyond the screen as you reclaim Your Time and earn rewards that improve your life with BePresent!
25 years. That’s the average time you will spend on your phone. 
With a combination of app blocking, gamification, social competition with friends, and real-life rewards, you will reclaim YEARS of your life like thousands of BePresent members already have.
We know you’ve tried to solve this problem before. But we’re not like other screen time apps.
▶ WHAT USERS ARE CELEBRATING ◀
• “I was able to go from 7+ hours per day to less than 2 hours! 10/10 would recommend” - Andrew M.
• “FINALLY an app that actually curbs my screen addiction instead of time limits that I just ignore!” - Gina V.
• “I’ve tried everything but nothing has worked. I almost gave up before I used BePresent! Thank god I tried it as I’ve reduced my screen time by over 3 hours a day!” - Jack W.
Download now to experience life to the fullest.
Instead of annoying app blockers or time limits, BePresent makes it fun and easy to stay off your phone.
▶ FEATURES ◀
[ BePresent App Blocking Sessions - Individual, Group, & BEAST MODE ]
• Dive into Present Sessions! Dedicate breaks from screens, whether it's a focused study session or a no-phone night out. Team up with friends for Group Sessions and joint tech time-outs. Share updates, cheer, and keep one another accountable—all from within the app. Need a stringent break? Enter BEAST MODE, ensuring unwavering commitment
[ Set Daily Goals and Build Your Streak ]
• Choose your digital boundaries. Maintain your streak by sticking to set screen time limits. Back your commitment with a monetary stake — overshoot, and that stake's gone. Customize reminders and design your journey to digital well-being.
[ Compete on Weekly Leaderboards and Challenge Your Friends]
• Show off your productivity prowess by competing against others on weekly leaderboards. Advance tiers so you’ll feel like a productivity superhero every day. Practicing mindful phone habits has never been so motivating and rewarding!
[ Earn Real-Life Rewards ]
• The ultimate motivation - earn points you can redeem for real-life rewards by limiting your screen time. Best of all, your rewards will also improve your life. Learn to meditate with a premium Headspace subscription. Redeem free workout classes with ClassPass. Schedule discounted therapy sessions with BetterHelp. Earn these rewards and more all by staying off your phone.
[ Never Doomscroll Again ]
• Set hourly scrolling awareness reminders so you never lose track of time doomscrolling again
[ Time Tracking & Daily Reports ]
• Measure the moments you're truly present. Access daily and weekly breakdowns, complemented by a comprehensive day-before report, amplifying your adherence to reality.
[ Improve Your Well-Being ]
• By reducing screen time, you'll improve your overall well-being and gain access to educational content that explains how reducing screen time can benefit you in multiple ways. Learn how to manage ADHD better, improve your mental health, and be more present with your loved ones, all while improving your sleep and becoming less distracted.
[ Complete Privacy and Data Security ]
• Data dignity, delivered. All of your data is private and safe with Apple’s Screen Time API. We do not have access to any specific content you access on your iPhone, and none of your personal data ever leaves your device.
▶ WE'RE HERE FOR EVERY QUERY ◀
Questions or feedback? Reach us at https://www.getpresentapp.com/ or shoot an email at contact@getpresentapp.com. Let's journey to mindful tech use together.
Note: All rewards are sponsored by BePresent and our partners. Apple does not sponsor any of the in-app rewards.

The Copart GO App lets Sellers list cars from their own lots in minutes and connects their inventory with Buyers around the world. Create offsite assignments, view your inventory, accept and negotiate pre-auction offers from Buyers and scan VIN numbers to instantly decode and populate vehicle information—all from your mobile device!

Receive push notifications right to your iPhone or iPad instantly whenever a Buyer makes an offer. You can view, accept and negotiate offers on your vehicle(s) instantly within the Copart GO App.

• Save drafts of your vehicle assignment entries so you can complete them later.
• Receive offers within minutes of entering assignments. 
• Review, accept and negotiate offers within the app—all in real time!

bluejetty:00081773:ios.name: 6Siege Official App
bluejetty:00081773:ios.summary:
Your Free 6:Siege - The Board Game APP! 
Operators, this free companion app for 6:Siege - The Board Game is a must-have tool to play the game under optimum operational conditions. More than a glorified yet efficient chess clock, this handy
bluejetty:00081773:ios.description:
Your Free 6:Siege - The Board Game APP! 
Operators, this free companion app for 6:Siege - The Board Game is a must-have tool to play the game under optimum operational conditions. More than a glorified yet efficient chess clock, this handy and immersive app creates instant tension. 
It helps you keep track of the time allotted to a squad, speed settings, and timing effects while enjoying this stimulating board game with sound design and visuals lifted from the videogame.
This dedicated app is an entertaining, practical, and functional tool, saving you significant time and effort calculating each time effect using traditional methods or a generic timer app.
MAIN SECTION & SETTINGS
The main page lets you determine the number of players and shows two buttons. One button will direct you to the living FAQ for the game, hosted on Steamforged Games’ website and updated by the development team. The other one allows you to turn on/off the sound effects and ambient music, which contains Ubisoft’s tracks and sounds from the video game. 
Each menu has its theme and rhythm, and when a timer reaches 30 seconds, a standard signal can be heard, matching a bomb’s beeping sound from the blockbuster…which speeds up for the last five seconds to end with a longer distinctive bleep, clearly signaling time is over!
The settings page will allow you to name your squad and to set each team’s timer speed from one of the four available speed settings (1 – Beginner, 2 – Chill, 3 – Standard, or 4 – Extreme). This can create asymmetry or give a team or a specific player a handicap.
SWAP TIMERS AND CHALLENGE
Each player must complete their two activation phases within a limited time, defined by the number of Operators still in play at the start of the round. During each activation phase, players take turns to activate some of their Operators. 
With this app, you can decide with a simple tap if you want your time to flow, if you're going to stop your opponent’s time, or if you want to swap a timer with the other player’s time. Some actions may be challenged, and the pause button will allow you to add or deduct 30 seconds to a timer immediately.
UPKEEP SECTION 
Several buttons are available here to keep track of the allotted time for each squad, which depends on the number of Operators still in play, or to keep track of the game rounds and victory conditions. You can start the next round, get to Overtime, or end the game if one team has succeeded in their mission!
We strongly recommend downloading this app for free and enjoying a dedicated, simple, handy, and immersive companion for your 6:Siege – The Board Game games.

bluejetty:00160386:ios.description:
Unlock your passive vocabulary with Eloqa — through images and quotes that bring words to life!
Mastering your words is the foundation of clear communication, and a powerful asset when it comes to speaking with confidence.
To express yourself better, you first need to enrich your vocabulary with the most useful and precise words of the English language.
And with Eloqa, it’s far more engaging than flipping through a dictionary!
We’ve selected a wide range of words and expressions that help you persuade, connect, and share your ideas with ease. To make them stick, we’ve crafted clear usage examples, paired with vivid illustrations so you’ll remember them effortlessly.
We’ve also gathered inspiring, witty, and thought-provoking quotes from writers, thinkers, and artists — across culture, history, psychology, and human relationships — all containing the very vocabulary you’ll want to make your own.
The game is simple: complete the examples from memory with the right words. Practice every day, and soon these words will become part of how you naturally speak.
With Eloqa, you won’t necessarily improve at crosswords or Scrabble…
But you’ll surprise yourself by holding conversations at a lexical level you never thought possible!
Eloqa’s method will impact your vocabulary as much as reading a hundred books — with a fraction of the effort.
Just three minutes a day is enough to add around 100 truly useful words to your active vocabulary each month.
With at least two new words daily, our scientifically proven spaced repetition system (SRS) makes memorization smooth and lasting.
Step by step, your spoken English will gain precision. You’ll feel more at ease in any conversation, and you’ll master the power of words — whether to tell stories, convince, or even charm in any situation.
What you’ll find in Eloqa:
- Over 1,700 precise and highly useful words and expressions
- Inspiring, philosophical, and witty quotes to put vocabulary in context
- The SRS memorization system, proven effective for learning vocabulary
- Beautiful images paired with each quote to help lock words in memory
- 300+ inspiring personalities with short biographies — philosophers, actors, comedians, and more
- Topics ranging from philosophy to history, politics, psychology, and culture
- A simple and intuitive interface
- At least one new word each day, featured in the daily quote
- A progress chart to track your growth
- An exploration menu to revisit words and quotes anytime
- Clear goals to keep you motivated
- Daily notifications so you never miss a session
- Constantly growing content
- Works offline — and if you’re online, your progress is synced and safely stored
Got feedback or ideas? Leave us a rating and review on the App Store — we’d love to hear from you!
Terms of Use : https://eloqa.app/en/terms.html

bluejetty:00174948:ios.description:
Auto-capture your golf swing. Instant slow-motion replay. Track ball flight. Instant diagnosis. Hands-free. 2-cam recording with external camera (iPad only).
PGA Show “Best Overall Product.” No sensor. Film on a phone holder, swing, and the app trims, replays, draws the plane, and tracks the ball.
**Train faster**
- Auto swing detection — hands-free recording 
- Auto replay in slow motion after every shot 
- Auto ball tracking 
- Auto swing plane and reference lines 
- Auto sway detection (head and spine) 
- Auto 2-second trim — keep only the swing 
- Auto Golf Digest–style swing sequence 
- Auto sync any two swings side by side 
- 2-Cam recording with external camera (iPad only)
**Coach — run your teaching business** 
Built for busy coaches who cannot waste a student’s time.
- Unlimited students and unlimited voiceovers 
- Student video lockers — every swing filed by player 
- Capture, draw, voiceover, and send in one flow 
- Built-in chat on every shared video 
- Groups and broadcast — one message to many students 
- Listed in the Swing Profile Coach Directory so golfers can find you 
- 25GB cloud storage 
Used by coaches worldwide. Learn more at swingprofile.com/Coach
**School — run a multi-coach academy** 
Everything in Coach, plus tools for collaborating between multiple coaches.
- School of up to 5 coaches (each coach needs their own Coach plan) 
- Assign and re-assign students across coaches 
- Cover for each other when someone is away 
- One shared materials folder for the whole academy 
Learn more at swingprofile.com/School
**What coaches say**
“A brilliant golf swing analysis app that bleeds efficiency for the busy golf instructor… continuous recording with auto-trim, auto draw of swing plane/shoulder plane/vertical reference lines, side by side analysis with automatic swing synchronization, and my favorite… frame-by-frame sequence view.” 
— Deb Vangellow, LPGA Master Professional, 2012 LPGA National Teacher of the Year
“Incredibly time efficient and easy to use. As a golf professional, it is very important not to waste my client’s time. The degree of automation is exactly what I need.” 
— Scott Pickett, NZPGA, Head Coach, North Shore Golf Club
“In a few easy steps you can record and view your swing in a number of key positions. An absolute must-buy for golfers who enjoy practicing and improving.” 
— Stephen Cowan, NZPGA, Head Coaching Professional, Complete Golf
Awarded “Best Overall Product” and “Best Market Research” at the 2012 PGA Merchandise Show.

bluejetty:00127272:ios.description:
I Love Film has been Today's App in 150 countries.
I love film will make your images look as if they were taken in the old days - with film.
Lots of care has been used when analyzing each film to match their original looks. The grain that comes with the films are real grains, scanned too perfection.
And who doesn't love the look of old film, hence the name 'I love film'.
To make you an even better photographer I have written 17 tutorials on how to improve and understand composition.
If you read through all of them, I can almost guarantee that your images will be so much better and you'll start to understand why some images that you see look beautiful.
KEY FEATURES:
130+ FILMS
Over 130 films are included in total and they simulated slides, color, black and white, instant and infrared films.
LIGHT LEAKS
Enhance your images with the old look using light-leaks
GRAIN
Each film will has it grain just as their original has.
VIGNETTE
Naturally you can darken the edges to make your main-subject pop even more.
DATE-STAMP
Add an analog feeling where the date the image was taken vill be present in your image.
BOKEH
Simulate nice-looking bokeh into your images.
FILM LIVE-VIEW
The camera will show the image using the film with grain in real time
LOTS OF TOOLS
Lots of tools to perfect your image, such as crop, contrast, exposure etc
SHARE
Naturally can save the images to your camera-roll or share it to common social media.
SUPPORT
We are eager to hear from you. We just love to hear both good stuff and bad stuff. And it's much likely that your opinion will be added into the next update.
Please don't hesitate to contact us at:
support@miiam.net

bluejetty:00040552:ios.name: Dark Mode for Safari: NightEye
bluejetty:00040552:ios.summary: Dark Mode - Night Eye is a Safari extension that automatically adds dark mode to every website you visit. It makes bright websites easier to look at at night, in low light, or anytime you prefer a darker screen. Dark Mode - Night Eye does n
bluejetty:00040552:ios.description:
Dark Mode - Night Eye is a Safari extension that automatically adds dark mode to every website you visit. It makes bright websites easier to look at at night, in low light, or anytime you prefer a darker screen. Dark Mode - Night Eye does not collect or sell your data.
It gives websites in Safari a clear, consistent dark theme while you browse. Use it across the pages you open every day, from news and blogs to forums, stores, and online PDFs. On websites that already support dark mode, it works with the site’s own theme so you can keep the look you prefer.
MODES
Dark — Changes colors, small images, and icons for a full dark mode experience.
Filtered — Keeps the original website colors and lets you adjust brightness, contrast, warmth, and more.
Normal — Switch back to the regular website look at any time.
FEATURES
- Automatically adds dark mode in Safari
- Works across the pages you browse every day
- Follows your system or browser color scheme
- Works smoothly with websites that already support dark mode
- Lets you schedule when dark mode turns on and off
- Applies dark mode to online PDFs
- Lets you export and import settings between Safari and other supported browsers
CUSTOMIZATION
Change settings for one website or for all websites. Adjust brightness, saturation, contrast, blue light filter, and dimming to make browsing more comfortable.
HOW TO SET UP
1. Open Dark Mode - Night Eye and tap the button on the welcome screen to go to Settings.
2. In Settings, go to Apps > Safari > Extensions, then tap Dark Mode - Night Eye and turn on Allow Extension.
3. On iPad, Safari may appear in the left sidebar.
4. On the same screen, allow the extension to run on the websites you visit. If you see All Websites, tap it and choose Allow.
5. Open Safari and start browsing with Dark Mode - Night Eye enabled.
You can also tap the Manage Extensions button in the Safari address bar to open Dark Mode - Night Eye settings.
PLANS
Night Eye Lite
Free access to dark mode on up to 5 websites.
Night Eye Pro
3 months included when you install the app. Starts automatically, with no payment or registration required.
Night Eye Pro Max
Yearly access with full features on up to 6 browsers.
Night Eye Ultimate
A one-time purchase for lifetime access on up to 10 browsers.
PRIVACY
Safari may tell you the extension can read and change webpages. Dark Mode - Night Eye needs this access to apply dark mode on the websites you open.
Safari may also show a notice about sensitive information or browsing history when you enable extensions. This is a standard extension warning. Dark Mode - Night Eye does not read, collect, or sell your personal information, including passwords or payment details.

bluejetty:00164608:ios.description:
Unlock the mysteries of your subconscious mind with Dream AI, the ultimate dream interpretation app that combines advanced AI with psychological, astrological, and philosophical insights. Whether you're seeking deeper meaning, exploring the art of lucid dreaming, or keeping a personal dream journal, Dream AI has everything you need to elevate your dream experience.
Dream AI offers detailed, personalized interpretations of your dreams. Using cutting-edge AI technology, we analyze your dream entries to provide insightful explanations tailored just for you. Dive into various perspectives, including:
1. Astrological Insights: Discover how your zodiac sign influences your dreams.
2. Psychological Perspectives: Explore how your dreams reflect your emotions and thoughts.
3. Freudian Interpretation: Uncover hidden meanings based on Freud's theories.
4. Jungian Analysis: Learn about archetypes and the collective unconscious behind your dreams.
- Dream Journal & Calendar -
Keep all your dreams in one place with our intuitive dream journal. Write down your dreams as soon as you wake up, and let Dream AI interpret them for you. Use the calendar feature to track your dream patterns, revisit past interpretations, and gain a deeper understanding of your subconscious over time.
- Learn the Art of Lucid Dreaming -
Take control of your dreams! Dream AI offers proven lucid dreaming techniques to help you become aware while dreaming. Master the art of lucid dreaming and explore your dreams with creativity and intention.
- Educative and Engaging Articles -
Expand your knowledge of dreams with our rich library of fun and educational articles. Learn about the science behind dreaming, the history of dream interpretations, and practical tips for improving dream recall. Prefer listening? Our articles are also available as audio versions for on-the-go learning.
- Why Choose Dream AI? -
• Easy-to-Use Interface: Log your dreams quickly and effortlessly.
• Comprehensive Interpretations: Get insights that combine modern technology with ancient wisdom.
• Customizable Experience: Tailored interpretations based on your zodiac sign, personal inputs, and interests.
• Accessible Content: Read or listen to articles anytime, anywhere.
Whether you're looking to interpret a recurring dream, track your dream patterns, or embark on a journey into lucid dreaming, Dream AI is the perfect companion. Explore the deeper meanings of your dreams, understand yourself better, and transform your nights into a fascinating adventure.

• AI-powered detailed dream interpretations.
• Multidimensional analysis: astrological, psychological, Freudian, and Jungian perspectives.
• Convenient dream journaling with calendar tracking.
• Step-by-step lucid dreaming techniques for beginners and experts.
• A rich library of educational and audio articles about dreams.
• Sleek, user-friendly design for seamless navigation.
Download Dream AI today and turn your dreams into a window of self-discovery, creativity, and fun. Transform the way you dream—start your journey with Dream AI now!
If you have any feedback, don't hesitate to get in touch with us via email: dreamapp@broftware.com  We will get back to you immediately :)

bluejetty:00038053:ios.description:

Your Meeting, Your Rules: Bot-Free or Professional Bot Enjoy seamless transcription across Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Google Meet, and all major conferencing platforms. Want total discretion? Use our strict bot-free mode to capture audio directly from your system with TOTAL PRIVACY—no awkward bots will ever join your calls. Want to demonstrate transparency and professionalism to your clients? Activate our professional AI bot to officially join the room and take notes on your behalf.
In-Person & On-the-Go: Anotar isn't just for online calls. Capture in-person meetings, spontaneous brainstorms, or private doctor consultations anywhere using your iPhone's microphone or directly from your Apple Watch. No phone juggling needed. Just tap your wrist and stay fully present in any situation.
Uncompromising Information Security & Encryption We don't just protect your privacy; we lock down your data. Anotar utilizes military-grade end-to-end encryption to create a secure environment for your most confidential information. Whether it's medical records or boardroom secrets, your files are processed securely and encrypted so tightly that only you hold the key.
Why Anotar? Because Efficiency Matters:
• Multi-Platform Delivery & Integrations: Get your AI-powered synopsis and digest delivered instantly to your email and WhatsApp. We also integrate seamlessly with Slack and other team management platforms for effortless communication and on-the-go access.
• Custom Visual Reports: Elevate your professional image. Turn raw meeting notes into polished, custom visual reports ready to be shared with your team or stakeholders.
• Smart Folder Organization: Keep your workspace perfectly sorted. Organize your meeting notes, transcripts, and files into dedicated folders by client, patient, project, or sector.
• Action Items & Highlights: Never miss a deadline. Anotar automatically extracts key highlights and assigns action items so you know exactly what needs to be done next.
Powered by Advanced AI (GPT, Claude, Gemini Integration): We baked in the brainpower of the smartest AI models available. It’s not just about transcribing anymore:
• Ask It Anything: Confused about a specific update? Chat with your notes and get clear, personalized answers about your content.
• Strategy Mode: Turn raw voice data into clear decisions and structured plans without breaking a sweat.
• Find It, Fast: No more digging through audio mush. Search your entire encrypted library and snag the exact quote you need instantly.
Who is Anotar For?
• Lawyers & Consultants: Nail every detail from hearings and organize client cases into dedicated folders.
• Executives & Managers: Keep stakeholder alignment perfect and share visual reports instantly.
• Docs & Therapists: Turn patient consults into tidy records with absolute confidentiality.
• Students & Researchers: Ditch the note-taking frenzy, get a complete recap of lectures, and actually enjoy learning.
Stop drowning in meeting quicksand. Let our secure AI handle the grunt work while you focus on crushing it.
Download Anotar Now.

bluejetty:00186788:ios.name: Color by Numbers - Animals
bluejetty:00186788:ios.summary: A rich and diverse animal world is very interesting for young children. First we get acquainted with domestic animals, like for example, fluffy kittens and playful dogs. On the street, we come across small insects and chirping, spotted bird
bluejetty:00186788:ios.description:
A rich and diverse animal world is very interesting for young children. First we get acquainted with domestic animals, like for example, fluffy kittens and playful dogs. On the street, we come across small insects and chirping, spotted birds. In the zoo we can view wild animals, such as rabbits, a fox, and a bear. Every time we learn more and more about these co-habitants of our Earth! Some of them creep along, while others run on their paws; still others soar through the air! Some prefer to live in burrows, some in nests, while others just live in the trees or sleep in meadows. You'll see huge elephants and hippopotamuses, small chameleons and frogs, fast lions and slow turtles - herbivores and predators alike. We invite you to get acquainted with these marvelous representatives of the animal kingdom on the pages of our game!
Benefits: 
◦ Teaching children simple arithmetic. Addition and subtraction
◦ Coloring by geometrical figures and pictograms
◦ Coloring by letters
◦ Very simple program interface that any child can master 
◦ Easy-to-use palette that allows you to put together your own unique set of colors
◦ High-quality drawings of all pictures 
◦ Visual effects and sound effects 
◦ Pleasing background music 
◦ Colored pictures automatically saved on closing the program
◦ And many other useful features that make coloring entertaining
Paint by numbers - an interactive coloring book for children. This mathematical game teaches children to recognize numbers and solve simple mathematical examples. In addition, this program develops memory, attention, imagination, and logical abilities.
Boys and girls of all ages love to color. The simple coloring mode is suitable for the smallest of children, including those of kindergarten and preschool age. These include simple and recognizable images that are easy to color. If the child selects the wrong shape, then they will be prompted with the correct number. Therefore, the picture will always be colored correctly, and the child will quickly memorize the numbers. Children can choose to color by geometrical figures and pictograms in addition to numbers. A child can easily distinguish a square from a circle, diamond, and triangle.
School-age children will enjoy the complex coloring mode. Here the picture is divided into a large number of elements, thus making it difficult at first to determine what it depicts. Older children can complicate the task by adding addition and subtraction tasks. Now children will need to solve the examples and choose the correct answers in order to color the picture. This will teach the child how to quickly do arithmetic in their mind.
Those who are learning the alphabet can choose to color by letter. Coloring by letters will be useful for children preparing to enter primary school.
To make the coloring process more interesting and fun, you can change any of the preset colors. To do this, press and hold the jar of paint and a palette will open. Then you can choose your favorite color. Thus, all the shaded areas of the image can be changed in the coloring by number mode. You can have fun by changing the color scheme to suit your taste. Try the program right now!

This app lets you select your line, your lure, a diver or trolling weights, and then combine them however you want. bluejetty:00078371:ios.description:
Experience the energy of training inside The Beehive by Brabants wherever you are. Join founder Kelly Brabants and her team of expertly trained instructors for a premium virtual fitness experience designed to support your mental and physical health journey.
Unlock unlimited access to a curated library of on-demand workouts, with new classes added weekly, all set to uplifting playlists that inspire and energize you. Whether you have 20 minutes or a full hour, you’ll discover thoughtfully programmed sessions that feel intentional, empowering, and seamlessly fit into your routine.
Why you’ll love it:
• Unlimited access to 250+ workouts
• Classes led by expert, certified instructors who inspire every session
• Classes include Kelly’s BBB Signature workouts, total body bootcamps, HIIT, Pilates sculpt, and more
• Studio-quality workouts you can do anywhere
• High-energy music and motivating coaching
• New workouts added weekly
Train consistently, elevate your routine, and experience the signature Beehive method wherever life takes you.
To access all features and content you can subscribe to Booty by Brabants on a monthly or yearly basis with an auto-renewing subscription right inside the app.* Pricing can vary by region and will be confirmed before purchase in the app. In app subscriptions will automatically renew at the end of their cycle.
* All payments will be paid through your iTunes Account and may be managed under Account Settings after the initial payment. Subscription payments will automatically renew unless deactivated at least 24-hours before the end of the current cycle. Your account will be charged for renewal at least 24-hours prior to the end of the current cycle. Any unused portion of your free trial will be forfeited upon payment. Cancellations are incurred by disabling auto-renewal.
Terms of Service: https://workoutbootybybrabants.vhx.tv/tos
Privacy Policy: https://workoutbootybybrabants.vhx.tv/privacy

imagin – More than just an app for managing your money
Open your 100% mobile and online digital account with no fees. Free cards, Bizum, transfers, mobile payments, investing and saving, all from a banking experience designed for you.
Become an imaginBank customer and keep track of your spending, withdraw cash for free at CaixaBank ATMs, and send money instantly with Bizum. Join imagin, the online bank that helps you manage your finances.
WHAT DO WE OFFER?
• A 100% mobile bank account with no fees.
• Cards that are completely free, with no issuance or maintenance fees, and made from 100% recyclable materials. Discover the benefits of the imagin debit card – the card for all your adventures – as well as our credit cards, prepaid cards and Carnet Jove.
• Apple Pay is available for quick and secure payments using your mobile phone. Add your cards to Apple Wallet from the imagin app by clicking on ‘Add to Apple Wallet’.
• Financial products tailored to you: insurance, mortgages, investments, financing and savings.
• Manage your money, accounts and personal finances.
• Send and receive money instantly with Bizum and make free transfers, with no fees.
• Find out the latest news on imaginPlanet, imaginMusic, imaginGames and Ventajas in the ‘Enjoy’ section.
• Discover the latest tech products, with or without finance, in the Falcilitea Shop.
• Withdraw cash for free at CaixaBank ATMs, with no fees.
• Get answers to your questions 24/7 with our chatbot.
YOUR FINANCES
Keep track of your personal finances. Organise your expenses and filter your transactions by category. Set your spending budget, reach your savings goal, and manage your personal finances all from a single calendar.
ENJOY.
Enjoy our top discounts on brands and services!
Find out the latest news on sustainability with imaginPlanet. On imaginMusic, you’ll have access to concerts and interviews with the hottest artists. Apply for your free card and enjoy exclusive experiences. Discover financial tips for your day-to-day life at imaginAcademy.
PAYMENTS AND MONEY TRANSFERS.
Send and receive money instantly with Bizum from your imagin account via the app. Pay at online shops via Bizum. Make free transfers. Withdraw cash for free using your mobile at over 13,000 Caixabank ATMs, easily and securely. With imagin&Split, create a shared expenses list with as many friends as you like and settle bills instantly in the app via Bizum.
WALLET.
Discover all of imagin’s free cards and choose the one that suits you best. Pay with your mobile or smartwatch using imagin mobile payments, Google Pay, Samsung Pay, Garmin Pay, FitBit Pay and SwatchPAY.
PRODUCTS.
imagin offers financial products tailored to your needs:
• Shop Facilitea. Discover the very best tech products in our shop.
• Get started in investing and finance with imagin&invest managed portfolios.
• Start saving by creating your own savings challenges and plans with CaixaFuturo.
• Discover the imaginBank fixed-rate and mixed-rate mortgage.
• Home insurance, health insurance, card insurance, travel insurance, mobile phone insurance, dental insurance.
• Manage bills and top up cards.
• Top up your mobile phone credit.
Download the new imagin app now and say goodbye to paying fees!
At imaginBank (CaixaBank), we will process your data to handle your comment and, if we can identify you as a customer, also to contact you by telephone for this same purpose. bluejetty:00114756:ios.description:
Word Solitaire: Associations is a clever blend of card strategy and word discovery. It’s not your usual word game — here, you’ll match ideas, uncover connections, and build meaning chains to clear the board. Relax, think, and play your way through hundreds of challenging levels that twist the classic solitaire formula into something totally fresh.
A New Kind of Word Challenge
What happens when solitaire meets word association?
Each level starts with a few cards on the table and a full deck waiting to be revealed.
Draw cards one by one, find the right categories, and place matching words in their proper spots. Just like solitaire, smart planning matters — one misplaced card can change everything.
How to Play
Tap to draw cards from the deck.
Place category cards first to create a foundation.
Add all related word cards to complete the group.
Clear all stacks to win the level.
It’s simple to learn but deeply satisfying to master.
Why You’ll Enjoy It
A relaxing mix of solitaire logic and word association puzzles
Hundreds of handcrafted levels full of clever links and surprises
No timers, no rush — play at your own pace
Smooth design and rewarding progression
Ideal for fans of word, logic, and card games
Train Your Brain, One Word at a Time
Every match you make sharpens your reasoning and vocabulary. Think outside the box, spot the hidden connection, and feel that “aha” moment with every correct pairing.
What Players Are Saying
“Brilliant combination of cards and words. Totally addictive.”
“Perfect balance of thinking and relaxing — my new favorite puzzle.”
“So satisfying when you find the hidden link.”
Whether you love word games, card games, or brain teasers, Word Solitaire: Associations delivers the best of all worlds. It’s clever, calm, and endlessly replayable.
Download now and see if you can master the art of word connections.

GetRate is a calculator for analysts and travellers!
Built-in analytics
bluejetty:00017955:ios.description:
GetRate is an innovative currency exchange calculator featuring exchange rate forecast and analytics. It supports more than 130 currencies and multiple data sources.
GetRate is a calculator for analysts and travellers!
Built-in analytics will help you learn more about currencies, and their interconnection against each other and primary resources.
Using the «Time Machine» feature, you will be able to make calculations for the past days. The forecast tools will help you estimate future exchange rates.
The built-in alarm clock will always help you keep informed about sharp currency fluctuations, and evaluate the security of your investment in currencies using a specialized currency rating system.
GetRate is perfect for travellers.
The calculator can operate in offline mode. You will be able to access all charts, analytics, exchange rates and exchange rate history.
Forgot the currency of a country? Not a big deal. The built-in country and currency matching system will help you sort things out.
The calculator features user-friendly widgets, Apple Watch support, night and day color schemes. It has everything you need.
You can buy a subscription to the Analytical Center of GetRate and gain access to daily updates on currency ratings as well as analytics for currencies and commodity prices.
Autorenewable subscription for 1 month costs $0.99. The renewal fee will be charged in the last 24 hours of the current period. Subscription for the next period can be cancelled in Account Settings. Already paid subscriptions cannot be cancelled.
You can have one week's trial, unused part of the trial period will be cancelled after the subscription fee is paid.
Privacy policy and terms of use: http://strelka.hk/getrateprivacy.txt

Why people choose Spark
More than just photos
Spark gives people more ways to express who they are through interests, profile questions, and profile details that make every profile feel more complete.
Shared interests that actually matter
Discover people through the topics, values, and hobbies you have in common.
Simple, mutual connections

A respectful space to connect

Create your profile

Complete profiles

Interest-based discovery
Find people through common interests and meaningful similarities.
Built-in safety tools
Moderation, reporting features, and community rules help keep the experience respectful.
Mutual connections only
Chats open only after both people express interest.

Spark is intended for adults 18 and over.

bluejetty:00002395:android:0.description:
Create, edit, and collaborate on presentations with the Google Slides app. With Slides you can:
* Create new presentations or edit existing ones
* Share presentations and collaborate with others in the same presentation at the same time
* Work anywhere, anytime - even offline
* Add and rearrange slides, format text and shapes, and more
* Present right from your device
* Never worry about losing your work -- everything is automatically saved as you type
* Present slides to video calls - scheduled meetings will automatically appear
* Open, edit, and save PowerPoint files
Google Slides is part of Google Workspace: where teams of any size can chat, create, and collaborate.
Google Workspace subscribers have access to additional Google Slides features, including: 
* Collaborating on a single presentation online with your business partner, your whole team, or external contacts. You control who gets permission to edit, view, or just add comments.
* Starting from scratch or expediting the process by choosing a template. You can enhance your presentations with videos, images, drawings, and smooth transitions.
* Working across PCs, Macs, mobiles, and tablets—View or even present your slides from your phone or tablet, so you have the option to practice your presentation up until the last minute.
Permissions Notice
Camera: This is used for camera mode in video calls and to insert images taken with the camera.
Microphone: This is used to transmit audio in video calls.
Photos: This is used to access photos under the control of Photos application to let the users pick images to insert into slides.

The service is also accessible to people who use whe
bluejetty:00071600:ios.description:
The RTC Flexibus app lets you book on-demand transportation in the areas served. You can book a trip within an area or to connect to another bus route at the same cost as a single ride. 
The service is also accessible to people who use wheelchairs and three- or four-wheeled scooters. 
With Flexibus, riders can do things like get to a bus stop or run an errand at the local grocery store or pharmacy. Flexibus is a public transit service. You’ll ride with up to 7 other passengers in the same vehicle. 
How it works: 
1– Download the RTC Flexibus mobile app 
2– Create your customer account or log in. 
3– Book your trip 
4– Go to the stop shown on the virtual map 
5– Board the bus and pay for your ride 
Benefits of the Flexibus app: 
- Book a Flexibus in a just few clicks 
- Track your Flexibus in real time 
- Get a text notification when your Flexibus is arriving 
- Manage favourite places 
Price: 
Flexibus costs the same as a bus ride. 
Payment methods: 
- OPUS or Occasionelle card 
- RTC Nomade app 
 Already have a monthly RTC pass or L’abonne BUS subscription? Flexibus is included.

bluejetty:00072916:ios.summary:
A FREE turn based STRATEGY game uses the engine of AGE OF STRATEGY but now in the fantasy world with ORCs, ELVES, UNDEAD and HUMANs! Also 2 new races: DWARVES, SCALEDFOLKs
A lot of of CAMPAIGNS, skirmishes and MULTIPLAYER games are waiting
bluejetty:00072916:ios.description:
A FREE turn based STRATEGY game uses the engine of AGE OF STRATEGY but now in the fantasy world with ORCs, ELVES, UNDEAD and HUMANs! Also 2 new races: DWARVES, SCALEDFOLKs
A lot of of CAMPAIGNS, skirmishes and MULTIPLAYER games are waiting for you to dive in!
NOT a pay to win game! The in-app payment option is for supporting the code developer.
The game is a retro-like 8-bit game like AoS, so it is not pretty and it has no fancy animations. This is a pure gameplay-oriented turn based strategy like the original.
***FEATURES***
- More than 390 Campaign maps to pass (There are also featured fan-made maps like LoTR and Warcraft)
- More than 300 Skirmish maps to fight on
- More than 1100! units and buildings
- More than 440! technologies to invent
- Design your own maps with the Map Editor feature! 
- Rewarding system: Collecting stars on each map (Based on your peformance) will grant you gems used for unlocking new troops, technologies or buildings!
- Spell Upgrades: Do you find a map too hard? You can ease the difficulty with various spells that can be bought with gems! (Used on consumption)
- Battle against AI on skirmish maps like in classic strategy games!
- Battle against or with real players worldwide!
- Design your own maps with the Map Editor feature!
- Upgrades section containing hundreds of new units, technologies and buildings buyable with gems (Including some fun units)!
- Pick one of 6 mighty races (Humans, Orcs, Undead, Elves, Dwarves and Scaledfolks) and engage in epic combat!
***UNIT REQUESTS***
There are many requests for new and unique units (eg. historical heroes), I am pretty open to this since it's pretty easy to implement a new unit. Please join the forum/Discord, post there the idea and i will make it!
***IF YOU INSTALL IT***
- Please be kind with the rating, since this app is in the middle of developement.
- Feel free to send me any suggestions concerning any part of the game (Gameplay, units, unit properties, new unit suggestions, graphics etc...)
- If you would like to take part in creating this game (eg. graphics, translation, ideas) send me an email and/or join the forums!
***FOR A START***
1. Go to Single Player (Or skirmish)
2. Play a map
3. If you have any, send me suggestions!
4. If not, enjoy the game!
Have fun!

bluejetty:00036349:ios.summary:
A steampunk-ish detective adventure from the creator of A Golden Wake and Shardlight! Can private investigator Miles Fordham find justice for his clients and track down his partner's killer before his entire world comes apart?
• "I fostered
bluejetty:00036349:ios.description:
A steampunk-ish detective adventure from the creator of A Golden Wake and Shardlight! Can private investigator Miles Fordham find justice for his clients and track down his partner's killer before his entire world comes apart?
• "I fostered a lifelong love for the adventure genre, culminating in a Purple Tentacle tattoo (Day of the Tentacle, duh) on my upper left arm. So I’ll be playing Lamplight City, too. Trust." - Rock, Paper, Shotgun
• "Overall, this game has a lot going for it, and I encourage you to check it out even if you’re not an adventure game buff." - Hey Poor Player
ABOUT THE GAME
The Gateway to Vespuccia, the City of Air and Light, Lamplight City - the thriving port city of New Bretagne is a beacon of progress and industrial advancement in the New World. Yet beneath the promises of a shining 19th-century future, the city rests upon foundations of poverty, class struggle, and crime.
For police detective turned private investigator Miles Fordham, Lamplight City's shadowy corners are just part of the territory. But with his former partner constantly speaking to him from beyond the grave, his grip on sanity is slowly loosening. Can Miles find justice for his clients and track down his partner's killer before his entire world comes apart?
Lamplight City is a detective adventure set in an alternate steampunk-ish "Victorian" past.
FEATURES
• Be the detective you want to be. But prepare to face the consequences.
Investigate crime scenes, interrogate suspects, get information by any means necessary. Follow the law or make your own rules, but how you choose to act will affect people's attitudes towards you.
• Five cases to solve, with multiple suspects, false leads, and different outcomes.
Never find yourself stuck in a dead-end situation. If the case becomes unsolvable, simply move on to the next one. The story will adapt based on your choices.
• Single click interface with no inventory.
Gather clues and documents in your casebook for review. Item manipulation is handled via a context-sensitive cursor.
• A fictional city with four boroughs to explore, each with their own unique flavor.
Players will visit each of these boroughs throughout the game, exploring themes such as class divide and the public's fear of emerging steam tech.
• Inspired by the works of Edgar Allan Poe and Charles Dickens.
• Meet over 50 professionally voiced characters.
• Original score by Mark Benis.

bluejetty:00089055:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00089055:ios.description:
Modak banking accounts are closing
Modak banking accounts will close on or before December 15, 2026. If you have a Modak account, please review the important dates and steps you need to take to access or move your remaining funds before closure.
Modak gives kids and teens a real Visa® debit card, plus the tools to earn, spend and save, while parents stay in control. Start free with a virtual card. Some features require a paid plan.²
A REAL VISA® DEBIT CARD FOR KIDS
Everywhere Visa® is accepted. Tap to pay with Apple Pay® or Google Pay™, shop online and in stores, cash at millions of ATMs. Operator fees may apply.⁴ Virtual card ready instantly; physical card available upon request.¹ Ages 0 to 17. Parents get a free virtual card too.
CHORES THAT PAY²
Set a task, set a reward, approve it when it’s done. The money lands on their account right away. Any task, no limit.
ALLOWANCE THAT RUNS ITSELF²
Set the amount and schedule once, daily to monthly, and it’s sent automatically, on time, every time. Change or pause anytime.
SAVING GOALS²
Open a goal, set the target, watch it grow. Kids and parents can both add money. On MoGold, every goal can earn up to a 4% annual boost.²
ALERTS, CONTROLS AND SAFETY
An alert the moment they spend: what, where and how much. Freeze the card in a tap. Biometric login and multi-layer protection. Kids can only spend what’s on their balance. Enhanced controls and analytics on paid plans.²
SEND AND MANAGE FAMILY MONEY
Add money from your bank, or in seconds from any debit or credit card (a small fee applies,⁴ free on MoGold²). Set auto-reload and the balance tops itself up. Send free between Modak users, and split any bill fairly.
CO-PARENTING²
Add another parent, a grandparent or a guardian to help manage a kid’s money. Each adult keeps a separate account.⁵
PLANS
MoBasic, $0/month: kids’ and parent virtual cards, ATM access, auto-reload, real-time alerts, card freeze, MBX rewards.
MoSilver, $2.99/month: everything in MoBasic, plus chores, allowance, saving goals, co-parenting, enhanced controls and analytics, premium card designs, physical cards included.
MoGold, $5.99/month: everything in MoSilver, plus 2% cashback on eligible purchases, up to a 4% annual boost on saving goals and your parent balance, instant funding fees reimbursed up to $25 a month.²
--
Modak is a financial technology company and is not an FDIC-insured financial institution. Deposit account and the Modak Visa® debit card are issued by Legend Bank, N.A., Member FDIC
1. Physical card issuance requires either funding the teen’s account with at least $10 or subscribing to an eligible plan. A virtual card is issued free upon account creation.
2. Details on Subscription plans, including cashback purchase eligibility, saving goals, instant funding limits (waived up to $25 in fees per month), free physical card shipping and more are available in our Terms & Conditions (modakmakers.com/legal/terms). The Modak Boost program, can be found in our Terms & Conditions and Modak Boost Terms and Conditions (modakmakers.com/legal/goals-account-acknowledgement). The Bank does not pay interest on the account, and All incentive payments are funded and made solely by Modak, independent of the Bank.
3. Fees for expedited or premium services may apply. Find out more in our Cardholder agreement (modakmakers.com/legal/legend-agreements).
4. For eligibility, functionality, and other details regarding the Co-Parenting feature, please review our Terms and Conditions (modakmakers.com/legal/terms).
Apple Pay is a trademark of Apple Inc. Google Pay is a trademark of Google

bluejetty:00115483:ios.description:

Bring your device’s speakers back to life with Speaker Cleaner - the smart, safe, and effective way to remove dust, dirt, and moisture from your audio system. Using precision-engineered sound frequencies, the app helps restore full, powerful sound quality in just minutes.

• Advanced Frequency Cleaning – Generate sound waves from 0 Hz to 20 kHz to break down and expel unwanted particles.

• Place your device face down on a flat surface.
• Set your volume to maximum.

bluejetty:00097104:ios.description:
MacroFactor Workouts combines innovative coaching algorithms with science-based workout routines customized to your goals, fitness level, and gym equipment.
Effortlessly track your strength training routines with an intuitive workout planner, and easily monitor your PRs and progress with charts and data insights.
MacroFactor Workouts uses progressive overload to automatically adjust your strength training workouts based on your progress, helping you break through plateaus and reach your fitness goals.
No gym? No problem. Create routines based on the equipment you have available in your home gym.
Download to start your 7-day trial of this premium, ad-free workout tracker app.
WORKOUT TRACKER & PLANNER FEATURES
- Effortlessly track your workouts with an intuitive interface
- Hundreds of strength training exercises with helpful tips and cues, and technique videos by Jeff Nippard
- Customizable rest timers
- Plate calculator based on available plates and bars
- Tracker for supersets, partial reps, and myoreps
- RIR tracker
- Smart warm-up planner
- Track different weights and reps on your right and left sides
- Easily swap exercises with smart suggestions
- Create new exercises
- Notes sections for exercise and workout details
- Create gym profiles for each of the places you workout
CUSTOMIZED WORKOUT PLANS
- Get a personalized workout routine based on your goals, fitness level, the gym equipment you have access to, and more
- Built by fitness experts and based on science
- Easily import and track popular Jeff Nippard routines
- Customize your workouts with smart exercise swaps, custom exercises, and more
- Prefer to create your own workouts? Use the workout planner for manual tracking, building, and saving custom routines and workouts
SMART AUTO-PROGRESSION FOR STRENGTH TRAINING
- Your plan automatically adjusts day-to-day based on your progress
- Simply track your strength workouts, and the app will tell you what to do to keep making progress – just like a coach would
- Reach your fitness goals efficiently – no wasted time, no guesswork, no pseudoscience
REACH YOUR FITNESS GOALS
- See your progress over time with beautiful and functional charts, visuals, and graphs
- Easily access your workout history
- PR tracker
- Volume tracker
- Progress photos and body metrics tracker
- Design your dashboard to feature the insights you value most
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING & TERMS
MacroFactor Workouts is a premium strength training and planner app that offers three auto-renewing subscription options:
$11.99 / month
$47.99 / half year
$71.99 / year (equal to $5.99 a month)
MacroFactor Workouts has a free trial, but does not offer a free subscription tier.
These prices are for US customers. Pricing in other countries may vary. Payment will be charged to your Apple account at confirmation of purchase.
Your subscription to MacroFactor Workouts will automatically renew, unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the current period ends. You can cancel or manage your subscription from your Apple account settings.

https://terms.macrofactorapp.com/

bluejetty:00091281:ios.description:
Obsessed with color? You’re going to love this! This app takes color analysis to the next level, ditching outdated Seasonal theories (Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter) and helping you discover the colors that suit you best – all based on your skin tone and how light or dark you are.
No more guessing or following rigid rules. The app is here to guide you in exploring color palettes and combinations that make you stand out, whether you’re styling your outfit, decorating your space, or just experimenting with a fresh new look. It’s super easy – just snap a pic, and the app does the rest!
Why you’ll love it:
 • Personalized color analysis – tailored to your skin tone and brightness.
 • Instantly generates color palettes that match your vibe.
 • Discover color combinations that help you stand out.
 • Snap photos of your favorite shades and see how they work in different harmonies.
 • Shop for clothes in your exact color palette or find items in the colors you love through the app’s e-commerce section.
 • Perfect for building the ultimate color palette for your wardrobe, interior design, or creative projects.
 • Access hex codes for any color you capture – ideal for designers and creatives.
 • Fun, easy-to-follow e-learning modules to boost your confidence in using color.
Whether you want to experiment, play, or just learn more about how to use color to express yourself, this app has you covered. Live your life in full color, your way!
