bluejetty:00041128:ios.description:
RVezy is an RV rental platform where you can book unique RV experiences with local motorhome and trailer owners. Drive, tow, or get your RV delivered and set up anywhere.
HOW RVEZY WORKS
For guests renting an RV
RVezy is the easiest way to book your next RV adventure. Add a location, dates, and filters to find the perfect RV for you.
Whether you’re looking for the classic RV experience of hitting the open road or looking to get an RV delivered and set up for the ultimate glamping experience, RVezy has got you covered. New to RVing? No problem. We’ll help you every step of the way to ensure you create a memorable RV experience.
For hosts renting out their RV
Using your RV to make money has never been easier. With RVezy, you can list your RV and start receiving bookings within just a few hours. You always have complete control over your listing and can choose when and how you want to rent your RV. In addition, with our best-in-class rental insurance and support team, you can rest assured that we’ve got your back throughout every rental.
Download our app today and discover why RVezy is the most trusted name in peer-to-peer RV rentals across North America (the U.S. and Canada).
HOW WE MAKE RV RENTALS EASY
FIND THE PERFECT RV RENTAL
RVezy enables travelers to search and book privately owned RVs available for rent across the U.S. and Canada. The RVezy app makes it easy to browse listings using the list or map view. Refine your search by adding a location, dates, and filters such as:
— Number of guests.
— RV types.
— Price.
— Amenities.
— Pet-friendly.
— Delivery.
— Instant Book.
— RV length.
— RV weight.
CUSTOMIZE YOUR RV TRIP
RVezy hosts collaborate with their guests to create personalized and memorable RV rental experiences. Here are a few ways hosts make their listings stand out with both included amenities and add-ons:
— RV delivery to a campground, event, driveway, or other location.
— Airport pickup or drop-off.
— Flexible departure and return times.
— Weekly and monthly discounts.
— Unlimited or generous mileage packages.
— RV essentials such as linens and kitchen supplies.
— Refilling and emptying tanks for guests.— Popular add-ons such as BBQs, outdoor chairs, bikes, and games.
MANAGE YOUR BOOKINGS OR LISTINGS
The RVezy app provides users a simple environment to manage their bookings or RV listings. Everything you'll need to rent or list an RV, from the first inquiry to the final closeout, is in one, easy-to-access place.
COMMUNICATE QUICKLY AND SAFELY
RVezy provides a secure messaging system that protects our users' personal information and lets guests and hosts communicate safely throughout the rental process. From sending an inquiry to asking questions during your rental, the RV app is the quickest and most secure way to communicate with one another.
DOCUMENT THE RENTAL PROCESS
The RVezy app provides hosts and guests a secure environment to photograph and document the RV's condition and agree to the rental terms and conditions before and after every rental. Reminders are sent through the app to ensure both parties complete the RV rental agreement and are protected in the case of a dispute or a claim.
RENT KNOWING YOU'RE INSURED AND PROTECTED
RVezy partners with the top insurance and roadside assistance providers in North America to ensure our renters, RV owners, and rental RVs have insurance and protection coverage on every trip. Whether you're driving your rental across the country or having an RV delivered to a friend's driveway, our 24/7 roadside assistance provider can jump in and help out if you need help.
GET SUPPORT FROM A TEAM WHO CARES
At RVezy, we are committed to providing exceptional customer service and sharing RV knowledge. From our user-friendly help center articles to our multilingual support team, our app helps you quickly find the answers to your questions and connects you directly with our in-house agents.

bluejetty:00045822:ios.description:
Texas CDL Prep Test:
The Texas CDL Prep Test is a comprehensive study tool designed to help individuals prepare for the Texas Commercial Driver License (CDL) exam. This app provides users with an interactive and engaging way to study for the CDL exam. The app covers all of the key topics, including:
* Vehicle inspection
* Vehicle control
* Air Brakes
* Hazardous Materials
* Transportation of passengers
The app includes a variety of practice questions for the CDL exam. These questions are based on the Texas Commercial Motor Vehicle Drivers Handbook. Users can track their progress and identify areas where they need more practice, allowing them to focus their studying on the areas where they need the most improvement.
App tracks the users completed practice tests. The app tracks their progress, allowing them to identify areas for improvement and track their overall progress. 
You should be able to "bookmark" questions so that you can study them later.
In addition, the app provides a list of weak questions based on practice tests on CDL Prep Test.
In the Texas CDL Permit Practice Test, there are multiple-choice questions. You must correctly answer questions based on the passing marks or mistakes allowed for that particular test.
Features:
- Study and Practice tests
 - Driving rules
 - Knowledge test
 - Air Brakes
 - Combination
 - Bus Endorsement
 - Hazmat Endorsement
 - Double Endorsement
 - Tank Endorsement
 - Passenger Endorsement
- Bookmark questions
- Preview answers after the test is submitted.
- Resume and Restart the test
- Questions with explanation
- Keep Track of Your Progress
- List of Weak/Wrong Questions for Improvement
- Review Previous tests
- Appearance ( Auto / Light / Dark )
- Test
 - Result on-the-spot with score
 - Review test questions with answers and filter about right and wrong answers
The Texas TX CDL Prep Test app is user-friendly and accessible, allowing individuals to study and prepare for the DMV CDL exam.
The app aims to provide individuals with a comprehensive and convenient study resource to help them pass the CDL exam and obtain their commercial driver's license in Texas. Whether you are a first-time CDL candidate or a seasoned professional, this app is an essential tool for passing the Texas CDL exam and achieving your commercial driver's license.
Content Source
Our app includes a variety of practice questions for the Driver's license exam for Commercial Vehicles. These questions are based on the official handbook of different states.
Disclaimer: 
This app is simply a fantastic tool for self-study and exam preparation. It has no affiliation with or endorsement from any government organisation, certificate, test, name, or trademark.

bluejetty:00175805:ios.description:
Offline Music Player — Download and Listen to Your Favorite Music Offline
Offline Music Player lets you download your favorite music, podcasts, DJ sets, remixes, and audio files to your iPhone or iPad and listen offline — anytime, anywhere. No internet? No problem. With support for MP3, FLAC, WAV, M4A, and other formats, enjoy your personal music library without Wi-Fi or data.
Whether commuting, traveling, working out, or relaxing, Offline Music Player puts you in control of your listening — no buffering, no ads, no distractions.
Download and Play Music Offline
Import your music from Google Drive, Dropbox, Yandex Disk, or OneDrive directly into the app. Files are saved locally, so you can play them even in airplane mode. No more streaming or wasted data — your music goes with you anywhere.
Need a quick way to transfer from your computer? Use Wi-Fi Transfer to send songs through a browser. You can also import audio from other apps using “Open in” or “Copy to” — fast, easy, and secure.
Key Features
 • Full-featured music player with rich playback
 • Lock screen controls, background playback
 • Headphones, Bluetooth, and AirPods support

bluejetty:00156016:ios.description:
NSSB is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with NSSB:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the NSSB app, you must be enrolled as a North Salem State Bank digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00184315:ios.name: Auto Expense.
bluejetty:00184315:ios.summary:
This is a simply but comprehensive app to track your car's fuel economy / electric car's energy consumption and other fees.
Use this app to track fuel logs / energy logs, including odometer, fuel / energy charge, price, cost, date, receipt
bluejetty:00184315:ios.description:
This is a simply but comprehensive app to track your car's fuel economy / electric car's energy consumption and other fees.
Use this app to track fuel logs / energy logs, including odometer, fuel / energy charge, price, cost, date, receipt etc, repair logs, service logs and other fees like insurance, parking, vehicle cleaning etc.
This app will calculate the fuel economy / energy consumption, like miles per gallon, cost per mile, cost per day etc; the fuel economy / energy consumption unit can be set as yours.
Also it provides very comprehensive reports for the costs by category, period, service type, repair type, fees type and the tendency. 
Key Features:
Fuels / Energies:
⁃ Track fuels filling up / energies charging logs with date, cost, price, cubage / capacity, odometer, distance compared with last filling up / charging, tank status / battery percentage, receipt and other note info.
⁃ Calculates fuel economy / energy consumption automatically.
⁃ Custom units for odometer, cubage / capacity and fuel economy / energy consumption.
⁃ Group logs by month.
⁃ Check fuel / energy charges by month.
⁃ Add, edit, and delete logs conveniently.
Services:
⁃ Track services logs with date, cost, receipt and service type etc.
⁃ Check logs by month, cost or type.
⁃ Add, edit, and delete logs conveniently.
⁃ Custom service types and their service interval by odometer and time.
⁃ Set reminders for each service by date or odometer interval.
Repairs:
⁃ Track repair logs with date, cost, receipt and repair type etc.
⁃ Check logs by month, cost or type.
⁃ Add, edit, and delete logs conveniently.
⁃ Custom repair types.
Others:
⁃ Calendar overview of expenses.
⁃ Track fees like insurance, parking, washing, tolls, and taxes etc.
⁃ Track unlimited vehicles separately.
⁃ Eight reports for vehicles’ cost.
⁃ Check total fees by each category.
⁃ Imports data into this app from Dropbox or iTunes.
⁃ Export data in format of PDF, CSV or HTML by email.
⁃ Passcode protection.
⁃ Custom units and currency.
⁃ iCloud and Dropbox backup and restore.
⁃ Supports Apple Watch version.
⁃ Supports universal version.
If you have any question, please email to yqapps@tom.com.

bluejetty:00120345:ios.description:
SAVE, LEARN & PRACTICE WORDS YOU NEED.
Your personal wordbook with flashcards, quizzes and hands-free mode. Syncs across devices, works offline.
MemoWord Flashcards App is a designed for people who need to learn large amounts of vocabulary quickly and efficiently — especially for learners who want to create and study their own vocabulary.
MemoWord helps you learn vocabulary 2–3 times faster thanks to 3 key advantages: 
 1. You learn exactly the words that matter to you. 
 2. The vocabulary you need is always at your fingertips.
 3. The hands‑free mode lets you learn while walking, driving, or doing physical work.
It works as a digital personal wordbook - wordbox and vocabulary trainer with smart repetition.
ADD VOCABULARY FAST AND EASY
Create flashcards using dictation, translation and pronunciation. 
Import your word lists from Excel. 
Download ready-made vocabulary sets. 
Group your vocabulary lists and practice until they stick!
6 POWERFUL MEMORIZATION MODES — LEARNING & PRACTICE
Flashcards — classic visual vocabulary learning
Flashcards Audio — improve listening and pronunciation
Learn On-the-Go — timed pauses and repetitions for hands-free learning
Quiz — test your vocabulary knowledge
Quiz Audio — train word recall through listening
Write — improve spelling and word recognition
FEATURES
Create and manage your own vocabulary lists and flashcards
Use MemoWord as a personal wordbook, wordnote, wordbank, or wordbox
Save words manually, by voice input, or with the built-in translator
Organize vocabulary into custom sets for learning and revision
Import your own word lists from Excel files
Study offline and sync your progress across devices
LEARNING ADVANTAGES
Mark words as “learned” or “difficult” for smarter repetition

Built in California by telecom industry veterans.
AliasMobile is a subscription-based service. 
Auto-renewing subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple ID and renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions.

bluejetty:00064814:ios.description:
Looking for the easiest way to access your ECU accounts? You’ve found it! Download the app today and experience the ECU difference! 
With ECU Mobile you can:
• Create a budget and track spending with Money Management
• Check your real-time balances and view transactions 
• Send or request money using Zelle®
• Open a new deposit account online (Savings, Checking, Certificate)
• Deposit a check from anywhere
• Transfer money between accounts 
• View and redeem credit card rewards
• Access the ECU Cards app for card controls
• Pay bills and setup your payees using Bill Pay
• Access Online Statements
• Apply for a loan
• Make loan payments
• Request a Skip-a-Payment
• Setup alerts for balances, payments, and transactions 
• Find an ECU or surcharge-free Allpoint ATM when you need cash
• Place a stop payment on a check
• Update your contact information
Other ECU Mobile features:
• Biometric login (Face ID/Fingerprint)
• See a balance preview on the app login screen using Quick Balance
• Connect to your Apple Watch
• Access ECU Live Chat for help
• Find current ECU loan and deposit rates
ECU Mobile for Business
ECU Business Banking members can now access business accounts using the ECU Mobile app! Are you an ECU Business Banking member? You’ll enjoy the same great features plus have access to business only features that will help you keep your business running even when you are on the go.
ECU Business Banking features include: 
• User level access controls and delegation
• Tokenized access for additional security
• Multi-TIN account access
• Enhanced ACH and wire capabilities
• Payment approvals
Note: To use the ECU Mobile app you must be enrolled in ECU Online Banking. To use ECU Business Banking features in ECU Mobile, you must be enrolled in the ECU Business Banking platform. Please call us at 800-999-2328 or visit and ECU branch for initial access. Visit www.ecu.org for additional information. 
Federally insured by NCUA
To learn more about how we protect your privacy, please visit https://www.ecu.org/privacypolicy

Learning Russian has never been so easy.
It is perfect for you whether you have a beginner, basic, intermediate or advanced level of Russian. With our online Russian course you will notice your Russian improving very quickly. Millions of students have already tried our courses. Would you like to join them?
Our online Russian courses:
Russian Course
In this course you will learn Russian from the ground up. Whatever your starting level, the course is designed to help you learn Russian from day one.
Russian Cases Course
In this course you will study Russian cases. You will practice their forms and learn how to use them correctly through additional exercises. Designed for people who are already doing the Russian Course.
Our learning method:
An easy, guided learning process designed for you: you will feel that you are learning more Russian every day. Every sentence, exercise, review and reading has been carefully selected for you.
Audio clips in Russian: A wide variety of accents with clear, crisp pronunciation, recorded by professional narrators.
Linked concepts: Each word is linked to its use or precise meaning. Tap a word in any sentence, exercise or reading to see its meaning or an explanation of its use.
Lesson structure: Concepts are introduced progressively throughout the course. Only concepts that have already been explained are used to create the content (sentences, exercises and readings).
Vocabulary: Learn the meaning, pronunciation and use of words with activities adapted to your progress.
Grammar exercises: Practice your grammar with exercises linked to explanations.
Vocabulary topics: Words are grouped into topic categories.
Spaced reviews: Review vocabulary and grammar at increasingly long intervals.
Search: Find whatever you are looking for, including vocabulary and grammar.
Readings: Learn and practice with conversations, news, emails and interviews, among others.
Diplomas: Earn a diploma that proves your knowledge at the end of each level.

- Basic: With a Basic account the course is free, with some limitations.
- Premium: With a Premium account you have access to all course content and activities.

Download our app to learn Russian!

bluejetty:00075558:ios.description:
Welcome to Jurassic Dinosaur, the dino park management game where you can build and expand your very own prehistoric paradise! Create a Jurassic playground for your visitors by unlocking and nurturing a wide range of realistic and awe-inspiring dinosaurs. From the mighty T-Rex to the gentle Brachiosaurus, these prehistoric beasts require your utmost care and attention to ensure they are well-fed, healthy, and happy.
But it's not just about the dinosaurs - you must also design and construct your park to attract visitors and generate revenue. Build roads, amenities, and attractions, and use your earnings to expand and enhance your park. Strategically place amenities to keep visitors happy, and monitor the health and happiness of your dinosaurs to ensure their well-being.
As the park owner, it's up to you to make strategic decisions that will impact the success of your park. Use research to unlock new dinosaur species and features, and stay ahead of the game by managing natural disasters and dinosaur diseases that will test your management skills and keep the gameplay fresh and exciting.
With endless hours of entertainment, Jurassic Dinosaur is a thrilling mobile game that offers something for everyone, from dinosaur enthusiasts to park management fans. Download now and start your own prehistoric adventure today!

bluejetty:00175262:ios.description:
MEATER® is the world’s first Wireless Smart Meat Thermometer that can help you cook meats perfectly every time.
The MEATER® app, together with the MEATER® meat thermometer (sold separately at https://meater.com/shop) will change the way you cook your meals, and make it a new and exciting experience. Using patented software algorithms, the MEATER® app will give you cook time estimates, and guide you towards the juiciest steak, chicken, turkey, fish or other cut of meat that you've ever cooked.
It’s time to break free from the kitchen or grill and let the MEATER® app monitor your food for you. When your food is ready, you'll receive audio and visual notifications on your smart device. This way, you can stop watching your food cook, giving you more time to focus on the things that matter the most to you.
* Unlike other smart meat thermometers, MEATER® is completely wireless! All of the electronics are contained inside the MEATER® probe, eliminating the need for any external wires.
* Easily connect up to four MEATER® probes at once to cook every steak exactly the way each person likes them.
* The smart Guided Cook™ system lets you know how long to cook your food, when to remove it from heat, and how long to let it rest. Simply select the type of meat, cut, and cook you want in the MEATER® app, then sit back and relax as perfect results are achieved.
* For veteran chefs, fully customizable cooking and alert options are available to give you total control over your cooking experience.
* Access your complete cooking history with ‘Previous Cooks’ so you can repeat your favorites whenever you want.
Cook smarter with MEATER®! Learn more at https://meater.com.
Get to know us!
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/MEATERmade/
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/meatermade/
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/c/MEATER/
Twitter: https://twitter.com/MEATERmade
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@meatermade
Check out meals cooked with MEATER® by searching the hashtag #meatermade, and don't forget to use the hashtag when you share your own cooks online!
This app requires at least one MEATER® probe to operate (sold separately at https://meater.com/shop). The MEATER® app supports all iOS devices with Bluetooth® LE (Bluetooth® Smart) support, running iOS 14.0 or later.

bluejetty:00083193:ios.summary:

Normally, a dog whistle is within the range of 16000
bluejetty:00083193:ios.description:
Get the original Dog Translator and Whistle today! Play games for dogs and talk to your dog with the Translator. A dog whistle is a type of whistle used in the training of dogs and cats.
Normally, a dog whistle is within the range of 16000 Hz to 40000 Hz with only the frequencies below 20000 Hz audible to the human ear. Our whistle has adjustable sliders for active control of the frequency produced. These kinds of whistles are also used to determine the hearing range of people or for physics demonstrations.
Discover your dog’s breed instantly with our new AI-powered breed scanner. Just upload a photo, and our intelligent system will analyze your dog’s features to identify its breed accurately.
Features - Dog translator - Dog training lessons - Dog sounds
- Dog Breed Scanner - Variable frequency tone generator - Sound level meter - Saved Settings Bar
To Train: Play the sound in front of your dog while playing the high-pitch sound. The dog needs to associate the sound with a command. Repeat as many times as you need to accomplish this. Use treats to teach him that he did well!
 • Shut up an annoying dog that is barking. Just play a sound!
 • Train your dog to do many things!
 • Train your dog to do tricks!
How does it work? Dogs are capable of hearing sounds at much higher frequencies than people. A dog whistle works by emitting a high-frequency tone in a range that a dog does not ordinarily encounter. The highest frequency a normal middle-aged human can hear is 12,000-14,000 Hz, so don't be alarmed if you can't hear all of the tones yourself. These high-frequency tones have the effect of immediately getting a dog's attention. Dog whistles are typically used as part of a training routine designed to train your dog to do tricks or for behaviour modification. A pure tone is much easier for a dog to distinguish compared to verbal commands. Different sound patterns can be used to trigger different responses. 
How do you tune your dog whistle? One method is to adjust the frequency of the tone, while your dog is sleeping, until your dog's ears perk up. When this happens, you have found a frequency that your dog is sensitive to.
Important Notes: Please note that dogs may not have an intrinsic response to high-frequency tones such as those used in this application. Therefore, you must train your dog to respond to the tones much like you would train your dog to respond to verbal commands. Through this training, many dogs will develop a conditioned response to respond in accordance with its training when it hears the tone. If your dog is not trained to respond to the tone, your dog may not respond to the tone. Recognise the possibility that success in dog training may not come as fast as you may anticipate, but relentless effort and consistency of commands will sooner than later reward you with success. Please consider this before purchasing our application.
Disclaimer: the translation functionality may not be accurate and is based on tone and voice. It is for fun purposes only.
Dog Whistle offers an auto-renewing yearly subscription at $19.99 USD/year, and an auto-renewing weekly subscription at $6.99 USD/week to provide you with unlimited access to all premium features while you maintain an active subscription.
Payment will be charged to the payment method connected to your iTunes Account when you confirm the initial subscription purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current subscription period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. You may manage your subscription and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your Account Settings after purchase.

Privacy policy: http://hypertornado.xyz/privacy.html

bluejetty:00038897:ios.description:
"My Dog & Me: Your Virtual Pet Adventure"
Dreaming of a playful puppy companion? Dive into the delightful world of "My Dog & Me," where you can enjoy the pleasures of pet care from your fingertips. This simple, engaging puppy-raising app is perfect for dog lovers of all ages.
"Create Unbreakable Bonds"
Spend time with your virtual puppy and watch your bond deepen. Share heartwarming experiences and make lasting memories with your cute pet.
"Fashion-Forward Puppies"
Deck out your puppy in the latest pet fashion. Choose from a variety of items to dress up your furry friend, making them the most stylish dog in the neighborhood.
"Decorate Your Dream Space"
Turn your virtual home into a cozy haven. Decorate with stylish furniture and items to create the perfect relaxing environment for you and your puppy.
■ How to Play: Fun and Fulfillment! ■
1. Tender Care
Nurture your puppy with food and affection. Enjoy the happiness of caring for your pet and earn rewards for your loving attention.
2. Discover with Dog Walks
After enjoying a meal, it's time for a stroll. Your puppy will find Dog Walk Finds even when you're not on your phone, bringing back unexpected treasures.
3. Creativity at the Craftshop
Use the Dog Walk Finds to create unique items at the Craftshop. Enhancing your Craftshop's level unlocks new and exciting crafting opportunities.
4. Dress and Decorate
Express your style through puppy fashion and home decoration. Watch your puppy engage with different items, showcasing adorable and playful behaviors.
Enjoy a world filled with mini-games, collectible items, and growing bonds. The more time you spend together, the closer your connection with your puppy becomes. Create an album of cherished moments!
Ideal for:
- Aspiring dog owners
- Enthusiasts of breeds like French Bulldog, Golden Retrievers, and Shiba Inus
- Those seeking comfort from adorable animal interactions
- Fans of gentle and captivating atmospheres
- Players who love nurturing, sandbox, and dress-up games
Start your loving adventure with "My Dog & Me: Your Virtual Pet Adventure" and experience the heartwarming journey of puppy parenting!

bluejetty:00016761:ios.description:
MICO is a global community for creative live streaming and interactive entertainment. We bring together talented broadcasters from around the world to showcase their skills, from music and dance to unique cultural performances. Join a vibrant community where you can enjoy high-quality content and engage with your favorite creators in real-time.
· Key Features:
■ Diverse Global Live Content
Explore a wide range of live streams from 100+ countries. Discover talented creators sharing their passions, including live concerts, talk shows, and creative arts. MICO is your window to global entertainment.
■ Interactive Community Engagement
Connect with broadcasters and fellow viewers through real-time participation. Join the conversation, support your favorite hosts, and be part of an inclusive community dedicated to positive interaction.
■ Seamless Real-Time Translation 
Experience content without boundaries. Our built-in translation feature allows you to understand and enjoy live streams from creators worldwide, fostering global cultural exchange.
■ Creative Virtual Gifting 
Express your appreciation for amazing performances with a variety of animated gifts. Support creators and help them grow within the community.
■ Safety & Moderation 
We are committed to providing a safe and respectful environment. MICO employs 24/7 manual and AI-powered moderation to ensure all content follows our community guidelines. We provide easy-to-use tools for users to report or block inappropriate behavior immediately.
MICO Auto-Renewable Subscription:
Subscription service: MICO Weekly Subscription (7 days); Monthly Subscription (30days); Annual Subscription (365days). All are auto-renewable.
Subscription price: Based on IAP application information, e.g., Annual subscription $99.99.
Payment: Subscriptions are managed by the user. After confirmation of purchase and payment, the amount will be charged to the iTunes account.
Renewal: The Apple iTunes account will be charged within 24 hours before expiration. Once charged, the subscription will be extended for another period.
Canceling renewal: To cancel the subscription, open "Settings" on your Apple device → go to "iTunes Store & App Store" → tap "Apple ID" → select "View Apple ID" → go to "Account Settings" → tap "Subscriptions" → select "MICO" to cancel the subscription. If the subscription is not canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the billing period, it will renew automatically.

bluejetty:00183696:ios.description:
TWINT is Switzerland’s digital cash. With TWINT, you can make convenient and secure payments using your smartphone.
All TWINT functions:
- Send and request money
- Make quick and secure payments in online shops
- Buy digital vouchers, pay for your parking and make donations in TWINT+, directly in the app 
- Make convenient and secure payments at cash registers, in farm shops and vending machines
- Store customer loyalty cards and employee cards in the app
- Benefit from discount coupons and digital stamp cards
Switzerland’s biggest banks offer their own version of the TWINT app. Please search in the App Store for the name of your bank together with the term “TWINT”. 
Top up credit:
The TWINT prepaid solution can be used by everyone, regardless of at which bank your account is
- Top up via your bank account (direct debit)
- Top up via a deposit slip
- Top up via a voucher code
Security:
TWINT is as secure as e-banking. All transactions take place in a secure environment. TWINT also does not disclose any personal data to third parties.
The money is not stored directly on the smartphone. If your smartphone is lost or stolen, or if you suspect fraud, please follow the instructions at www.twint.ch/block.

bluejetty:00089382:ios.description:
Most dating apps just give you options. Sitch gives you a matchmaker.
Your AI matchmaker gets to know you: what you want, what you don't, and what makes you unique — and uses all of it to introduce you to people actually worth your time.
Every profile is reviewed by real people on our team.
Sitch sets you up so you can spend your time dating, not searching.
How Sitch works:
Answer a few questions to create a profile. Share your preferences, your non-negotiables, your nice-to-haves.
Your matchmaker sends you curated introductions with photos, background, and why this person could be a fit.
After every introduction, send a note back about what worked and what didn't. Be as specific as you want. That's not picky. That's the point.
As you keep using the app, we'll ask questions to learn more about what makes you you.
When your matchmaker finds someone you should meet, and you both say yes, we'll set you up.

bluejetty:00073873:ios.name: OpenDocument Reader Pro
bluejetty:00073873:ios.summary:
Read documents created using LibreOffice or OpenOffice on the go, wherever you keep them, with the Document Reader!
The file reader lets you open files like ODF (Open Document Format) documents created using LibreOffice or OpenOffice where
bluejetty:00073873:ios.description:
Read documents created using LibreOffice or OpenOffice on the go, wherever you keep them, with the Document Reader!
The file reader lets you open files like ODF (Open Document Format) documents created using LibreOffice or OpenOffice wherever you are. In the bus on your way to school wanting to look at your notes before the big exam? No problem! With the Document Reader you can open files wherever you like and read & search through your documents to go in a clean and simple way. There is a text editor in here as well, for the last typo before a document goes out. It is a young one and it does not reach every document yet, so the reader is what this app is for. The Pro version also adds new paragraphs, text formatting such as bold, colours, sizes and alignment, formatting of spreadsheet cells, and more ways to mark PDFs: underline, strike out and draw.
You can open files from ODF (ODT, ODS & many more) that you have created with Libre Office or OpenOffice also from within other apps. Supported apps include GMail, Google Drive, iCloud, OneDrive, Nextcloud, Box.net, Dropbox and lots of others! Or use our integrated file explorer instead to open files on your device.
THE ALL IN ONE DOCUMENT READER
*open files with ODF: ODT (writer), ODS (calc), ODP and ODG without a hassle
*fix typos, edit and colour spreadsheet cells, and highlight text in documents and PDFs
*securely open password-protected documents
*search for keywords in your ODT (writer), ODS (calc) or ODG and highlight them
*print documents if your device is connected to a printer
*read your documents in fullscreen to avoid distractions
*select and copy text out of your documents
*enjoy your documents even without internet connectivity - fully offline capable
*read out aloud your documents using Text-To-Speech technology
DOCUMENTS TO GO - WHEREVER YOU LIKE
In addition to that, the document reader aims to support various other file formats as well as possible:
- Portable Document Format (PDF)
- Archives: ZIP
- Images: JPG, JPEG, GIF, PNG, WEBP, TIFF, BMP, SVG, etc
- Videos: MP4, WEBM, etc
- Audio: MP3, OGG, etc
- Text files: CSV, TXT, HTML, MD, RTF
- Microsoft Office (OOXML): Word (DOC, DOCX), Excel (XLS, XLSX), PowerPoint (PPT, PPTX)
- Apple iWork: Pages, Numbers, Keynote
- Libre Office and Open Office ODF (ODT, ODS, ODP, ODG, FODT, FODS, FODP, FODG)
This app is open source. We are not affiliated with OpenOffice, LibreOffice or similar. Made in Austria. We highly appreciate all kinds of feedback via email.
ODF is the format used by office suites like Open Office and Libre Office. Text documents (Writer, ODT), as well as spreadsheets (Calc, ODS) and also presentations (Impress, ODP) are supported, including complex formatting and embedded images. Graphs are no problem either. If you want to secure your data you can even open password-protected documents. Other applications that are using this format are LibreOffice, OpenOffice, NeoOffice, StarOffice, Go-oo, IBM Workplace, IBM Lotus Symphony, ChinaOffice, AndrOpen Office, Co-Create Office, EuroOffice, KaiOffice, Jambo OpenOffice, MagyarOffice, MultiMedia Office, MYOffice, NextOffice, OfficeOne, OfficeTLE, OOo4Kids, OpenOfficePL, OpenOfficeT7, OxOffice, OxygenOffice, Pladao Office, PlusOffice, RedOffice, RomanianOffice, SunShine Office, ThizOffice, UP Office, White Label Office, WPS Office Storm, Libre Office, Collabora Office and 602Office.

Bienvenido a tu app Banca Móvil del Banco de Bogotá.
Estamos cambiando contigo para que disfrutes de la mejor experiencia en cualquier lugar de forma rápida y segura.
Una vez descargues la aplicación ingresa con tu tipo y número de identificación junto con tu clave segura. En caso de no contar con clave segura ingresa por la opción “Registrarme en la app” y sigue los pasos.
Aquí podrás realizar:
• Consulta de productos, inscripción y pago de servicios y obligaciones, transferencias entre cuentas del grupo Aval y a otros bancos, recargas de celular, descarga de extractos y certificados, administrar la seguridad de tus tarjetas y activar tu token.
• Cambio de clave segura y conocer algunas recomendaciones de seguridad.

• Consultar tus extractos y certificados con envío al correo electrónico de tu preferencia.
• Controlar la seguridad de tus productos: Bloquea tu Tarjeta Débito temporalmente por pérdida o robo.
• Invertir o retirar hacia o desde encargos fiduciarios.
• Avances de tarjetas de crédito BdB sin clave.
• Recargas a celulares sin inscribir el número del celular.
• Pagos de servicios públicos y privados, tarjetas de crédito Aval y de otros bancos y créditos Aval.
• Transferir sin inscripción a cuentas BdB, o a cuentas inscritas Aval y de otros Bancos.
• Inscribir obligaciones de otros bancos para realizar el pago.
• Inscribir cuentas para realizar transferencias.
• Utiliza el cupo de tus créditos.
¡Importante!
Para realizar el proceso de “Registrarme en la app” es importante que tengas tus datos actualizados. Si no recibes el código para completar este proceso, debes actualizar tus datos en una de nuestras Oficinas.
Si tu sistema operativo es inferior a IOS 15.0, Banca Móvil BdB no podrá ser instalada, en ese caso te invitamos a usar nuestro Portal Transaccional ingresando a https://virtual.bancodebogota.co/#/login

bluejetty:00159861:ios.summary: Pendant Lifelog by Limitless is your AI-powered voice recorder, meeting note taker, and transcription tool in one. Capture, transcribe, and summarize meetings, voice memos, and conversations effortlessly, whether for work, study, or daily l
bluejetty:00159861:ios.description:
Pendant Lifelog by Limitless is your AI-powered voice recorder, meeting note taker, and transcription tool in one. Capture, transcribe, and summarize meetings, voice memos, and conversations effortlessly, whether for work, study, or daily life.
With accurate AI transcription and instant summaries, you’ll never miss a key detail again. Search through your voice notes using AI-powered search and chat, and organize everything seamlessly across your devices.
KEY FEATURES
• Accurate AI transcription: Pair with the Pendant device for all-day recording and instant, highly accurate transcripts.
• AI summaries and takeaways: Generate concise summaries of meetings, lectures, or conversations.
• AI-powered search: Chat with or search through transcripts and summaries to quickly find what you need.
• Daily AI insights: Get personalized recaps of your day, including productivity stats and reminders for unfinished tasks.
• Offline voice recording: Record audio memos or meetings using the app or Pendant device without an internet connection.
• Flexible export options: Export transcripts and summaries to notes apps, emails, or LLMs for further use.
• Privacy first: You own your data, securely stored with full control over sharing options.
• Cross-device sync: Access your transcripts and summaries on iPhone, desktop, or the web.
• Hands-free all-day recording: Keep the Pendant device running to capture everything without worrying about turning recording on or off.
WHO IS IT FOR?
• Professionals: Save time with automated meeting transcription, summaries, and shareable action points for teams.
• Everyday users: Keep track of ideas, personal reflections, and conversations with AI-enhanced audio notes.
• Students: Record lectures, turn them into study materials, and organize class notes.
• Content creators: Document interviews and brainstorming sessions.
HOW MUCH DOES IT COST?
Pendant Lifelog is free to download and includes 1,200 free transcription minutes each month. Upgrade to Pro or Unlimited plans for even more transcription minutes.
Terms of Service: https://www.limitless.ai/terms
Privacy Policy: https://www.limitless.ai/privacy

bluejetty:00098478:ios.description:
Baked in San Francisco with love
You know how we are all always a little frazzled these days? Just constantly distracted and brain fried — from work, from social media, whatever.
That's why we made this app called Bro.
It's just like… having a ridiculously supportive buddy on your lock screen. Sends you good vibes, checks in, and helps you keep your head on straight.
You can talk to bro about whatever: work, relationship... and bro is the perfect sounding board.
Bro even keeps a journal for you so that you can track your growth and connect the dots looking backwards.
Bro's just here to keep you dialed in, keep you sharp and chill, and on top of your game.
In this day and age, we could all use one more bro.
---------------

Our app offers an in-app subscription for a premium experience, including advanced AI models, unlimited memory, and unlimited cloud storage.

Subscriptions may be managed and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to Account Settings after purchase
Official Website: https://bro.my
Support: social@bro.my

bluejetty:00161113:ios.description:
TransG: Embrace & Celebrate Authenticity
Welcome to TransG, more than just a top app designed for adults in the trans community seeking real connections and love. This platform is not only tailored to meet the unique needs of transgender individuals by providing a safe, inclusive, and supportive environment for finding friends, love, and meaningful relationships, but it also serves as a vibrant hub for true self-expression.
TransG boasts a massive user base of hot singles, catering to a variety of unique wants and needs. Whether you're gay, straight, lesbian, trans, bi, or somewhere in between, our site is open to all transgender people and their admirers. When signing up, you can identify as a man, woman, pre-op male-to-female, post-op male-to-female, pre-op female-to-male, or post-op female-to-male. Crossdressers and transexuals are also welcome on TransG.
Our AI-powered Q&A feature, supported by ChatGPT technology, is ready 24/7 to answer all your questions about transitioning and beyond. This tool is crafted to enrich your TransG experience by offering comprehensive support and knowledge, ensuring informed and discreet responses to a wide range of topics – from personal journeys to medical or social inquiries.
Key Features:
SpaceG: Dive into a dynamic world of emoji group chats and private messaging. Engage and discover in our lively digital space, designed for instant, meaningful communication.
LiveLink: Instantly connect via video and audio calls in TransG, enhancing community bonds and safe self-expression.
Flashes: Lets trans users share fun, short videos to express themselves and connect through everyday moments.
AI-powered Q&A: Utilizing ChatGPT technology, get instant, accurate answers to all your transitioning and transgender-related questions, any time of day.
AI-Glam: Experience the magic of AI-assisted transformations. Share your radiant transitions, play with styles, and step into new personas. Whether experimenting with age, outfits, or even becoming your favorite anime character, AI-Glam makes it all possible.
Feed: Your life's vibrant canvas. Chronicle every emotion, milestone, and LGBTQ+ event. It’s where your stories come alive and resonate with others on similar journeys.
Dual Gender Display: Every aspect of your identity has a space here. Represent yourself authentically, and if you choose, share your birth gender. Every avatar tells a chapter of your unique story.
Privacy Pledge: We value trust above all. With robust data protection measures, TransG ensures your experience is not just enriching but also secure.
Join us. Let your authentic journey flourish with TransG.
Age Restriction Notice
Important: TransG strictly adheres to age restriction policies. This app's content and services are intended solely for users aged 18 and above. If you are under 18, please do not download or use this app. We are committed to providing a safe and responsible user experience, ensuring our content is appropriate for the intended age group.
TransG Premium Offers:
Monthly subscription: $19.99
Six-month subscription: $84.99
Annual subscription: $119.99
With a premium account, you'll enjoy unlimited access to all site features.
Payment will be charged to your iTunes account upon purchase confirmation. Your subscription will automatically renew, unless you turn off auto-renewal at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Renewal charges will be applied within 24 hours before the end of the current period.
You can manage your subscriptions and disable auto-renewal by accessing your Account Settings in the iTunes Store.
If you prefer not to purchase a Premium membership, you can continue using the app for free.
Rest assured, your personal data is securely stored on TransG. For more details, please review our privacy policy and terms and conditions:
Privacy Policy: https://www.transgapp.com/transg/team_service.html
Terms and Conditions: https://www.transgapp.com/transg/privacy_policy.html

bluejetty:00061195:ios.name: Douay-Rhiems Catholic Bible
bluejetty:00061195:ios.summary: The Douay-Rheims Bible is a translation of the Bible from the Latin Vulgate into English. It was the first officially authorized Catholic Bible translation in English, and has formed the basis of some later Roman Catholic Bibles in English.
bluejetty:00061195:ios.description:
The Douay-Rheims Bible is a translation of the Bible from the Latin Vulgate into English. It was the first officially authorized Catholic Bible translation in English, and has formed the basis of some later Roman Catholic Bibles in English. It includes the seven Deutero-Canonical books (also known as the Apocrypha).
In 1568, English exiles who were members of the college at Douai, in Flanders, founded by William (later Cardinal) Allen, began the work of preparing a Bible translation, which has become the foundation of nearly all English Catholic versions. In October, 1578, Gregory Martin began the work of preparing an English translation of the Bible for Catholic readers, the first such translation into Modern English. Assisting were William Allen, Richard Bristow, Thomas Worthington, and William Reynolds who revised, criticized, and corrected Dr. Martin's work. The college published the New Testament at (Reims/Rhemes) , in 1582 through John Fogny with a preface and explanatory notes.
Later, the Old Testament was published at in two parts (1609 and 1610) by Laurence Kellam through the efforts of Dr. Worthington, then superior of the seminary. The Douay-Rheims translation had been prepared before the appearance of the New Testament, but the publication was delayed due to financial difficulties. The religious and scholarly adherence to the Latin Vulgate text led to the less elegant and idiomatic words and phrases often found in the translation. In some instances where no English word conveyed the full meaning of the Latin, a Latin word was Anglicized and its meaning defined in a glossary. Although ridiculed by critics, many of these words later found common usage in the English language. Spellings of proper names and the numbering of the Psalms are adopted from the Latin Vulgate.
In 1749 Dr. Richard Challoner began a major revision of the Douay-Rheims Catholic Bible and texts, the spellings and phrasing of which had become increasingly archaic in the almost two centuries since the translations were first produced. He modernized the diction and introduced a more fluid style, while faithfully maintaining the accuracy of Dr. Martin's texts. This revision became the 'de facto' standard text for English speaking Catholics until the twentieth century. It is still highly regarded by many for its style, although it is now rarely used for liturgical purposes. The notes included in this version are generally attributed to Bishop Challoner.
The 1610 printing of the second time of the Old Testament includes an appendix containing the non-canonical books 'Prayer of Manasses,' 'Third Booke of Esdras,' and 'Fourth Booke of Esdras' as part of this Catholic Bible. While not part of Challoner's revision, the 1610 texts are placed in the appendices. Also included are the original texts of two short books, 'The Prophecie of Abdias' and 'The Catholike Epistle of Iude the Apostle,' to give the reader a sense of the language of the first editions in comparison to the Challoner revision. Further background on the Douay-Rheims version may be found in a selection from the preface to the 1582 edition and the original glossary included in the appendices.
Ease of Bible study with our application is achieved if the following:
- The application works without an internet connection (offline);
- Ability to search;
- Ability to increase / decrease the font;
- Ability to create an unlimited number of tabs to a particular verse, one of the books;
- If you are interested in the allocation of poems you can copy or send a message;
- Ability to scroll through the volume buttons.
User guide:
Each menu item is a separate book, and each separate page in one of the books is the chapter.
Place the cursor instead of the chapter number and enter the chapter number. Thus, you will not have to scroll all the chapters, selecting interesting.
Terms of Use - http://apple.nsource.by/terms-of-use.html
Privacy Policy - http://apple.nsource.by/privacy-policy.html

bluejetty:00186262:ios.description:
Readability’s award-winning Smart Reading & Comprehension Learning App gives your child the effectiveness of 1-on-1 tutoring. Our breakthrough voice-based technology LISTENS while your child READS, highlighting, and correcting any problem words. Kids from kindergarten to 6th grade will improve their reading, vocabulary, and comprehension skills all in the convenience of a mobile app.
IMPROVE READING WITH 1-ON-1 TUTORING 
Readability prompts your child to read aloud and listens while providing reading help and real-time pronunciation correction as your child reads. If they get stuck, they can tap on the speaker icon to have Readability read the selected passage or word aloud. Readability automatically selects the right reading material for each child to maximize improvement and minimize the reading struggle. Your child will be eager to learn as these fun and educational grade-level stories come to life with bright illustrations. 
IMPROVE CRITICAL THINKING SKILLS

bluejetty:00046366:ios.description:
U4Ea · Sound & Color Wellness
You can shift this.
U4Ea is a research-backed wellness app that uses binaural beats, pure tones, and color frequency to support how you feel — right now, in sixty seconds, on your phone.
HOW IT WORKS
Check in first. Four questions, no typing. Mark how you feel, where you carry it in your body, and where you want to move. U4Ea scores your seven centers — the emotional and physical zones your body already knows — and builds a session matched to your current state.
Then press play.
From a catalog of 385 binaural frequencies across the delta, theta, alpha, beta, and gamma ranges, U4Ea selects a combination tuned to your score. Every session is logged. A ten-second check-in after each one feeds your history, so the longer you practice, the more precisely your sessions meet you where you are.
WHAT'S INSIDE
— Binaural Beats & Pure Tones: frequencies matched to your seven-center score, across every brainwave range
— Full Sound Library: rain, ocean, fire, forest, Tibetan bowls, color noise, and pure single-frequency tones
— Schumann Bowls: a virtual instrument built from seven resonance frequencies, one per center, played with both hands in real time
— Privacy-First Design: your assessment runs on-device. Only your seven-center score values ever leave your phone. Raw inputs stay local, always.
THE SCIENCE
Binaural beats, music therapy, and chromotherapy have been studied for decades across thousands of participants. The findings keep converging: rhythmic auditory and visual stimuli produce measurable responses in the nervous system. U4Ea combines all three, built on fourteen peer-reviewed studies. Full citations at u4eaapp.com/science.
The NIH has invested over $35 million in what they call "music as medicine." Ancient healing traditions from Egypt, India, Tibet, Hawaii, and the Americas arrived at the same tools — independently, centuries apart. U4Ea is built at the intersection of that lineage and what modern research is now measuring.
Schumann Bowls, AI-generated visuals, Kaleidoscope Player, Smart Sessions, unlimited Spaces, full score history, weekly check-ins, and early access to new features.
U4Ea CARE — FOR FACILITIES
Hospital systems, clinics, hospice, rehab, and wellness centers: see u4eaapp.com/care for multi-seat licensing, HIPAA-aligned data handling, practitioner dashboards, and EHR integration.
U4Ea is a wellness tool, not a medical device. It is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any condition. If you are experiencing a mental health crisis, please call or text 988.
TERMS & PRIVACY
Terms of Use: https://u4eaapp.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://u4eaapp.com/privacy

bluejetty:00185638:ios.description:
Use the Disney Cruise Line Navigator app before, during and after your voyage—to plan, explore and relive the fun.
AT HOME
Plan your vacation, make payments, breeze through check-in, reserve onboard activities or make special requests—from dietary preferences to birthday surprises. 
Get Ready to Cruise
• Retrieve your reservation to make payments, review required documents and more.
• Use My Online Check-In to fill out your cruise documents and register kids for youth clubs.
• Explore activities and entertainment. 
• Book activities, including Port Adventures, Premium Dining, Onboard Fun, Spa & Fitness and Nursery.
• Change your dinner seating assignment.
• Add or edit Vacation Protection Plan and Ground Transportation.
• View your Air Transportation.
• Make Special Requests, including special diets, accommodations for little ones, celebrations and more.
ON BOARD THE SHIP
With your app in hand, you can explore your ship with Deck Plans, view favorite and booked activities, learn about the ports you’ll visit and use the onboard chat feature.
Enhance Your Experience
• View onboard activities across your entire voyage.
• Plan your day, from shows to shopping.
• Review your ports of call and at-sea days.
• Read details about activities that interest you.
• Check menus before dinner—kids’ menus too—and easily access your dining schedule.
• Check out the latest offers and specials.
• Save favorite activities in one convenient list.
• View booked activities, including Port Adventures, Premium Dining, Onboard Fun, Spa & Fitness and Nursery.
• Find Disney Characters throughout the ship.
• For assistance, visit our Help Center.
Know Where to Go
• Explore your ship deck by deck, from bow to stern.
• Find locations of the activities you want to do.
Stay in Touch
• Use onboard chat to stay connected to your family, friends and shipmates.
• While aboard your cruise, chat one-to-one or with multiple friends and family members at once.
• Use our wide array of Disney emoticons to express yourself as you chat.
AFTER YOUR CRUISE
View past reservations and more—and transport yourself back to the adventure when you download your purchased photos, available for a limited time.
Effortless Access All in One Place
• Easily view past reservations, including your stateroom number.
• Look back at onboard charges (within 90 days of your cruise).
• Explore and book your next cruise.
Download the Disney Cruise Line Navigator app today and enjoy it at home or on board. Simply connect to the ship’s Wi-Fi network—complimentary to app users only.
Note: To use onboard chat, you are required to provide your full name, stateroom number and birth date. Children should always ask their parent or guardian before using onboard chat. Control access for children with the permissions feature.
APP PERMISSIONS
Camera & Microphone Access: This app uses your device's camera and microphone for the Disney Uncharted Adventure game experience.
Storage Access: This app saves data locally to your device, including chat messages and embarkation information, to ensure a seamless experience even when connectivity is limited.
Location Services: This app requires location permission to connect to Wi-Fi networks and enable Bluetooth (BLE) features, such as DisneyBand+ functionality. Your actual location is not tracked or stored.

OneDMV combines short lessons, practice questions, and clear explanations to help you learn driving rules and apply them to different road situations. Review your mistakes, understand what went wrong, and use practice exams to check your preparation.
------
UNDERSTAND THE RULES BEHIND THE ANSWERS
Remembering an answer is different from understanding why it’s right. OneDMV helps you connect driving rules to road situations, so you can practice applying what you know when a question is worded differently.
HOW ONEDMV HELPS YOU LEARN
Learn the rules. Practice applying them. Understand your mistakes.
• Learn one rule at a time
Build your understanding through short, focused lessons with clear explanations and easy-to-follow road examples.
• Read road signs, instead of memorizing them
Learn how a sign’s color, shape, and meaning connect to the action you should take.
• Put your understanding into practice
Answer questions about different road situations, with explanations that help you understand why an answer is right or wrong.
• Learn from your mistakes
Review the questions you missed, revisit the rules behind them, and practice again to strengthen your understanding.
• Check your preparation

bluejetty:00118889:ios.name: ClearToken App
bluejetty:00118889:ios.summary:
The ClearToken iOS App is a reference application for manufacturers interested in including the ClearToken technology into their products.
By combining Bluetooth low energy devices with ClearToken's proprietary single use token technology
bluejetty:00118889:ios.description:
The ClearToken iOS App is a reference application for manufacturers interested in including the ClearToken technology into their products.
By combining Bluetooth low energy devices with ClearToken's proprietary single use token technology companies can deliver convenient access control solutions with via their customers mobile devices.
The App gives a very simple example of the technology. After the device has been verified by its phone number the user is presented with a list of ClearToken BLE devices that are in range.
The user select a device and is presented with the details of that item.
It that device is the one they are looking for they press the action button (Go in the screenshots) and the device will be activated to perform whatever action it is wired to do.

bluejetty:00016237:ios.summary: Welcome to Crazy Dino Park, a wonderful and exciting Puzzle game. Discover the mysterious world of the dinosaurs. Uncover the mysteries hiding just beneath the surface. Giant skeletons, hidden treasures and artifacts are waiting to be disco
bluejetty:00016237:ios.description:
Welcome to Crazy Dino Park, a wonderful and exciting Puzzle game. Discover the mysterious world of the dinosaurs. Uncover the mysteries hiding just beneath the surface. Giant skeletons, hidden treasures and artifacts are waiting to be discovered by you. 
Venture into the wild to recover dinosaur fossils. Build new structures and entertain your visitors. Dive into this crazy amusement park and endorse its unique approach to science and history.
Managing a dinosaur park, especially as crazy as this one, is both a great responsibility and wonderful opportunity.
* Oversee numerous excavation sites to uncover fossilized remains of the dinosaurs.
* Solve jigsaw puzzles to bring these prehistoric creatures back to life.
* Discover new variations of your dinosaurs by combining them with each other.
* Develop your park by building new structures and pens for your growing collection of unique life forms.
* Find mysterious artifacts and bonus items during you expeditions.
* Attract the visitors and entertain them with new items and events. Gain popularity, earn more money and invest it to further grow your enterprise.
* Customize the look of your park by a wide selection of decorative items.
* Assemble a team of your strongest dinosaurs and test your skills against other players in the PVP Crazy Battle Arena.
Embark on this great adventure with a mix of management and exploration game. Dig dinosaur fossils from beneath the ground. Meet all the funny dinosaurs and our wacky Professor. Become a jurassic park builder and owner, in this dinosaur fossil exploration game. Run your very own crazy dinosaur park and set out for the adventure of a lifetime!
“Crazy Dino Park” is FREE to download and FREE to play. However, you can purchase in-app items with real money. If you wish to disable this feature, please turn off the in-app purchases in your phone or tablet settings.
We make our games with love. If you like what we do, please do not forget to rate us.
If you encounter any problems with our game, please do contact us at support@idreams.pl and we'll do our best to help you.

bluejetty:00159880:ios.name: Photo/Message Lock - SafeCloud
bluejetty:00159880:ios.summary:
Have messages, photos or videos that are so private you want to keep on a separate safe cloud only you could access? This app is for you! 
The only app that enables multi-factor authentication to access your cloud stored private data!
Eas
bluejetty:00159880:ios.description:
Have messages, photos or videos that are so private you want to keep on a separate safe cloud only you could access? This app is for you! 
The only app that enables multi-factor authentication to access your cloud stored private data!
Easily backup your popular application's messages (including videos, photos etc) in the cloud securely and safely. Currently fully support importing chats from WhatsApp and Line. Other chats, photos & videos could be imported manually.
Make any of your conversation, photos or videos private easily and keep those behind a lock only you have access to.
You can unlock your saved chats, photos or videos using TouchID, FaceID or a passcode (depend on your device capability)
Store all your private conversations, photos and videos on a secure cloud which could be unlocked by you only. 
Syncing your data with our cloud and login is optional.
If you decide to store your data in our cloud and you forget your password you can restore it by multiple factor authentications so you would have access to this private data always. To have access to the cloud data you would need to have access to the email and phone number you have provided.
Important: The app doesn't add a lock to the original app, it is used to store your sensitive data and chats in a safe cloud. It is your responsibility to delete those chats from the original device.
-----------------------------------
Information about the auto-renewable nature of the subscription
- If you want to use our service, we offer you cloud archiving service. With subscribing you will get 10GB cloud disk space.
- Subscription period is monthly or yearly. Every month or year your subscription renews.
- Prices for subscriptions depends on which package you choose and will be seen in payment screen.
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
- You can cancel your subscription via this url: https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039
- Privacy policy: http://privacy.safecloudapp.com
- Term of use: http://tos.safecloudapp.com
- Subscription Information : http://subscription.safecloudapp.com
-----------------------------------
DISCLAIMER
Unofficial Product. Any product names, logos, brands, and other trademarks or images featured or referred to within this app are the property of their respective trademark holders.
Any of these trademark holders are not affiliated with us, our products, or our apps. They do not sponsor or endorse this app or any of our online products.

bluejetty:00040467:ios.description:
【熊窝dodox讨论群】：462088639 （问密码、问教程、提出开发建议、提出修改建议、玩家交流）
【熊窝dodox微信公众号】：熊窝dodox 或 Lairdodox（机器人自动回答密码和简单问题）
【英雄群侠传II官网】：https://www.lairdodox.com
【游戏简介】：
　　一个人独立制作的高自由度武侠游戏，历经一年零七个月时间。
　　英雄群侠传II在一代的基础上有了很大的变化，首先是彩色水墨画风格的半回合制游戏，练功也由原来的艰苦模式改成了自动修炼，并且加入了每日签到以及奖励福利和节日奖励。
　　武功技能方面是翻天覆地的变化，每一个武功都有不一样的武功光景，打斗方面从原来的单挑模式增加为群殴模式，可以有更多的对战人数，以及拥有自己的队友进行战斗。
　　游戏地图比之前的一代也有了巨大的提升，范围更大，能进入的场景更多，地图中会有可以采集的木材和矿石，并且在一定时间之后会恢复，地图与玩家之间的互动也会更多。
　　这个游戏还是一个人制作，现在时间越来越少，可以做的时间也越来越少，只要有时间我就会更新这个游戏，有很多喜欢一代的玩家，在二代中你们一定会有更好的游戏体验和玩法上的感受。
==========游戏特点==========
 水墨风格武侠类游戏，纯免费的单机角色扮演游戏，无需联网，无内购。
 在一代原有的基础上增加了嵩山派、青城派、恒山派、明教、天鹰教、五毒教、神龙教、红花会、天地会。 
 英雄群侠传一直以来都是一个需要动脑需要分析需要研究的高自由度游戏，游戏中人人平等，没有充钱就能无敌的玩家，给所有喜爱武侠的人同一个起跑线，在这个世界完成你心中的武侠梦。
 这是一个慢节奏游戏，现在都是快餐游戏、网络游戏时代，一天不玩一小时不上就差别人一大截，上班已经很累了何必还要被游戏拖累成为负担呢？所以我决定这个游戏永久单机，每天玩一玩自娱自乐，不玩也不会有负担。
 此游戏不适合习惯一键寻路、一键通关、用钱来解决的玩家，此处武林人人平等，只要你花费心思去研究，就能创造出属于你自己的武林，纯单机游戏你会有研究出很多玩法。
 游戏一开始将会让玩家选择性别、性格、你的选择将会影响游戏的剧情发展，请谨慎选择。
==========古色古香==========
 英雄群侠传II的主线剧情是一个正在玩英雄群侠传I的玩家获得了真是武侠体验的机会，在一个虚幻武侠世界中完成武侠梦想的过程，你可以选择命运选择生活，这个武林该如何，是正是邪全部交给你来决定。
==========更新频率==========
 根据游戏玩家数量和大家反馈的意见，以及我个人的时间，如果玩的人多，反馈意见多，我会挤出时间来提高游戏的更新，哪怕是一个人，我也会尊重你给的建议和意见。
==========游戏特色==========
【采集系统】地图上随时都能发现矿石和木材，采集完毕后一段时间还会生长出来。
【机密系统】有的宝箱或者机关是有密码的，如果输入错误就会自毁，所以别自作聪明。
【结婚系统】可以和心仪的武林侠士结婚了，结婚之后伴侣可以帮助你修炼、武功、技艺等。
【挂机系统】忙碌的小伙伴们没时间玩？琅嬛福地提供了离线挂机和在线挂机功能，收获各有不同。
【好友系统】部分武功秘籍、神兵利器就看你有没有找对人搞好关系了，异性角色还可以结婚。
【门派系统】每一个门派都有职位小至弟子大道掌门，你的身份会因为你的行为发生变化。
【生命系统】你的年龄、肚子的饱饿、口渴会一直在变化，如果你有什么想不开的，平安镇西郊的歪脖树提供上吊服务。
【生活系统】还记得武林群侠传中的 打猎、绘画、书法吗？游戏中还能购买别墅、家具、雇佣侍卫和婢女，赚钱的门路也会很多，例如挖矿锻造、或者可以去找镖师押镖。
【练功系统】武功招式等级不同，威力也会变化，还会有一些绝技可以通过副本和任务获得。
【奇遇系统】命运造化天注定，武林秘籍、神兵利器就看你机缘了，金庸、古龙著名人物都将现身其中。
【善恶系统】正邪不两立，两种人生两种命运可自由抉择，善恶将影响游戏发展和所能拜入的门派。
【皇位系统】各路大侠都可以招兵买马杀入皇宫谋朝串位，登上皇帝宝座、后宫佳丽三，皇宫就是你的了。
【天气系统】不同区域有特别的天气现象出现，或是下雨或是下雪，不同的天气会有不一样的奇遇经历。
【周目系统】通关一次之后，再次进入游戏会获得上次通关的奖励和祝福。
【家园系统】购买江南别院之后可以为家中添置各种家具，小院子中也可以种树养花。
【交通系统】江湖之大，各大主城都为侠士们提供了便捷的马车服务和商船服务，不想跑路的侠士有福了。
【轻功系统】想体验瞬间去到自己想去的地方吗？踏踏实实修炼轻功，可以通过施展轻功如愿以偿。
【套装系统】当筹集一整套装备之后，便可发挥出意想不到的隐藏属性和隐藏能力的提升。
【筋脉系统】两大筋脉，任脉和督脉，每次打通一个穴位都能获得对应的属性提高或是新能力的领悟。
【破绽系统】战斗并非无脑出招，既可以闪躲、防御化解掉对方，也可以运用破防、破绽克敌制胜。
【连招系统】想要威震八方单凭一种武功还不够，多种武功之间可以进行连招提高威力。
【时装系统】NPC身上好看的服装可以抢过来自己穿上，改变自己的外观。
【克制系统】天下没有哪一种武功是绝对的无敌，相互之间可以克制，例如一阳指就是蛤蟆功的克星。
【秘籍系统】许多绝世武功可能藏匿于某处或记载在某本书卷之中，若是寻获便可以习得上面的武功。
【探险系统】除了在地图中标记的地点外，还有很多隐藏的地方等待玩家去探索，首先要获得位置信息的所在。
【坐骑系统】大地图中可以看到游走的野马，驯服之后便可以骑着马匹驰骋江湖。
【结伴系统】闯荡江湖怎么能少得了好友相助，与人关系到一定程度之后便可以邀请对方加入自己队伍。
【强化系统】所有的装备都可以使用自己采集的矿石进行强化，提高装备的品质。
【镶嵌系统】在副本或任务中获得的宝石可以镶嵌在自己的装备或武器上，能提高物品的属性。
【押镖系统】各位侠士可以在各大主城接到不同难度的镖车，押送完成之后能获得丰厚的奖励，押送途中也有可能被劫镖的危险。
【互动系统】游戏中有很多的技艺，例如棋术、钓鱼、书法、音律等，可以直接学习，也可以通过完成对应的小游戏获得技能的提升。
【体验系统】不需要修改也不需要作弊，游戏中提供体验模式，畅快体验所有门派的武功和所有装备、物品的效果，让你更快的了解武林世界中的千奇百变。
【副本系统】侠客岛、唐家堡、藏经阁和光明顶可以通过善恶令、小李飞刀、平安符与圣火令前往打败守关敌人掉落装备和武功秘籍，副本中不仅需要玩家展现实力，还需要开动智慧解除机关。
【锻造系统】所有装备属性除了会随机变化，还可以进行强化和镶嵌宝石，没有最强的武功，任何困难面前只要妥善的搭配装备，就没有打不败的敌人。

bluejetty:00098305:ios.description:
Relax and boost your brain with this addictive, fun, and challenging number puzzle game!
Looking for a fun way to sharpen your reflexes? This addictive number game challenges your mind, enhances your mental flexibility, and hones your eye for detail. It is easy to play, and hard to put down!
With simple mechanics - just match numbers or find pairs that add up to ten - it's easy to get started, but every level keeps you thinking strategically and spotting patterns. It's the perfect mix of brain exercise, logic, and fun, offering endless brain challenges for players of all levels!
How to Play This Number Puzzle Game
Match two identical numbers or pair digits that add up to ten to clear the board.
Tap and remove number tiles, scoring points with every successful match.
Connect numbers horizontally, vertically, or diagonally for efficient number matching.
Link number pairs from one row to the next for maximum moves and strategic play.
Stuck? Use hints or the add-row tool to keep your number game going forward!
Complete the number puzzle by clearing all tiles and earn high scores in this addictive math game!
Exciting Game Highlights
Special Levels: 
Collect gems to unlock exclusive, thrilling challenges that push your skills to the limit!
Daily Challenges: 
New number games every day keep the fun fresh and your brain engaged!
Postcard Rewards: 
Indulge your collector's spirit and celebrate your achievements with unique themed postcards!
Best Scores: 
Compete with yourself to achieve the highest scores and master the math game's challenges!
Challenge Levels: 
Tackle number levels with specific score targets to earn even greater rewards and tougher challenges!
Powerful Tools: 
Use hints and the add-row tool to keep progressing and clearing the number board!

Simple to get started, but the deeper you go, the more you'll be hooked!

This addictive number game offers the perfect combination of fun and brain training! As you progress, you'll sharpen your math skills and pattern recognition, making it the ideal game for anyone looking to enhance their brainpower while enjoying a relaxing yet challenging puzzle game experience. With daily number challenges and special levels to tackle, there's always something new to keep you hooked!

Collect postcards to celebrate your success, track your best scores, and push your limits with challenging digit levels. bluejetty:00027946:ios.name: Romans: Age Of Caesar
bluejetty:00027946:ios.summary:
*** From the Creators of Stronghold and Caesar ***
Rebuild the Eternal City of Rome and be crowned Caesar in Firefly Studios’ Romans: Age of Caesar! Expand your own Roman Empire alongside thousands of other players online and in co-op. Gat
bluejetty:00027946:ios.description:
*** From the Creators of Stronghold and Caesar ***
Rebuild the Eternal City of Rome and be crowned Caesar in Firefly Studios’ Romans: Age of Caesar! Expand your own Roman Empire alongside thousands of other players online and in co-op. Gather resources, set up trade routes, develop vital defences and assemble mighty legions as you gain true allies or battle fierce enemies in strategic warfare and political schemes. To become emperor is to dare to have your name known across the empire!
..::: FEATURES :::..
*** BUILD your online city and protect it with ancient defences and new allies.
*** RULE the legendary empire and march to expand its war-torn frontier!
*** BATTLE worthy enemies, trade with other cities and explore an ancient world filled with thousands of other players.
*** DEFEND your growing city from barbarian hordes and rival players by leading your legions to glory.
*** RISE through the ranks of the imperial Senate, ultimately cementing your authority by becoming Caesar.
*** PLAY FOR FREE on your phone or tablet, with frequent updates and cross-platform multiplayer.
..::: DESCRIPTION :::..
Romans: Age of Caesar is a co-op MMORTS from Firefly Studios, the award-winning creators of the Stronghold castle building series. In Romans, players will be greeted by an expansive empire map, where they can raise grand structures, uncover crucial resources, build alliances and wage tactical warfare in epic battles across mobile and PC platforms.
Hone your legions by pushing back the barbarian threat at your border or seek victory over other players in all-out online combat. Betray or befriend fellow governors online, defeating common threats and protecting the prosperity of each shared city. Vying for the ultimate goal to be crowned Caesar, you must work your way up through the Senate, using cunning or confrontation on your pathway to power. With multiple shared worlds and a full co-op experience on offer, there’s just no place like Rome.
..::: COMMUNITY :::..
Facebook – https://www.facebook.com/PlayRomans
Twitter – https://twitter.com/fireflyworlds
YouTube – http://www.youtube.com/fireflyworlds
Support – https://firefly-studios.helpshift.com/hc/en/4-romans-age-of-caesar/
..::: MESSAGE FROM FIREFLY :::..
Our goal with Romans: Age of Caesar has always been to give players the opportunity to experience a compelling MMO set in glorious Ancient Rome, an empire for and by the players. We're confident the city-building and RTS gameplay will be familiar to Stronghold fans, but the depth of all the elements across an ever-changing Roman empire map, with other real-time players to aid or hinder you, will make for a journey unlike anything else. Rome can’t be built alone, so join the ranks of thousands of others already online!
Firefly has always had tremendous respect for our players, so we’d love to hear your thoughts on Romans! Please try the game out for yourself (it’s free to play) and send us a message using one of the community links above.
Thank you for playing from everyone at Firefly Studios!
Please Note: Romans: Age of Caesar is a free to play MMO RTS, however players are able to purchase game items using real money via in-app purchases. If you don’t wish to use this feature you can add authentication for in-app purchases on your iOS devices and enjoy a completely free to play experience. Romans: Age of Caesar also requires a network connection to play.
Like the game? Please support us with a 5-star rating!

bluejetty:00081474:android.description:
CubeXpert is your comprehensive Rubiks Cube solver and companion, whether you're a beginner looking to conquer your first Rubiks cube or an experienced cuber seeking to refine your skills. Unlock the secrets of the Rubiks Cube Solver and become a master cube solver with our app.
With CubeXpert, you can dive deep into the world of Rubiks Cube solver. Our app provides you with an extensive library of algorithms, complete with detailed instructions and Rubiks Cube animations.
CubeXpert values personalization. Customize your Rubiks cube puzzle's appearance and behavior to match your style and comfort level. Tired of scrolling through endless pages to find your favorite algorithms? CubeXpert allows you to save and access them with ease.
If you're new to logic puzzles and Rubiks Cube solving, our app offers beginner-friendly tutorials how to solve a rubiks cube that break down the fundamentals step by step, empowering you with the knowledge you need to conquer the cube confidently. And for those moments when you want to add some fun to your cubing experience, explore our entertaining Rubiks cube patterns featuring unique and playful cube rotations and sequences.
Join a thriving community of cubers and embark on an exciting journey of skill-building and cube-solving exploration. Whether you aspire to become a Rubiks Cube champion, impress your friends with lightning-fast solves, or simply enjoy the satisfaction of mastering this logic puzzle, CubeXpert is your trusted cube solver.
Ready to elevate your Rubiks Cube game? Download CubeXpert now and take the first step toward becoming a Rubiks Cube pro!
Key Features
Unlock the secrets of the Rubiks Cube and become a master solver with CubeXpert, your ultimate guide to all things Rubiks Cube.
Rubiks Cube Solver 3x3
Experience the convenience of a built-in Rubiks Cube solver in CubeXpert. Enter the current facelet configuration of your Rubiks cube, and let our advanced solving algorithm provide you with a step-by-step solution. Whether you're stuck on a challenging scramble or want to check your solution against the app's recommendations, the Rubiks Cube Solver feature is your reliable companion in mastering the art of solving the cube.
Learn Rubiks Cube Algorithms
CubeXpert boasts an extensive library of algorithms designed to demystify the Rubiks Cube solving app process. Each algorithm is accompanied by detailed instructions and animations, ensuring that you can easily follow along and learn at your own pace. From basic maneuvers to advanced techniques, we cover it all, making sure you have the knowledge to conquer any cube.
Customize Your Rubiks Cube Experience
Change the colors of the cube's faces to match your style, and fine-tune the rotation speed to match your comfort level. Your Rubiks cube, your way.
Cross Trainer
Take your solving skills to the next level with CubeXpert's Cross Trainer feature. Specifically designed to enhance your proficiency in solving the cross — a crucial step in solving the Rubiks Cube efficiently. With the Cross Trainer, you'll gain the precision and speed needed to conquer the initial stage of any Rubiks Cube solve.
Learn Cube Basics
If you ever asked how to solve a rubiks cube, CubeXpert has an answer! If you're new to Rubiks Cube solving, CubeXpert provides beginner-friendly tutorials that break down the fundamentals step by step. Start with the basics and gradually progress to more advanced solving techniques. Our goal is to empower you with the knowledge you need to conquer the cube confidently.
Explore Fun Rubiks Cube Patterns
For those moments when you want to infuse some fun into your cubing experience, CubeXpert offers a delightful collection of entertaining cube patterns.
