bluejetty:00162027:ios.name: NAS Pro
bluejetty:00162027:ios.summary: NAS Pro is a powerful NAS management and monitoring app that lets you control your Synology (DSM), QNAP, or TrueNAS server from anywhere. Monitor system health, storage, network activity, containers, virtual machines, backups, and downloads
bluejetty:00162027:ios.description:
NAS Pro is a powerful NAS management and monitoring app that lets you control your Synology (DSM), QNAP, or TrueNAS server from anywhere. Monitor system health, storage, network activity, containers, virtual machines, backups, and downloads — all in one professional-grade mobile app.
Whether you manage a home NAS, private cloud, or business server, NAS Pro gives you remote access, real-time monitoring, and administrative control directly from your iPhone, iPad or Mac.
With support for Wake on LAN, Widgets, and Siri Shortcuts, you stay in control of your NAS anytime, anywhere.
Key Features**:
System Monitoring & Control:
* View system health at a glance
* Restart or shut down your NAS remotely
* Real-time CPU and RAM usage monitoring
* Start or stop installed packages
* Update Server
* UPS status: mode, battery level, and estimated runtime
Network Management:
* Real-time network traffic overview
* Connect or disconnect VPN interfaces
* Manage connected users (with option to terminate sessions)
* Detailed interface information
Storage Management:
* View all storage pools, volumes, and disks
* Run S.M.A.R.T. tests on disks
* Detailed external storage information (partitions and capacity)
* Eject external storage safely
Containers (Docker):
* See all containers with image names, uptime and utilization
* Real-time CPU and RAM usage per container
* Filter by status (running, stopped)
* Perform actions: start, stop, restart, force stop, clear
* Remove unused Images
Virtual Machines:
* List and monitor all virtual machines
* View utilization, network, and storage details
* Start, stop, or force stop virtual machines
* Filter by state (running, stopped)
Backups:
* View all backup tasks with status and details
* Browse backup versions
* Start or stop individual backup tasks
Downloads:
* Manage all download tasks in one place
* Create and edit download jobs
* Filter by task state (running, finished, paused)
* Pause, resume, or delete downloads
Logs:
* Browse the latest logs with color-coded severity
* Filter by log level (warnings, errors, etc.)
* Clear all logs in one tap
* Copy log messages to clipboard
Tasks:
* View all tasks and events
* Filter by status (enabled, disabled)
* Check “Run results” for selected tasks
* Perform actions: enable, disable, run, delete
Users & Groups:
* Manage users and groups
* Create, enable, disable, or delete accounts
* Adjust group memberships
** Functionality and available modules may vary based on your NAS.
Supported systems: 
* Synology DSM 6.0 and above
* Qnap QTS 5.0 and above
* TrueNAS 24 and 25.
--
Terms of Use: https://ezv-software.com/nas-pro/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://ezv-software.com/nas-pro/privacy/

bluejetty:00120940:ios.summary:
A little bird told me that you should definitely play this. Well, not actually. But it’s fun, trust us. Combine different and awesome kinds of birds and go beyond your imagination mixing up these animals. The sky is the limit!
From the cre
bluejetty:00120940:ios.description:
A little bird told me that you should definitely play this. Well, not actually. But it’s fun, trust us. Combine different and awesome kinds of birds and go beyond your imagination mixing up these animals. The sky is the limit!
From the creators of the renowned Evolution games, comes the sequel that takes the series to incredible new heights! Combine birds to evolve them and discover their most curious, exotic and bizarre forms!
FEATURING
• Pantheon: a place for supreme beings to look down on us mortals and laugh at our misery
• Impostors: watch out for impostors trying to steal the spotlight from the birds
HOW TO PLAY
• Drag and drop similar birds to create new mysterious creatures
• Use bird poop coins to buy new creatures and make even more money
• Alternatively, fiercely tap a bird to make coins pop when birds poop
HIGHLIGHTS
• Different stages and many bird species to discover
• A mind-blowing story yet untold
• The unexpected mix of alpaca-like evolution, 2048 and incremental clicker games
• Doodle-like illustrations
• Various possible endings: find your destiny
• No birds were harmed in the making of this game, only developers
Don’t settle for lousy games. Download Birds Evolution and reach for the sky! You know the saying: “the early bird catches the worm”!
Disclaimer: While this App is completely free to play, some additional content can be purchased for real money in-game. If you do not want to use this feature, please turn off in-app purchases in your device's settings.
Like our page on Facebook and be the first to know about our upcoming games and updates! http://fb.com/tappshq

الشروع في رحلة قانونية يمكن أن يكون أمرًا مرهقًا، ولكننا هنا لنجعلها أسهل بالنسبة لك. تطبيقنا يقدم مجموعة شاملة من الاستشارة القانونية والخدمات، مصممة لتلبية احتياجات الشباب المحترفين و
bluejetty:00039469:ios.description:
تبسيط رحلتك القانونية: استشارة وخدمات متخصصة بين يديك
الشروع في رحلة قانونية يمكن أن يكون أمرًا مرهقًا، ولكننا هنا لنجعلها أسهل بالنسبة لك. تطبيقنا يقدم مجموعة شاملة من الاستشارة القانونية والخدمات، مصممة لتلبية احتياجات الشباب المحترفين ورواد الأعمال وأصحاب الأعمال والشركات الناشئة والشركات الصغيرة والمتوسطة والأفراد مثلك.
هل تبحث عن استشارة قانونية ميسورة التكلفة ومريحة وموثوقة؟ لا تبحث بعيدًا. تطبيقنا يتيح لك الاتصال بمحامين مرخصين يتمتعون بخبرة في مجالات قانونية متنوعة. سواء كنت تتعامل مع عقود تجارية، قضايا توظيف، الملكية الفكرية، قضايا الأسرة، أو أي قضية قانونية أخرى، فإن محامينا هنا لمساعدتك عبر العملية.
نحن ندرك أن التعامل مع مكتب قانوني يمكن أن يكون مثقلاً بالضغوط، خاصة إذا كنت غير ملم بالإجراءات القانونية. لهذا السبب، يضمن واجهة التطبيق السهلة استخدامًا سلسًا وخاليًا من الضغوط. وداعًا للمكاتب القانونية المرعبة، ومرحبًا بالاستشارات الافتراضية من راحة مساحتك الخاصة. يوفر تطبيقنا وسيلة مريحة وسهلة للتواصل مع خبراءنا القانونيين، مما يتيح لك مناقشة قضيتك وتلقي الإرشاد المهني بكل سهولة.
الوقت ثمين، ونحن نحترم ذلك. يلتزم محامونا بتقديم حلول فعالة دون المساس بالجودة. نحن نسعى لتقديم استشارة قانونية ذات جودة عالية ودقيقة، مما يمكّنك من اتخاذ قرارات مستنيرة في الوقت نفسه يوفر عليك الوقت الثمين. من الاستشارات الأولية إلى الدعم المستمر، فريقنا ملتزم بمعالجة احتياجاتك القانونية بشكل سريع وفعال.

bluejetty:00092720:ios.name: mvbank
bluejetty:00092720:ios.summary: mvbank is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empower
bluejetty:00092720:ios.description:
mvbank is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with mvbank:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the mvbank app, you must be enrolled as a Mountain Valley Bank digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00178793:ios.summary:

In puzzle games, you can categorize snacks, drinks, and fruits and explore
bluejetty:00178793:ios.description:
Do you enjoy shopping at supermarkets and organizing your fridge? 
Then the triple matching game of Goods Master 3D is sure to provide you with a better experience! 
In puzzle games, you can categorize snacks, drinks, and fruits and explore the fun of triple matching in 3D cupboards, unlocking more of your favorite products like the most matching games. 
The puzzle games are straightforward, just drag the same 3D products to several shelves for pairing or triple matching.
Game Features
- Over 1000 levels
- Hyper-realistic 3D items: fries, snacks, drinks, coconut slices, soda, etc.
- Simple matching games gameplay
- Generous rewards of props and coins
- Realistic scene changes
- Easy-to-play time-killing game
- Super boosters and hints to help you pass difficult levels
- Choose realistic scenes and refrigerators to add fun to the game
- Detailed and beautiful design, choose your favorite realistic scenes
How to play
- Click on the same 3D items to add them to the shopping cart in puzzle games.
- 3 identical items will be cleared.
- Enjoy robust features such as fun matching 3D games and collecting skill cards.
- You can earn higher scores by cleaning and organizing the shelves in matching games.
- Unlock more of your favorite products by completing more game levels.
- Various products, as well as the ability to pass the time offline.
"Goods Master 3D" also offers many surprises, and you can challenge your vision and concentration through matching sorting games. If you are a fan of matching games, why not give Goods Master 3D a try?
"Goods Master 3D" is a classic casual matching game that combines elements of sorting, matching, and triple matching gameplay. In puzzle games, players need to sort various items to complete the task and challenge, while also using their observation and judgment skills to quickly and accurately match different types of goods. By matching three or more identical items, players can earn points and rewards and continuously improve their rank and level.
We believe you all like match games, triple match games, and sorting games. And that's why "Goods Master 3D" features a variety of gameplay modes, including sorting goods and matching goods. You must use your skills and strategy to match similar items and place them in the correct fridges or closets, while also trying to achieve Triple Match combos for even higher scores.
In addition to sorting and matching gameplay, "Goods Master 3D" also incorporates elements of color sorting. Players need to organize the items by category and color to fill the fridge or closet as efficiently as possible. The puzzle game's graphics are simple and beautiful, and the sound effects are pleasant, making it suitable for matching game players of all ages who enjoy Match games for adults or organizing games.
Discover the ultimate tile matching adventure with 'Goods Master 3D,' the fun games that sharpen your mind with challenging match 3 games and brain games. Dive into a world of mystery games without the need for wifi, where you can sort tiles, color balls, and same blocks in this free game for adults. 'Goods Master 3D' is not just a simple adult game; a magic no-wifi matching game full of intriguing puzzles that promise endless entertainment for those who love free games for adults.
Become a sorting games master with "Goods Master 3D" - a vivid fusion of puzzle games, matching games & organization games, which you can enjoy offline! Fine-tune your skills in the fun games that marry matching 3D and color match for an immersive puzzle game experience. Whether sorting colored balls or organizing goods in a closet, puzzle games transform you into a goods match-3D leader. 
So why wait? Start playing "Goods Master 3D" today and see if you have what it takes to become a master of matching games!

bluejetty:00094089:ios.description:
Lakeview Bank is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with Lakeview Bank:
- Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
- Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
- Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
- Transfer money between your accounts
- Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
- Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
- View and save your monthly statements
- Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the Lakeview Bank app, you must be enrolled as a Lakeview Bank Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.
